- Unlock/Lock
- To lock/unlock a distrib (uses the shared feature), need to make sure there are no comments in the file.  May get a delete any threaded comments error.

- Processor / Reviewer Tasks
- Step doesn't complete correctly
- Check Deal Setup > Ongoing Tasks
- Confirm the related Processing and/or Review tasks are setup on the deal
- Confirm that the File Location of each task is pointing to the right folder (check for typos, etc.)
- --If the file path and file name in the File Not Found error doesn't match the DID (ex. spaces in the wrong places) --Click on that task and hit Modify File Location
- --Update the File Location to match the DID and hit Save

- LID Change
- Loan mismatch
- -- Due to duplicate loans
- Check tblLoanCutoffOrig - ensure that the loans are only in this table once and with the old LIDs.  If have records of the loans with the new LIDs, delete those records.
- After removing the duplicate loans, reprocess.  If still having loan mismatches, go to Data-Actions > Setup > Collateral Validation and enable the "Always Reset Cutoff Data" setting.  Then reprocess.
- --Unrecognized loans
- Use LID Change.  NEVER fix the LIDs in the servicer/import files.

- Updating Cutoff
- To load data on a new RMBS deal: Use the “IMPORT CUTOFF – EXCEL” map.
- To append to existing cutoff data: Use the “IMPORT PREFUNDING CUTOFF – EXCEL” map. To update existing data: Use the "UPDATE CUTOFF BATCH"  map.
- Note: if tblLoanCutoffOrig is wiped out and it's after the first payment, can use the prefunding map (above) to reload the cutoff data.  See IMPORT PREFUNDING CUTOFF – EXCEL.
- Citrix/VDI
- VDI won't open.  Have to end all related processes in Task Manager.
- Run K:\!@RUN ME FIRST\Systems Help Tools\Citrix_Receiver_Reset.CMD
- Tip: Copy the file to your local machine's desktop for quicker access, especially if you have the issue every day.
- Report Logic
- If want to know the logic for a data point in any Crystal Report
- Add report to Data-Actions > Deal Report Setup > Display Reports
- In Process > Export, highlight the report in question
- Hit View Report Info - it will display the related sproc and auto-copy
- Paste into Notepad and copy just the sp name that is named similar to the report, ex. spRptRemitSummary5) Go to Action > Query > Search
- Paste sproc name where it says "Please Enter Text" and hit Search
- Select the desired sproc from the results.  Logic will be displayed below.  Copy all of the logic out and paste into SSMS for easier reading.

- Outlook Emails
- Can't format text
- Replying changes pictures to "OLE Object"
- This is due to the Sender's setting - update your Outlook settings (File > Options > Mail) and ensure that the "Compose messages in this format:" is set to HTML.  Going forward, all emails that you send will not cause the OLE Object issue for the recipients who want to reply or forward your email.
- For existing emails that you want to reply/forward that were already formatted incorrectly, you will have to manually change the format of the email BEFORE replying/forwarding: 1) Double-click on the message to open it in its own window.
- In the Move menu, select Actions > Edit Message
- Click on the Format Text tab and choose HTML
- Click on the Message tab and choose Reply or Forward

- Search in Database
- To search for a keyword, field, etc. in any of our database, use the iRibbon macro “SQLQuery_IR”.
- When running macro “SQLQuery_IR”, you’ll get the form you see in the middle of the snapshot in tab 3. In the upper right of the form, you’ll see a button that says “Search the Database”.  You can select iServ/iManage or iTax/SnrSub (and more) in the pulldown just to the left of the button. When you hit the button, a popup box comes up, and you can enter any word(s) you want, and it’ll search the database for that word, with a list of the results in the box on the bottom of the form. In the below example, I searched forthe word “DID”, so there were a TON of results.
- Default Printer in VDI
- Bank policy forces the default printer on VDIs to Citrix UNIVERSAL Printer every time you log in.  Even after fixing the default printer to XPS, Citrix forces the default back to Citrix Universal throughout the day.
- This can cause reports to generate incorrectly in iManage.
- Note: This is not an issue for automated deals.
- If want the printer to be reset automatically, follow https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/gsfu/GSF%20University%20Tech%20Tips/Add%20XPS.bat%20file%20to%20Outlook%20Startup.docx?
- d=wbcd8116218664923a8fbf2b7a6ac8eb7
- > Every time you restart Outlook, it will set the default printer to XPS
- If only want to change when needed, can use K:\!@RUN ME FIRST\Set_XPS_DefaultPrinter.lnk
- COPY the Set_XPS_DefaultPrinter.lnk utility to your desktop and run it as needed.

- Logging into Citrix via browser.  After login, get following error: "Citrix Workspace app cannot create a secure connection in this browser"
- Citrix Workspace app cannot create a secure connection in this browser.

- Duplicate Icons on Desktop
- Desktop has copies of various icons. Multiple same icons.
- All machines now use OneDrive Desktop as a default.  All your icons, shortcuts, files, etc. on one machine will also appear on all your other machines.
- You can delete the "copy" and it will be removed from all your machines.
- Ex. if your local machine or old VDI had an iManage icon and then you setup iManage on a new VDI, the next time you log onto any of the machines, you will see two iManage icons.
- Subout Loans
- If you previously used maps 18, 1551 or 1866 to load subout dates into tblLoanCutoffUpdate, we disabled all those maps and are getting rid of tblLoanCutoffUpdate
- Use map 2050 instead (writes to tblCutoffOverride.  One difference is you will need to include a ModifyDt in the import file.
- Online Storage
- If client only provides data via online storage facilities, such as DropBox, Google Drive, etc. (not Box.com), you will need to request a special entitlement.
- Via Access Management, request the "Internet Online Storage" entitlement and provide a very detailed justification as to why you need it.

- CUSIPs loaded in error

- New Check for InternalCheckReview :: specific to Backup Servicing services
- Definition of Backup Servicing is that at least one file is backed up every month in the deal’s data folder on the U:\ drive
- 1)If the deal has Backup Servicing services, then InternalCheckReview is going to check that the current month data folder is found (U:\Backup Servicing\[DID]\Data\[YYYY]\[M]\). If not, that’s going to be a fail.
- a.Some people may need to update their processes to make sure that’s the filepath they’re creating. (i.e. no folders like
- Data\YYYY.MM or Data\YYYY\MM)
- b.Some deals may not be using the DID as the folder name on U\Backup Servicing. If this is the case, please let me know and we can determine how much of an issue it is going to be to update the folder name on the U drive.
- 2)InternalCheckReview will also check if the folder contains at least one file (excel or PDF), if not, then it will fail.
- 3)To correct a fail
- a.Collect the data from the servicing contact and save it to the U drive.
- b.If you already have the data stored on the M drive, add MoveFiles_IR to the workflow to copy the data to the U drive.
- 4)If you need to override the fail
- a.Open either
- i.Template.xls file for the deal
- ii.If there is no Template.xls file, then open any excel file that’s in the data folder for that deal (U:\Backup Servicing \[DID]\Data\[YYYY]\[M]\).
- a.Then run the macro “InternalCheckAll_IR”
- 5)If you have a scenario where you do backup duties AFTER delivering the investor report (this might be the case for deals that have both Bond and Backup Servicing services), do the following
- a.Enable the “Post-Deliverables” workflow step
- b.Add the macro InternalCheckAll_IR, and keep the default file. ( J:\@Application_Setup\Global Macros\Code
- \InternalCheckReview.xlsm)
- i.Be sure to hit the “readonly” checkbox when adding that macro.
- 6)If you deliver a verification report/letter at the “Deliver Final Reports” workflow, you should enable the “Post-Deliverables” workflow and move AutoMail_IR to that step, to avoid sending the report multiple times should the InternalCheckReview fail.

- Arithmetic overflow error converting float to data type numeric. The statement has been terminated.
- This happens in the stored procedure spInsertOID_MX because SQL Server is trying to insert a FLOAT value into a NUMERIC column, and the value exceeds the precision or scale defined for that column.
- Why this occurs
### The NUMERIC(p, s) type in SQL Server has:
- p = precision (total digits) s = scale (digits after decimal)
- If the FLOAT value has more digits than allowed by p or more decimal places than s, SQL throws this error. Example :: NUMERIC(10, 2)  -- allows max 10 digits, 2 after decimal

- We’re excited to reintroduce the Issues Task Force and share a streamlined way to submit and track issues.
- The task force—made up of Sudh, Samir, John, and Rodney —is here to support deal teams, managers, and shelf SMEs with interpreting document definitions, evaluating client requests, and in-general navigating risk-related questions especially when SMEs/Managers need second set of eyes. To submit a new issue or follow up on existing ones, please use this Team channel (see below screenshot). Just @mention any of us and we’ll jump in. We actively monitor this space, so once you post, we’ll review, research, and respond with a resolution. We’ll also keep you updated in the thread on the progress of the issue and ask for clarification or more information as needed.
- This process makes issue handling more transparent and collaborative. It also lets us tag relevant reviewers, managers, or SMEs to weigh in. Plus, others can learn from the discussions—even if they haven’t faced the issue themselves.

- Acronyms - Glossary Of Terms
- Thursday, July 10, 2025	9:13 AM
- “Does everyone know what that means”?  We have a tendency to use acronyms and terms that are commonplace in some circles, but perhaps not widely understood.  Below is summary of acronyms GSF IR tends to use a lot.
- You may also consider Bank-wide used Glossary Of Terms for many more.
- BAU
- Business As Usual
- We refer to BAU issues as things that simply come up in the normal course of business.   For example, I get an error message when I tried to load a servicer file into iManage --- that’s a BAU item.
- CapEx
- Capital
- Expenditures
- The bank has a process by which each business line can make their case for $$ to improve their technology/infrastructure.   Annually, we present our wish list of items, the cost associated with executing on those items, and the benefits achieved if we were to complete the projects.   The most worthy projects get the $$.   We use our allotted funds to improve iManage --automated workflow, redesigned/modernized web-based user interface --- these are examples of our “CapEx” projects.   These items keep Linda EXTREMELY busy.
- TOS
- Technology and Operations
- Services
- Department responsible for all technology implementations across the Bank. This group governs everything from desktop computers, to servers, security, networking, VDI, etc.  Along the way, they are responsible for underlining processes that make data movements possible.
- PROD
- Production
- Main environment utilized for day-to-day processing.  PROD can refer to databases, servers, network drives, etc.
- UAT
- User
- Acceptance
- Testing
- Main environment utilized for testing of changes. UAT can refer to databases, servers, network drives, etc.
- IT
- Integration Testing
- Typically utilized by the development team for initital testing of changes.  IT can refer to databases, servers, network drives, etc.
- DEV
- Development Testing
- Main environment used by the development team where initial code changes are enacted for various initiatives. It could be for BAU bug fixes, CapEx initiatives, and anything in-between
- DEV Team
- Development Team
- A group of people respoinsble for code changes in applications
- SLA
- Service Level
- Agreement
- A service-level agreement is an agreement between a service provider and a customer. Particular aspects of the service – quality, availability, responsibilities – are agreed between the service provider and the service user
- SME
- Subject
- Matter Expert
- SMEs are responsible for bringing knowledge of function processes (e.g., risk, credit, compliance) and ensuring all Product development complies with risk policies, legal standards, and credit standards.
- An expert in some aspect of the delivery content expected to provide input to the delivery team regarding business, scientific, engineering or other subjects. Input maybe in the form of requirements, planning, resolutions to issues and/or review of delivery results
- TO
- Technical
- Owner
- Person who should have intimate knowledge of the functions and business needs regarding access to their application
- PBLO
- Primary
- Business Line
- Owner
- Person who should have intimate knowledge of the business line data and processes
- SIRP
- Software
- Inherent Risk
- Profile
- Transferred to AIR
- AIR
- Application Inherent Risk
- AIR (Application Inherent Risk) is the new ServiceNow-based inherent risk methodology replacing SIRP. It is used to determine an application’s inherent cyber and data risk levels.

- LIBOR Transition
- Tuesday, August 8, 2023	12:47 PM
### Now that LIBOR has officially ceased publication, we are in transition mode. Over the next two months, I will need your help with a few things:
## July o Footnotes
- Starting this month, we will be inserting a full page note at the end of the package for each deal that still actively uses LIBOR and is transitioning to SOFR
- Nothing to do here as Sudh is adding the footnote for all appropriate deals. Just let me know if you feel your deal should have the footnote but does not (or vice versa).
### o If your deal reports LIBOR or Next LIBOR, but no longer uses the index (e.g. all certificates that once referenced the index have paid off):
- Simply put “N/A” in place of the percentage.
- You can leave the “LIBOR” text, and no footnote is necessary.
- o “Next LIBOR” percentage and text label switches to “Next Adjusted SOFR” (can use “Next Adj. SOFR” if space is limited) ▪ I only see 12 deals besides Freddie/STACR that still report Next LIBOR.
- The percentage should come through input manager automatically with the spread adjustment included (see reminder below)
- The change to the text will need to be done manually.
- If you see another deal that still reports this AND has outstanding LIBOR certificates, let me know.
### These are the 12:
- August o All LIBOR reporting switches to “Adjusted SOFR” (can use “Adj. SOFR” if space is limited).
- My suggestion is to use IF statements based on dates for the text label. This way, you can start updating files now, and you will only have to go into distrib 1x.
- Again, the percentage will come through input manager with no changes needed to distrib or review (see reminder below).
- Freddie and STACR o These deals will work a little differently than most other deals. Your SMEs will reach out to you with further info.
- Reminder o As of 7/3/2023, the input manager items that contained LIBOR (e.g. US0001M) will now contain the combination of Term SOFR + the appropriate Spread Adjustment. The input manager labels will be the same so the new amounts should flow through both distrib and review sheets with no updates needed to the CAS entry.
- Finally, I’m attaching a file for reference. It contains a list of deals that are getting the footnote on one tab. The other tab lists deals that probably need the N/A because they are pulling LIBOR from input manager, but they were identified as NOT actively using the index as of June 30.
- o Please ask your managers if you have questions, and don’t hesitate to escalate to me or Theresa if you have questions that persist.
- Additional thoughts and helpful reminders
- Adjusted SOFR – The rate most deals that previously used LIBOR are transitioning to.  o    It’s the combination of the “raw” Term SOFR rate plus a spread adjustment.
- The spread adjustment is a fixed amount that will never change.o    Adjusted SOFR is populated in Rate_US0001M starting July 1, 2023
- New deals should NOT be using Rate_US0001M from input manager or the spread adjustment on its own.  Here is a quick key of the available SOFR options for new deals going forward: o    Rate_TSFR1M – 1 month Term SOFR.  o    Rate_SOFR30A – Average 30-day SOFR.
- Rate_SOFRRATE – Daily SOFR rate published by the Fed.  Using this rate is very uncommon.  Check with me if you think this is the correct rate for your new transaction.
- Please pay special attention the interest calculations and labels on reports this month and next as you’re reviewing your deals.  o I’m attaching an extract of adjusted SOFR rates during July for quick reference. o Please reach out to me or Theresa with any questions – no matter how trivial it seems.  o I’ll look to set up a couple of short huddle sessions for Q&A over the next week or two.

- Thursday, November 9, 2023	6:35 PM
- Regarding viewing prior (as in, prior to revision) versions of the report, Linda confirmed that we do indeed keep all prior versions, and they’re available in the repository. The reason you can’t see them in iManage is because we changed the repository location, so the legacy iManage isn’t accessing the current archive. We’ll definitely have the new WebUI show all the prior versions, but in the meantime, you can look for priorversions here: G:\FileRepo\Archive\[DID]\Bond\[Year]\
- The filename logic is [DID]_X_MMYYYY_Clean_ZZ.PDF
- The “X” will give you the filetype, where
- 1 = Investor Report
- 2 = Review sheet
- 7 = Support Package
- The “ZZ” will be a number
- 1 is the original version (always)
- 2 will be the first revision, 3 the next, etc

- Tuesday, February 11, 2025	1:52 PM
### When using the DMT to assign/update the Modeler, please follow these steps:
- Flag the EffectiveDt and Modeler fields on the left
- Filter by DID and AllocationType = 1
- Hit the Filter button and identify/filter the latest record - confirm by checking the EffectiveDt.  Notate the AID for that record (should be th greatest AID)
- Unflag the EffectiveDt and filter everything again like above
- Hit Modify and update the record for the applicable AID with the desired Modeler
- Note: If the EffectiveDt is pulled into the Excel file, it will fail due to the UK date format issue.  That also means you shouldn't try to insert a new record into the table because an EffectiveDt will be required and will fail.  TOS is trying to address that issue in a separate ticket.

### To protect the safety and security of the information we share with our regulators, we’re putting the following guardrails in place, effective immediately:
- You must use the OCC’s designated file-sharing platform, BankNet, to deliver documents to the OCC. Our systems will automatically remove any email attachments that you attempt to send to the OCC, and you’ll receive an automated notification reminding you to use
- their file-sharing platform. If you need assistance gaining access to or using BankNet, you can contact Regulatory Services at RegulatoryServices@usbank.com for assistance.
- In the coming days, we will provide you with additional information detailing the preferred methods for delivering documents to our other regulators including the Federal Reserve, the FDIC, and the CFPB.
- Avoid including confidential information in your emails to our regulators. Instead, use phone calls, virtual and in-person meetings and/or the agencies’ file-sharing platforms to exchange confidential and sensitive information.
- These agencies may continue to include attachments in their emails to you. Our systems scan incoming emails and attachments to identify malware, viruses and other cyber security risks.
- We appreciate your partnership and support. Feel free to forward this email to members of your teams as appropriate, and please reach out if you have any questions.

- Date Codes
- Monday, November 3, 2025	11:06 AM
- Date Calc Legend Explanation
- The date codes is a 10 character code. The first 6 characters define the base day. The last 4 characters define the adjustment to the base date.  Example: M-25BA02B+ (This code means the 25th or next BD from last month, plus two BDs)
- Base Date (first six characters)
- The first two characters specify which period to look in
- MT = Current Month
- i.	MT25BA02B+ for July 2017 = 7/27/2017
- M+ = Next Month
- i.	M+25BA02B+ for July 2017 = 8/29/2017
- M-  = Last month
- i.	M-25BA02B+ for July 2017 = 6/28/2017
- Q+ = Next Quarter (3 month period)
- i.	Q+25BA02B+ for July 2017 = 10/27/2017
- Q- = Last Quarter (3 month period)
- i.	Q-25BA02B+ for July 2017 = 4/27/2017
- S+ = Next SemiAnnual (6 month period)
- i.	S+25BA02B+ for July 2017 = 1/29/2018
- S- = Prior SemiAnnual (6 month period)
- i.	S-25BA02B+ for July 2017 = 1/27/2017
- Y+ = Next Year (12 month period)
- Y+25BA02B+ for July 2017 = 7/27/2018
- i.	Y- = Prior Year (12 month period)
- i.	Y-25BA02B+ for July 2017 = 7/27/2016
- The next two characters specify which day to start on
- 0 to 31 = Day of the month
- i.	“00” will be the last day of the month prior to the period defined above
- The next two characters specify what to do with the day specified above
- BA = If the day lands on a holiday/weekend, then returns the next Business Day
- i.	MT22BA00NA for July 2017 = 7/24/2017
- BP = If the day lands on a holiday/weekend, then returns the prior Business Day
- i.	MT22BP00NA for July 2017 = 7/21/2017
- AC = The actual day of the month, regardless of holidays or weekends
- i.	MT04AC00NA for July 2017 = 7/4/2017
- BD = The Xth (where X is defined above) business day of the month
- MT05BD00NA for July 2017 = 7/10/2017
- Note that “00” cannot be used with BD
- DD = Distribution date, as defined in the deal setup
- If “DD” (Distribution Date) is used, then Items 1) and 2) above change their behavior.
### Under item 1), all amounts except for “MT” will be multiplied by the number defined in item 2). b.	Examples:
- i.	M-02DD = The distribution date from 2 months ago
- 1. M-02DD00NA for July 2017 = 5/25/2017 ii. M-01DD = The distribution date from 1 month ago
- iii.	MT00DD = Current month’s distribution date
- When MT is used with DD, it will always be the current month distribution
- For example, MT25DD00NA, MT00DD00NA, and MT88DD00NA for July 2017 =
- 7/25/2017 iv.	M+04DD = The distribution date in 4 months
- 1.	M+02DD00NA for July 2017 = 9/25/2017
- v.	Q+03DD = The distribution date 9 months from now
- Each quarter is 3 months, 3 * 3 = 9
- Q+03DD00NA for July 2017 = 4/25/2018 vi.	Q-01DD = The distribution date from 3 months ago
- 1. Q-03DD00NA for July 2017 = 4/25/2017 vii. Y+02DD = The distribution date 2 years from now
- Y+02DD00NA for July 2017 = 7/25/2019
- Y-02DD00NA for July 2017 = 7/27/2015
- Base Date Adjuster (last four characters)
- The next two characters specify a number of days to adust the base day
- 0 to 99 = Days to adjust the base date by
- The next two characters specify what to do with the the adjusting day specified above (Note the difference between +A and A+, and -A and A-)
- NA = No Change, do not adjust the base date
- i.	MT25BA88NA for July 2017 = 7/25/2017
- B+ = The Xth Business day after the base date
- i.	MT20BA02B+ for July 2017 = 7/24/2017
- B- = The Xth Business day prior to the base date
- i.	MT20BA02B- for July 2017 = 7/18/2017
- +A = The Xth day after the base date. If the result is a holiday/weekend, then the next BD.
- i.	MT03BA02+A for July 2017 = 7/5/2017
- -A = The Xth day before the base date. If the result is a holiday/weekend, then the next BD.
- i.	MT25BA02-A for July 2017 = 7/24/2017
- +P = The Xth day after the base date. If the result is a holiday/weekend, then the prior BD.
- i.	MT27BA02+P for July 2017 = 7/28/2017
- -P = The Xth day before the base date. If the result is a holiday/weekend, then the prior BD.
- i.	MT25BA02-P for July 2017 = 7/21/2017
- A+ = The Xth day after the base date
- MT25BA02A+ for July = 7/27/2017
- i.	A- = The Xth day before the base date
- i.	MT25BA02A- for July 2017 distrib = 7/23/2017
- Sample Base Days                    Base Date
- First Calendar day of the current month            MT01AC
- First Calendar day of the prior month            M-01AC
- First BD of the current month                MT01BA
- First BD of the prior month                M-01BA
- Last BD of the current month                M+00BP
- Last BD of the prior month                MT00BP
- Last Calendar day of the current month            M+00AC
- 4th BD of the current month                MT04BD
- 4th Calendar Day of the current month            MT04AC
- 4th Calendar Day of the current month or next BD    MT04BA
- 4th Calendar day of the current month or prior BD    MT04BP
- Distribution date from 2 months ago            M-02DD
- Last Year’s distribution date                Y-01DD or M-12DD or S-02DD
- Distribution date 6 months in the future            S+01DD or M+06DD or Q+02DD
- Sample Base Day Adjuster                Base Date
- 2BDs before the base date                02B-
- 2BDs after the base date                02B+
- 2 Days (not BDs) after the base date            02A+
- 2 Days (not BDs) before the base date            02A2 Days (not BDs) after the base date. If the day falls on a holiday or weekend, then the next BD            02+A 2 Days (not BDs) before the base date. If the day falls on a holiday or weekend, then the next BD            02-A 2 Days (not BDs) after the base date. - Explanations
### Naming:
- Each validation will be a sproc, with a name that starts with spVal_ (for example, spVal_Check_PaymentID). Name the sproc appropriately, and there will be two parameters passed to the sproc, @DID and @Dt. You can write the sproc logic assuming those parameters.
- The sproc will be added to the Servicing Database
### Sproc logic:
### Validation sprocs must result in one field/column, named “Result”, with up to one row/record for the result for fails. If it’s a successful result, there should be no record (or returns nothing). For example, this sproc logic would result in a success:
- SELECT DID AS [Result] FROM tblSetup WHERE DID = ‘HelloWorld’
- This is because there will be zero records in the result.
### Example 1:
### Let’s say you wanted a sproc that results in a fail if there are any Class names that contain a “-“ symbol in tblPmtInfo for that month. You would write the sproc like this:
- --Check if there is at least one class with a dash symbol
- If Exists (Select [Class] from tblPmtInfo where DID = @DID and Dt = @Dt and Class like ‘%-%’)
- SELECT ‘At least one class contains the – symbol’ AS [Result]
- Note that this sproc is only returning a result if true. If not true, it doesn’t return anything. This will be interpreted as a successful result.
### Example 1a:
### If you wanted to be more explicit with your results, you can return a result with zero records. Using the same logic from example 1:
- --Check if there is at least one class with a dash symbol
- If EXISTS (Select [Class] from tblPmtInfo where DID = @DID and Dt = @Dt and Class like ‘%-%’)     SELECT ‘At least one class contains the – symbol’ AS [Result]
- ELSE
- SELECT DID AS [Result] FROM tblSetup WHERE DID = ‘HelloWorld’
### Example 1b:
- If you wanted to be more descriptive in your results, you can include counts or lists, but remember, the result must be one record.
- DECLARE @ClassCount Integer
- --Check if there is at least one class with a dash symbol
- Set @ClassCount = (Select Count([DID]) As [ClassCount] from tblPmtInfo where DID = @DID and Dt = @Dt and Class like ‘%-%’ Group By DID)
- If @ClassCount > 0
- SELECT Cast(@ClassCount as varchar) + ‘ class(es) contain(s) the – symbol’ AS [Result]
- ELSE
- SELECT DID AS [Result] FROM tblSetup WHERE DID = ‘HelloWorld’
- Add Validation to Library (tblWorkflowValidations)
### The validation/sproc then gets added to the library of validations. The following must be provided:
- 1) The name of the validation (this is what will be displayed in the UI as the validation name) 2) The type of validation (it will be SQL)
- 3) The name of the sproc that will have been added to the database 4) Active (= 1, for TRUE)
- 4)
- 5) IsCustomValidation = 0 (for false)
- Add Category Definitions to the validation
- (tblWorkflowValidationCategory)
- Determine the following two items. These are used to help filter the various validations when adding to a particular deal (to help the user find the appropriate validation). Neither value is used to actually “limit” the view of the validation in the UI, it’s more for query/helping to go through the list of all the validations.
- Which Dealtype this validation applies to. The available items are
- ALL (meaning applies to any deal)
- Agency
- Backup Servicing
- CMBS
- Fund Accounting
- Global Duty
- MBS
- What the validation type is (Bond, Global Duty, Fund Accounting/Collateral, Backup Servicing, Tax) the current list is
- Backup Servicing
- Bond
- Collateral
- File
- Fund Accounting
- Global Duty
- Report
- Adding the validation to workflow steps
- (tblWorkflowValidationStepSetup)
- Lastly, insert the validation to whatever workflow step(s) you want to see the validation appear as available. You define the following
- The step it gets added to
- Whether it’s a “Pre” or “Post” validation
- a. If you want it for both, you’d add the same validation twice that that workflow step 3) Whether or not it’s a mandatory validation

- Resolution
### If the Package Report step seems to be stuck, go to the Step Report > Macros tab to see which macro it seems to be stuck on:
### :
- If the SupportPackageExport_IR macro shows as "Init", that macro is stuck and there is most likely something wrong with the source files used for the Support Package
- Check the Support Package setup and manually open the files that are used in the setup
- If there is any pop-up or security issues with the file, that is the problem and the file needs to be fixed before retrying the step
- ○ If the file a .xlsm, change to .xlsx by executing Save-As, do not just change the file extension
- Similarly, if the SupportPackageExport_IR macro shows as "Success", but the ReportPackage_IR macro shows as "Init", that macro is stuck
- Manually open the distrib and any non-Crystal Report files used for the final package to ensure there are no pop-up or security issues with the files.  If there are, fix the issues before retrying.
- Note: If there any such issues, the offending file will be locked up by the cloud (ex. file is locked up because a pop-up form needs to be completed).  In such cases, post to Automation Issues Reporting channel to have TOS release the file.

- Repackage Report Logic
- Tuesday, October 3, 2023	9:35 PM
- Repackage Report step is setup in a WF.  The distrib customviews have been updated since that prior distribution.
- Resolution
- Part of the packaging macro includes creating a “snapshot” file if, and only if, the deal is going to be running the “repackage report” workflow step. The snapshot file is saved on the T drive with the filename [DID]-CVCheck_MM01YYYY.xlsx
- In order to save time, the macro will look to see if
- There already is a snapshot file for the current month
- There’s a snaphot file from the prior month
- a.	If this is true, then it will copy the snapshot file and rename it to the current month
- If either are true, then it will check if the distrib customviews changed or not.
- At this point, if everything is “good” then the snapshot file just needs to be saved. This entire process takes about 2-3 seconds.
- If, however, the snapshot file for the current or prior month is not found, OR if the customviews changed, then the macro will need to create a snapshot file from scratch. Depending on the deal, that can take a while.  A subsequent re-run of this workflow step will run much quicker as the CVCheck file has already been created.

- With the convenient and easy-to-use HID Mobile Access app, you simply open the app and hold your phone a couple of inches over the access card reader.
- Request mobile access via RightCrowd.
- Click on “Badge Requests”
- Select “New Badge”
- On the next screen, choose “Other” under “Reason for Request”
- Choose “Mobile” under “Badge Type
- ” Select ”Work” for the “Delivery Method”
- Enter your name in the “Attention” field
- Select “Submit”
- Visit Access Control and Security Technology for more information about using RightCrowd.
- After the proper approvals, you’ll receive an email from HID labeled [PARTNER EXTERNAL] and titled “Your HID Mobile Access Invitation code.” Simply follow the instructions in the email to download the app and prepare your phone. You must use the activation code in the email within 48hours
- Note: Once the app is downloaded, select “Settings” in the bottom right corner and ensure the “Nearby Readers” setting is toggled to “Off”. The rest of the app’s security settings have been preset for U.S. Bank; do not change them. Also, ignore the “Location Permission Required” message you’ll see on the screen that displays your mobile badge. If you change any other settings, you may have trouble setting up the app and/or using your mobile access card
- After you’re set up, give it try. Remember to open app to use it and then close it to ensure it receives updates and doesn’t run in the background. If you have trouble, visit our SharePoint site to make sure all your settings are correct.
- Keep your plastic badge with you in case there’s an issue with the mobile badge. You’ll still need your plastic badge at somesites. The mobile badge WILL NOT work for elevators, garages, etc., at some sites.

- Tuesday, October 21, 2025	8:13 AM
- If you have a Copilot Pro subscription and regularly attend meetings, you can use Copilot to generate meeting summaries—whether you're the organizer or a participant. Steps to follow.
- How to Enable Copilot in a Meeting
- Click the “Copilot” button during any meeting to activate it.
- Copilot will begin listening to the conversation once enabled. Side window will appear, ensure you pop the copilot chat box out.
- To Generate a Summary
- Before the meeting ends, enter the provided prompt into the Copilot chat box to request a detailed or executive-level summary. Executive summary prompt: "N:\Projects\AI CoPilot Test Projects\Meeting Summary Prompts\Exec summary prompt.docx" Detailed summary prompt: "N:\Projects\AI CoPilot Test Projects\Meeting Summary Prompts\Detailed summary prompt.docx" 99% of the time executive summary prompt provides the right level of information we usually need.
- Copilot will generate the summary in the chat.
- Use the copy button to copy the summary to your clipboard.
- Review the summary, then paste it into the meeting chat for team visibility before you end the meeting. Ending the meeting you will lose access to the Teams meeting copilot window, the summary - everything.
## Important Notes
- To prevent Copilot from listening during a meeting, simply close the Copilot chat box. If you're discussing personal topics like vacation plans, sports, or casual banter, make sure Copilot is turned off—otherwise, those details may be included in the meeting summary.
- These two prompts have been used consistently for over three months. They are reliable, repeatable, and comprehensive—proven effective across a wide range of meetings and individuals. I hope this helps.

- K:\!@RUN ME FIRST
- In case you were wondering what each routine does….
- Add Taskbar Clock Seconds – adds or removed seconds to your Windows 10 taskbar clock
- Clean_All_Setup – creates Clean_All icon at user desktop; executes iApplication_Cleaner, GSFIR_iApp_Desktop_Setup and Temp_Remove tools all at once
- GSFIR_iApp_Desktop Setup – loads the iApp application icons to your desktop, regardless of what environment you are in.
- iApplication_Cleaner – useful if the wrong version of iManage, iFactor or legacy iTax seems to open; will clear out the installation setup folder for selected application and once you reopen targeted application from your desktop icon, it will load the latest setup files to ensure application opens correctly.
- iRibbon_Load_Behavior – ensures that iRibbon/Global Macros load correctly in Excel.  (Note: if Global Macros disappear, please refer to instructions found on the GSF University Tech Tips on how to fix that)
- OneDrive Sync – forces OneDrive to sync immediately instead of waiting for regular refresh
- OneDrive_Cloud_Only – removes physical files from local or VDI machine while leaving links to the files that reside in the Cloud repository; great tool to increase your local or VDI available storage
- Prod2UAT_Folder_Copy – copies entire folder, with sub-folders and files, from Prod to UAT; name of the folder has to be exact ( tip: copy folder name you want to copy from Windows
- Explorer and paste to this utility ) o For more information how to use this tool, see this article
- ServiceZapper – closes ALL instances of Excel, iManage and PdfViewer at your workstation
- Set_XPS_DefaultPrinter - will set the default printer on your VDI to Microsoft XPS Document Writer
- Single Drive Mapper - allows you to quickly map a drive which has suddenly disappeared, such as the T: drive

### If using Teams in VDI and experiencing weird system issues, try these troubleshooting steps:
- Close all Microsoft applications (Teams, Outlook, Excel, etc.) and iApplications (iManage, iTax, etc.)
- Open Task Manager and under the Processes tab, end any processes that are still running in the background related to the above, especially Teams, Excel and possibly, PDFXCView.

- o Delete Teams temp files - https://itsmnow.service-now.com/kb_view.do?sysparm_article=KB0197399 o Run Temp_Remove.bat from K:\!@RUN ME FIRST o If this still doesn’t help, RESTART your VDI and ALL other devices that you have Teams on (laptop, phone, tablet) Desktop/Laptop Rules
- If you experience extreme slowness on your local computer during certain times of the day, TOS is actively working to resolve this issue. Note: This is unrelated to the system latency issues we have in VDI.
- TOS’s main tip is to restart your desktop and/or laptops every night and leave it at the Windows login screen.
- · Desktop users and those leaving their laptop at a U.S. Bank location overnight
- If you have a portable device such as a laptop or tablet, ensure that it is secured in compliance with ISS Workstation Management Policy (cable lock, etc.) and in its assigned docking station. Leave the lid open to ensure the device does not automatically shut down.
- Restart your workstation/device by going to Start > Log Off > Restart
- If you have a laptop, wait for the McAfee Endpoint Encryption screen to come back up and log in past the encryption before you leave for the day.
- Leave the workstation at the login screen. It will be powered ON but you will not actively be logged on to your workstation.
- · Laptop users not at a U.S. Bank location
- When possible, laptops not at a U.S. Bank location should be powered on, connected via VPN, and left at the lock screen overnight to ensure that application and security updates install properly. Leaving your workstation on the dock without a full restart, however, does not allow the updates to occur.
- Ensure the device is in a safe place and properly secured. Laptops should be left with the lid open to ensure the device does not automatically shut down.
- Restart the device.
- Sign in past the encryption screen.
- Log in to Windows.
- Do not start any applications except what is necessary to connect to U.S. Bank VPN.
- Connect to VPN following your normal procedure.
- When connected, hit ctrl-alt-del to lock the device.

- 1) Open Citrix Workspace through a browser, such as Internet Explorer - https://myworkspace.us.bank-dns.com/ - and log in as normal. 2) At the top right corner, click on setting icon -> Account settings row down next to your name and select Activate.
- You will be prompted to download a file called Workspaceconfig.cr.  Select Open.
- After you open the file, the following window will appear.  Click Add.

- After login, the Citrix Workspace window will populate with your Favorite Applications.  You may exit this screen at any time.
### On your local computer, your VDI (Citrix Workspace and GSFIR_PRD) will appear in your Windows Start Menu:
- Going forward you will be able to launch VDI directly from your Start menu or desktop if you create a shortcut for the VDI.

- Click on the drop-down arrow by your name at the top of the Citrix Workspace screen and select Refresh Apps

- After VDI Upgrades – Reset Citrix Workspace
### If your VDI was recently upgraded to Windows 10, you may have noticed that your local Citrix Workspace no longer works correctly. To reset the workspace to pull in your new VDI:
- Open Citrix Workspace from Start button – I can tell it’s old on mine because I no longer have a Win 7 VDI.
- Go to Menu > Accounts…
- Remove the AppStore account and hit OK
- Once it’s removed, close Citrix Workspace.
- Re-do all the First Time Setup steps (above) to pull in your most current Citrix account
- After Citrix Workspace Updates
- If Citrix Workspace on your USB-issued laptop is updated, you may have to log-in again 1) After logging into your laptop, click on Start > Citrix Workspace.
- The following screen will appear.  Copy and paste the following path in the server address field and click Continue: myworkspace.us.bank-dns.com
- Log in with your Preferred ID, AD/Windows password, flag the Remember my password checkbox.   Click Log On.

- Logging into a UAT machine
- Log into Citrix Receiver as you normally would to access your VDI, using your preferred ID and Active Directory (Windows) password
- Click on the Desktops tab on top and click on the “GSFIR UAT – Windows 7” icon
- A UAT VDI will load.  Although the UAT machines are named “Windows 7”, many of them have been upgraded to Windows 10.
- If it is your first time logging into one of the 10 UAT machines in our pool, it will take several minutes for it to create your profile.
- If you get an error that the machine cannot start, please report the error to GSF IR Support.  It is possible that all 10 machines are being used or they may need to be rebooted.
- UAT J: and Working with Files
- Please be patient while the machine remaps the drives to UAT drives as it may take more time for it to complete even after the mapping utility says it is done.
### If it takes more than 10 minutes for the drives to remap, you can manually map them by following these steps in the UAT machine:
- Go to \\us.bank-dns.com\NAS\pri\GSFIRAutoBack_prod (the K: drive)
- Run "K:\!@RUN ME FIRST\Special Drive Mappings\GFSIR Drives Default.bat"
- This will map the production drives
- Then run "K:\!@RUN ME FIRST\Special Drive Mappings\GSFIR_Drives_UAT.cmd"
- Check your J:, M: and T: drives to make sure they all have a UAT machine on top of each folder
- If those folders are confirmed to be UAT, you can proceed with testing.
- Note: Many of the drives in the UAT environment will remain PRODUCTION drives, except for the F:, G:, J:, M: and T: drives so please be careful when working with files.
- The surest way to confirm that you are mapped to fake F:, G:, J:, M: and T: is to check the first folder on each of the drives – it should be “!!#UAT – J – DRIVE #!#”, etc.
- Fake F:, J:, M: and T: are refreshed with Prod files every Friday at 11 PM CST.
- However, if there are folders/files that aren’t up-to-date, you can copy them from the Prod folders using K:\!@RUN ME FIRST\Prod2UAT_Folder_Copy.lnk
- o Following the command prompts, narrow down to the subfolder that you want to copy over from Prod.
- Loading the iApps
- Once logged into the UAT machine, navigate to and double-click on the K:\!@RUN ME FIRST \GSFIR_iApp_Desktop_Setup file.  The icons for the iApps will appear on the desktop.
- Note: If you get an error that "You are not logged into OneDrive", wait a few minutes and then check the Cloud status (Taskbar (by clock) > Arrow Up > Right-click on the cloud icon)
- If files from your OneDrive are listed, then OneDrive should be synced o If not, try to sign into OneDrive and wait until it syncs up
- Once synced, you can retry setting up the iApp icons
- Set Default Printer to XPS
- Double-click on the K:\!@RUN ME FIRST \Set_XPS_DefaultPrinter file
- Data Refreshes
- Data in UAT is only refreshed with current Production data when requested.  Usually, data is loaded/processed through UAT on individual deals to make them current for one-off testing purposes.  If you need all data to be updated for mass testing, please request it from GSF IR Support.

- Startup Preference
- If you like your deals ordered in a certain way, you can set your sort order permanently instead of resetting it every time you open iManage.
- Go to Action > User Startup Preference and set your Sort and/or Filter preferences.  Save and RESTART iManage.
- Going Green – Flip Screens, Display %
- You have the option to change the way the prior and current PDFs open through the Going Green Tasks form.
- ** Please reach out to Linda Mai to update your personal setting **
- By default, the current PDF opens on the left monitor and the prior PDF opens on the right monitor.
- FlipScreens will change your personal default setting to open the prior PDF/current Support on the left and the current PDF on the right.
- ForceSingleScreen will change your personal default setting to open both PDFs on one monitor if your VDI is stretched over multiple monitors.
- By default, the PDFs will open at 87% if using a single monitor and 150% on dual monitors.
- If you have a different size you prefer the files to open to, just let Linda know.
- Archive of Original Reports (Prior to Revision)
- The My Deals > Internal Files tab lists all the files that were approved through Going Green for the deal/period selected.
### • In the main screen, the most current files that went through the GG process will be listed.  If the file is listed as “True” in the Stored in Repository column, you can:
- Download Clean Copy - downloads an unmarked copy of the file to the deal’s PDF folder as {DID}_{FILE}_MMYYYY_Clean.pdf
- Download Marked Copy - download the GG check-marked copy of the file to the deal’s PDF folder as {DID}_{FILE}_MMYYYY_Marked.pdf
- • If the deal was revised, you can view any older versions of the files that were approved. (Only available after a deal is revised)
- o Open Archive will list the original files prior to the last revision. The feature allows you to download either a marked or clean version of the selected file. o In the example below, the deal was revised twice (hence 2 versions of each of the files in the Archive).
- Data Management to Query
- If you are not comfortable writing your own queries and want to look up data really quick, you can use the Data Management Tool.
- Select the Application you want to query from
- iManage = Servicing database
- iTax = SNRSUB
- iFactorGNMA =
- iFactorUSBB =
- Select the Table – not all tables are listed, but most of the helpful ones are
- Find the field(s) you want to lookup
- Filter out your deal (and any other key identifiers you have)
- Hit Filter button to get the results
- Note: Only Managers and select Senior Reviewers have access to Modify data or Insert data using this tool, but the Filter option is available for all.
### For example, if tblLoanCutoff isn’t pulling in the correct Servicer for a loan, you may want to see if there is a record in tblCutoffOverride that has the wrong Servicer listed for that loan.  In that case, I would do the following:
- FYI: tblLoanCutoffOrig + tblCutoffOverride = tblLoanCutoff, where Override takes precedent over Orig.
- Report Logic
- If a report is not generating the value you expect it to, you can review the report logic yourself.
- In the Process > Export tab, highlight the report in question
- Hit ViewReportInfo
- A form will pop-up with various information
- Report Name: starts with “rpt” – if there is a problem with the report, such as a bad column name, columns are too small, extra blank page - and you need to submit an iTracker to get it fixed, it is helpful to list the “rpt” name in the ticket to help pinpoint the exact report (but not required)
- Table Name: spRpt… - lists the sproc that drives the meat of this report
- Table Name: spRpt…Header – lists the sproc that drives the header used for the report
- You will not be able to select just the sproc name from the form.  However, all this information is automatically saved to your Clipboard.  You can open Notepad and paste the information.  From there, you can select just the sproc name, i.e. spRptComReduction.
- Use the next feature to see the sproc logic.
- Sproc Lookup
- Go to Action > Query
- Go to the Search tab and copy your sproc name in the search field.  Hit Search.
- From the results, click on the sproc name and the logic will appear in the section below.
- It’s easier to read the sproc in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) so select all (Ctrl + A) of the sproc logic, copy it (Ctrl + C) and paste it into SSMS.
- Similarly, the Search feature can be used to find all the sprocs and functions that a specific field name or table is included in.
- .

- iRibbon 3.0 Setup
- Monday, March 20, 2023	3:37 PM
- NOTE: These instructions must be followed on every machine you work on - on your local machine, VDI, UAT VDI, etc.
- First, open a new excel (no specific file, just a blank workbook)
- Confirm if a personal workbook is currently enabled, by checking VBA (Alt+F11)
- If personal workbook is not enabled, then
- hit the “Record Macro” in the Developer Tab and choose to store macro in “Personal Macro Workbook”
- Immediately stop recording. You now have a personal workbook enabled.
- In VBA, for the VBAProject (PERSONAL.XLSB), under the “ThisWorkbook” object, add the following code, save the personal workbook, and close Excel.
- Option Explicit
- Option Compare Text
- Private Const iRibbonLocation = "J:\@Application_Setup\Global Macros\Code\Globalmacro.xlam"
- Sub Workbook_open()
- Dim rslt As String On Error GoTo Failed: rslt = Application.Run(Chr(39) & iRibbonLocation & Chr(39) & "!SetEnv")
### Failed:
- End Sub
- NOTE :: Do not copy/paste the code from this document. Formatting will not be preserved which must be. Instead, copy and paste from a text file located here . The file path is N:\HR\Hiring Process\iRibbon Setup\iRibbon 3.0 VBA Code.txt
- Open Excel again (blank workbook). Confirm that a personal workbook is open, and the "GlobalMacro" xlam file is open in VBA. Under File>Options>Quick Access Toolbar select “Macros” from the pulldown, and add the macro “CallRibbon”. You can modify the macro and use an icon that’ll be easy to recognize
- Tech Tips Page 185
- modify the macro and use an icon that’ll be easy to recognize
- Functionality Changes
- You no longer hover over the macro to see a description of the macro. If you want a macro description, select the macro from the pulldown next to the Run button
- Note that the userform popup is not “built in” to excel anymore, so it’s an individual box that can be moved around the screen.
- The userform is tied to whatever screen was active when iRibbon was pulled up. So if you switch windows the userform will appear to “go away”, even through it’s active in the other window
- You can choose whether you want the form to stay open after you run a macro, or close after a macro runs
- You can choose to toggle Horizontal mode (default) or Vertical Mode
- All buttons are assignable now, there is no “user assigned” section. So you have 24 customizable buttons.

- SQL writing Tips
- Tuesday, August 8, 2023	5:06 PM
- When writing queries, it would be a good idea to add “WITH(NOLOCK)” after each table name. That helps make the queries run a lot faster, especially when something else may be slowing down the SQL server.
- Select * FROM dbo.tblSetup S WITH(NOLOCK)
- LEFT JOIN dbo.tblCompleted C WITH(NOLOCK)…

- Blocked Email - PCI False Positive
- Tuesday, April 9, 2024	8:58 AM
### There are a few things the business can do to avoid non-PCI strings from being detected as PCI. Generally, these solutions involve modifying the string so that it doesn’t match the industry PCI algorithms. A few examples include:
- Add leading zeros to the front of your number string. Leading zeros is recommended because often if the data is programmatically ingested, the leading zeros will generally be ignored.
- Try adding any characters to the front or end of the number string, to remove the “whitespace”.
- Data truncation !IMPORTANT!
- Intentionally modifying a data element that is considered sensitive to bypass detection is a violation of policy and will sub ject you to Insider Threat review and potential escalation to HR. This action will lead to disciplinary action up to and including termination.
- If you are not able to use the suggestions above, then there is one more option as long as you do not have access to PCI data. If you do not have access to PCI data, you may request the PCI False Positive entitlement <PCI False Positive US Bank or PCI False Positive Elavon>. This entitlement will require your manager’s approval and will then be reviewed by the PCI Program Team. Please reach out to the PCI Program Team (ISSPCIConsulting@usbank.com) if you have questions on this option. o If you qualify for an exception, the PCI False Positive entitlement is a temporary solution (6-9 months) and you must work to either modify the data flagging as PCI or modify your process regarding how you collaborate/communicate.
- ▪ Please work with the PCI Program Team and your PCI Coordinator on your options to modify your process/data.
- If you do have access to PCI data, and since the PCI detection rule cannot be tuned further than it already is without jeopardizing compliance due to missed detections, you must use an approved PCI solution until you can either modify the data flagging as PCI or modify your business process. Box.com or SharePoint Advanced Management
- (SAM) are the approved solutions. For more information on which solution is the best option please see the following
- site: https://usbank.sharepoint.com/teams/BoxPCI/SitePages/How-do-I-know-if-Box-or-SharePoint-SAM-should-be-used-for-sharing-PCI-files-.aspx o Additionally, if you have further questions regarding the approved PCI solutions, please reach out to the PCI Program Team (ISSPCIConsulting@usbank.com). Also, please work with your Business Line’s PCI Coordinator, listed here.

- Introduction
- Chat with IT is an easy method of communication with ITSC team about tech related issues / questions.  There have been many c hanges enacted to this platform and this brief tutorial will explain the entire process of creating a chat session.
- One of the many benefits of chatting with IT is you can pre-write your issue than paste it into a chat window which will save time in resolving your problem.
- Default chat session is AI ( artificial intelligence ) enabled.  Anything you enter will search and display relevant answers from previous interactions for other users.  The more AI is used, the better it will perform in the future.
- Some requests cannot be answered by AI thus interaction with ITSC agent is warranted.  This tutorial will help you with this aspect of a chat with IT.
- How To
- To start a chat session, go here.  Save this page in your browser bookmarks.  You can also access this link from USB Intranet / MyTech / EVA on right bottom of screen.
- •
- Chat with IT window will open.
- Outlined in blue below, on the right side of the screen, will be your incidents, service requests and trending questions.

The ques tions will always be the same so to make things simpler, create a doc with the answers and save it to your desktop (or somewhere handy) so you can easily past e the answers into your chat session.

- Logging off at the end of the day
- Wednesday, May 3, 2023	1:33 PM
- HOW TO PROPERLY LOG OFF AT THE END OF THE DAY
- To assure you are totally disconnected from the network, and that your station(s) is fully refreshed for the next day, you should restart.   Restart will refresh your memory and processor which is the best way to start the day.  The down side is the logon will take a little longer.
### First you restart your VDI and then you restart your USB computer.  Steps are the same for both:
- Same practice should be exercised when logging off UAT VDI.
- If you are experiencing Excel loading slowly - beside logging off your VDI/Computer properly, you will also have to close out any USB applications that might be running on your mobile device.
- Then it comes to your VDI, you have another option at the end of the day - Sign Out.  This option will get a new session going, however it will NOT refresh your memory and processor and they might get stale as they are retained from your previous session.  The upside is your logon will be a bit faster than if you have restarted your VDI.

- Active Directory - How to reset your AD password
- Wednesday, May 3, 2023	10:55 AM
- Note: You can no longer reset your AD password using Resetme. However, the site will list the password requirements and instructions on the best way to reset it.  Always reset your AD password from your WORKdesktop/laptop.
- Safest way to reset your password
- In office
### While the laptop or desktop is connected to the bank network directly:
- Press CTRL+ALT+DEL
- Select Change a password.
- Select the icon with the Preferred ID (US\xxxxxxx).
- Fill out the Old, New and Confirm Password fields. Click on the right arrow.
- A message will appear stating the password change is successful. Click on the OK button.
- Press CTRL+ALT+DEL and choose Lock this computer
- Press CTRL+ALT+DEL and enter the new password to unlock the computer.
- Remotely
- CANNOT be connected remotely via Citrix or MyWorkSpace
- Option 1
- On your WORK laptop, log into Pulse Secure.
- Once connected to Pulse Secure, press CTRL+ALT+DEL
- Select Change a password.
- Select the icon with the Preferred ID (US\xxxxxxx).
- Fill out the Old, New and Confirm Password fields. Click on the right arrow.
- A message will appear stating the password change is successful. Click on the OK button.
- Press CTRL+ALT+DEL and choose Lock this computer
- Press CTRL+ALT+DEL and enter the new password to unlock the computer.
- Do NOT log out of Windows or Reboot your workstation after resetting this password.  Logging out or Rebooting may result in an inability to log back into Windows.
- Log into INTERNAL Citrix / MyWorkSpace (without the PVN field) to access your VDI.
- Recommendation is to stay logged into Pulse Secure for a few hours so that your single sign-on can sync up to the new password on all the applications, websites, etc. that uses it.
- Option 2 (If you do not have your work laptop with you)
- Note: You must first be registered for SSPR in order to use this option (refer to Quick Links below)
- Make sure you are NOT logged into VDI (Citrix or MyWorkSpace)
- Log into SSPR from any browser on any device - https://passwordreset.usbank.com
- When prompted, enter in your U.S. Bank User ID (i.e., your U.S. Bank email address) and validate the random characters.
- You will be presented with two (2) options. To reset your password, select the first option: I forgot my password.
- Choose Email my alternate email and select Email.
- You will receive the following email (at the personal email address you provided).
- Enter the verification code where prompted.
- Proceed with mobile phone verification. You can choose to have a text sent to your mobile phone or receive a phone call. You must enter the same mobile phone number that you provided during SSPR registration.
- You will receive a text message or call to your mobile phone containing a verification code.
- Enter your new password.
- Your password has been reset. You can now log in. A password reset confirmation email will be sent to your personal email AND U.S. Bank email.
- If the next time you access your work laptop/desktop is in the office while it’s connected to the bank’s internal network, it should be able to log onto the machine with your new Windows/AD password.
### IMPORTANT!!!  If you bring home your work laptop/desktop (without first doing step #12 above) after resetting your password, you must do the following:
- Select CTRL-ALT-DELETE on your keyboard > change a password.
- Enter your old password and new password where prompted to update the information cached (i.e., saved) on your machine. o You can now log in with your new Windows/AD password.

- Windows Explorer Restore Files and Folders
- Wednesday, May 3, 2023	1:44 PM
- How to Restore Files/Folders
- If a file/folder is accidentally deleted or moved, you can restore a previous version of the file using Windows Explorer.  Please keep in mind that this feature only retains versions from the previous 30 days.
- In the below example, we will restore a deal folder from the M: drive.
- Open Windows Explorer
- Find the M: drive path and right-click on it
- Select Properties
- Go to the Previous Versions tab and find a version of the M: drive that has the deal folder you are looking for by clicking Open on different dates’ versions of the drive.
- NOTE: Please NEVER hit the Restore… button as that will overwrite all current files/folders in the M: drive for every deal.
- Once you find the deal folder you are looking for, COPY the deal folder using Ctrl+C or right-click > Copy
- PASTE the copied folder to the normal/current M: drive.
- Similarly, to restore a file, simply navigate to the file’s parent folder and find a previous version of the folder with the file you want to restore and copy it from the previous version and paste it into the current version of the parent folder.
- Note: If the folder is not in the Previous Versions, try looking inside the folders around where it would have been.  The folder could have been accidentally moved into a neighboring folder.

- USB Device Read Permissions & Wired Print Device Entitlements
- Thursday, March 20, 2025	8:44 AM
- Starting March 20, 2025, there will be changes to the entitlements required for reading contents on Portable Electronic Media (PEM) storage devices and connecting wired print devices. These changes aim to enhance security and manage access more effectively. Impact on Users
### Read Only USB:
- Users will no longer be able to plug in USB devices and read contents without an entitlement.
- Users with existing read/write USB PEM entitlements will be unimpacted.
- Read Only USB permissions will require Manager approval.
### Wired Print Device:
- Users will no longer be able to connect wired print devices to their computer to print from home.
- Access to print at home will require Manager and Risk Manager approval.
- Action Required
- Users who need to read contents from USB storage devices must request the USB Read Only Entitlement.
- Users who need to connect wired print devices must request the Print Device Entitlement.
- For instructions on how to request an entitlement click here.
- New Entitlements
### USB Read Only Entitlement (one for USB users, another for Elavon):
- PEM USB External Drive Read Microsoft Intune PROD
- Elavon EU PEM USB Read Microsoft Intune PROD
### Print Device Entitlement (one for USB users, another for Elavon):
- PEM USB Print Device Microsoft Intune PROD
- Elavon PEM USB Print Device Microsoft Intune PROD
- For information regarding file uploads to Portable Electronic Media devices, visit the DataSecurity/ site.

- PVN = 4 digit Personal Verification Number from Setting up Entrust, Step 14

- Decrypt Files
- Thursday, December 4, 2025	4:03 PM
- From meeting with Ilya, Matt D. and Mike G. on 12/04/2025
## Key Topics:
- · Introduction: Ilya and Matthew discussed the decryption of data files and the challenges they are facing with the current software. They explored alternative solutions and potential workarounds to ensure the decryption process works smoothly.
- · Decryption Software: Ilya and Matthew discussed the decryption software options available, including the transition from GPG to Cleopatra. They explored the installation and functionality of Cleopatra and attempted to modify scripts to work with the new software.
- ·
- · Passphrase Issue: Ilya and Matthew encountered issues with the passphrase required for decryption. They tried different methods to input the passphrase, including using KeyPass and hardcoding the passphrase in a batch file.
- · Command Line Utility: Ilya and Matthew explored the command line utility for Cleopatra to automate the decryption process. They attempted to find the correct parameters and options to make the decryption work without manual passphrase input.
- · Cleopatra Installation: Ilya and Matthew located the installation folder for Cleopatra and attempted to use the command line options to decrypt files. They faced challenges with the command line switches and the software's response.
### Action Items:
### Decryption Software:
### · Share the screen and show the installed Cleopatra software to Ilya. (Matthew) Passphrase Issue:
### · Enter the passphrase provided by Ilya into the decryption software. (Matthew) Command Line Utility:
### · Modify the decrypt batch file to include the passphrase directly and test the decryption process. (Matthew) Cleopatra Installation:
- · Locate the installation folder for Cleopatra and verify the command line options available. (Matthew)

- Tuesday, August 8, 2023	5:08 PM
- When writing queries, it would be a good idea to add “WITH(NOLOCK)” after each table name. That helps make the queries run a lot faster, especially when something else may be slowing down the SQL server.
- Select * FROM dbo.tblSetup S WITH(NOLOCK)
- LEFT JOIN dbo.tblCompleted C WITH(NOLOCK)…

- ○ Questions from rating agencies, insurers, investors (including counsel to investors).
- ○ Questions about the administration of a waterfall over multiple periods, how/why particular amounts are calculated, U.S. Bank’s “general practices”, or questions resulting in extended communication / follow-up questions.
- ○ Inquiries related to any: Article 77 proceeding, settlement, terminated deal purchase price, deferred principal, forbearance, excess cashflow, retired/zero-balance class, writedowns/ups, loss allocations, certificate insurance.
- Some questions can start out simple enough and not need escalated handling. But if there continues to be back and forth, that would be a time to elevate to Nick and Kim. And, in writing, remember to always be factual and specific to the deal in question, never providing opinions or generalizations

- Web iManage Version 1.1.4.0 - Tax Workflow (Release Date: 10/7/2025)
- Thursday, October 2, 2025	11:49 PM
- Tax Portfolio View
- A new section dedicated to tax processing and signoffs has been added to web iManage called Tax Portfolio View.  With this first release, the tax team will be able to easily see the status of their deals, similarly to how the data is presented in the Tax Processing screens in legacy iManage. In addition, users will have much more convenient access to reports, files and folders to help with their troubleshooting.  Note: actual signoffs and processing will be integrated in the next releases.
- iAgent
- What it is
- With the web iManage residing on the cloud, we must restrict the way files and folders are open
- Instead of allowing files to be opened directly, a secure file-opening “iAgent” is used to open the files/folders for those who have access
- Please refer to a separate email from Rudy with instructions on how to set up the iAgent on your VDI
- Once iAgent is running, it will automatically open web iManage for you and you can proceed from there
- When selecting to open, lock or unlock a file in web iManage, the request will be sent to the iAgent and a message will appear on the bottom right corner of your screen with the description of the action.  This message will auto-close after 10 seconds of completion of the action.
- If you work in web iManage without the iAgent running, the following banner will appear on every screen – “PROD Local agent not found so related features (distrib loc/unlock file/folder opening) will be unavailable…”
- iAgent Options
- Once the iAgent is running, a purple “M” icon will appear in the tray for your taskbar (click on the up arrow on the left of the date/time)
- Right-click on the “M” icon to see different options o Open iManage – opens web iManage in a new browser window. Convenient if you had previously closed the web and need to reopen it. o View Log – useful for troubleshooting purposes.  TOS may ask that you provide this information if you run into issues related to iAgent and its functionality.
- Reconnect – after long idle periods, iAgent may disconnect and you may start to get a “Local agent not found so related features (distrib loc/unlock file/folder opening) will be unavailable.” message.  Use this option to reconnect the iAgent to be able to open files/folders again.
- Exit – closes iAgent.  If closed, you will have to run the desktop icon to reopen it.
- Color coding – on the top right of the “M” icon, a green circle shows that the iAgent is connected whereas a red circle shows that it is disconnected and files/folders will not open
- Tax Ribbon
- Accessing the ribbon
- Specific Deal
- To access the tax ribbon for a specific deal, first Search for the deal and select the applicable deal from the search results
- The deal’s bond ribbon will load.  Although the menu options are similar, to access the tax-specific options, you will want to switch to the tax ribbon.
- Click on the Tax portfolio view option on the main left navigation panel and then the tax ribbon will load • The tax ribbon is distinguished by a purple “Tax” tag
- From Grid
- • While managing your workload in the Incomplete deal, Annual view, WHFIT or Completed deals tabs, you can simply click on any deal row and its ribbon will load
- Deal (for non-iFactor deals)
- Distrib tag, ex. “Distrib locked” in green – the bond distrib status will appear on the top of the ribbon.  Please note that it does not automatically refresh if the status changes while you are on the deal.  Use the browser refresh button to see the latest distrib status.
- Tax Distrib - opens the "T:/TAX/{DID}/Distrib_iTax.xlsm" file, if applicable
- Bond
- Open – opens the bond distrib file from the J: folder o Tracing – opens the bond distrib, semi-unprotected, to allow for tracing.  Although it seems to allow you to make edits, hitting save does not save the changes.
- Lock – similar to how the lock feature works in legacy iManage, it will open the distrib to record the change history before unsharing and locking the distrib up ▪ If changes detected, the Locking form will pop-up for you to fill out
- Unlock – this feature is unique in that it checks to see if a bond workflow is running on the deal before allowing a tax analyst from unlocking the distrib
- If the bond workflow is not running or if it is, but still prior to the Prepare Distrib workflow step, Unlock will be enabled and tax analysts will be allowed to unlock the distrib
- However, if a bond workflow is running and it’s already past the Prepare Distrib step, the Unlock option will be disabled

- General Grid Features
- The grid used through the web version of iManage has many convenient features.
- Grid top ribbon
- Export – exports the grid into an Excel file that you can access through your local Downloaded folder
- Autofit columns - applies the minimum possible width for all columns, so that all text fits without wrapping
- Column selector – allows user to select which columns they want to see, including optional fields that are not shown by default o Tip: Once done with your selections, click out of the box for the changes to be applied
- Settings – more on that below
- Clear filters – quickly clears all filters o Tip: Remember this icon when working in the WHFIT TAB
- Refresh – refreshes all the data in the grid
- Column header filter and sorting
- To the right of each header is a kebab menu icon from which you can access the different filter and sorting features.
- Filter by checklist – the first tab lists all the values found in the column and allows users to select deals via a checklist • Filter by conditions – allows users to filter the results by certain conditions
- Sorting and more – allows users to apply different options to the column
- o Note: You can always sort the results of a column alphabetically (descending or ascending) by simply clicking on the header name
- Search and grouping
- The easiest way to find a deal is to use the Search feature
- Grouping – in the row immediately below the grid Search/ribbon is where you can pull in the field(s) that you want to group your data by o Simply drag the column header name that you want to group by into that empty row o The grouped data can then be collapsed and expanded as desired
- In the Setting icon in the grid ribbon, you can choose to hide the grouping row if you don’t want to use it or want to save real estate on your screen
- VIPR-related Fixes (Release Date: 9/4/2025)
- Wednesday, September 3, 2025	1:24 PM
- Setup/Processing
- Deal Contacts Not Updating
- The bug that prevented deal contacts (Account Administrator, Cash Analyst and Relationship Manager) from automatically getting updated in iManage to match VIPR has been fixed
### If contacts don’t seem to be updating correctly, a few tips:
- Ensure the contacts are setup in VIPR correctly
- Ensure the deal is flagged with the GSFIR account dimension in VIPR o Ensure that U.S. Bank Trust, N.A. is associated with the deal
- Ensure that the contact is setup in iManage Contacts > Contact (ex. new AA) o If all those are confirmed, the contact should get updated by the end of the day via a scheduled job
- Approval / Workflow
- Review Class Payment Emails
- When payments are approved (Reviewer or Looksee Signoffs), if iManage detects that payment is calculated to classes that are not setup in VIPR, an email notification will be sent to the deal teams (or shelf SMEs), Account Administrator and Cash Analyst to reconcile
### Common reasons:
- o Class names don’t match exactly o Class is no longer active in STA/VIPR o Class is not paid through VIPR – if true, flag the class as VIPRException in tblCertInfo
- Reports Not Sweeping at Deliver Final Reports
- There have been various instances where reports were not sent at the Deliver Final Reports workflow step
- TOS identified that if multiple files are setup after workflow had already started, then only the first file would get sent, so they fixed that bug
- Other causes are still unknown so if you encounter this problem, please report it on Teams
## iManage Release Notes Page 333
- immediately so TOS can troubleshoot in real-time
- Version 7.0.4.4 (Release Date: 8/7/2025)
- Thursday, August 7, 2025	4:09 PM
- Setup/Processing
- Update Deal Setup -> Workflow restrictions
- Workflow template setup changes are now open to all elevated roles
- Note: new users with only Processor rights are still restricted from making template changes
- Approval / Workflow
- Change VIPR Check Logic During Signoffs
- Signoffs will no longer fail if the selected deal does exist in tblVIPRData (if the VIPR setting is enabled)
- If the check fails, an email notification to the Account Administrator and Cash Analyst will be triggered instead
- If they have questions about the email, please let them know that since the deal was not correctly setup in VIPR yet, payments will not automatically load into VIPR.  They should work with their manager to ensure that the deal is setup correctly by the next distribution.
- Update to Revision Process for VIPR
- Previously, iManage would automatically pull back the payments from VIPR whenever a deal is reverted or revised, whether or not payments changed.  Unfortunately, this caused a lot of problems for the Cash Analyst, especially if payments didn’t change.
- The new logic is to pull back the payments if the deal is reverted or revised PRIOR TO payment date
- If reverting/revising ON OR AFTER payment date, iManage will check to see if payments actually changed (after payment approval) o Only if payments change will it pull back the payments and then send the revised payments to VIPR
## iManage Release Notes Page 335
- Version 7.0.4.3 (Release Date: 6/5/2025)
- Wednesday, June 4, 2025	5:34 PM
- Setup/Processing
- Automatic Internal Contacts Update Logic
- Using our direct connection to VIPR data, deal contacts will now automatically be updated in iManage daily
- If the Account Administrator or Cash Analyst assigned to your deal is incorrect, ask the Cash Analyst to correct the Role Assignment(s) in VIPR
- The update should be reflected in iManage the next day
- If it can’t wait, you can still update the contact(s) manually, but they will get overwritten the next day if VIPR was not changed
- Edit Mode Impact on Legacy iManage
- As more features on the web UI become available for pilot testing, there is a need to ensure that changes made there does not interfere with attempted changes in the legacy application at the same time
### Therefore, as you are processing in the legacy application, you may get the following type of message which means you will not be able to do anything with the deal until the other person working on your deal is done with their edits in the web application:
- Restrict Import to Shared Drives
- To comply with the bank’s policies, files may only be imported if they reside on a whitelisted shared drive o As a best practice, data files should be saved on the M: drive
### If you attempt to import a file from a location that was not whitelisted, you will get the following error:
- Create Trigger for tblCutoffOverride
- As part of the ongoing efforts to improve performance and prevent database blocking, TOS implemented an automatic consolidation of all tblCutoffOverride records for any given loan at the time of table insertion or update
- The result should be quicker calculations during Process Data, especially for deals with a lot of tblCutoffOverride records for their loans
- Note: The Loan Setup Detail pop-up when you double-click on a loan in the Maintenance >
- Loan Setup screen has been disabled to prevent bad data o If you need to update tblCutoffOverride data, please reach out to your manager for help
- Import of Line Items Timing Out
- When trying to import Line Items PRIOR to Process Data, some deals were timing out because the system was trying to figure out cutoff data for the current period
- With the above changes made to tblCutoffOverride, the cutoff data is now readily available at the time of import and so it no longer times out
- spExportLoanLevel Execution Timeout
- The timeout threshold was extended so prevent the export of the Loan Level CSV from timing out for deals with a lot of loans
- Data Disappearing from tblSetup
- The bug that was wiping out the deal’s Currency Code in tblSetup has been fixed
- Approval / Workflow
- Unlock for Shelf Deals
- The bug with the last release that denied those with elevated rights (Managers and above) to unlock shelf-allocated deals has now been fixed
- Change Payment Import Logic
