- Version 7.0.2.4 (Release Date: 10/5/2023)
- Thursday, October 5, 2023	5:57 PM
- Setup
- Access for Workflow Template
- • Additional users with “EditWorkflowTemplate” rights are now able to set/change the workflow template for deals in the Deal Setup > Processing > Workflow tab • Senior Managers must submit an iTracker to request the rights for the additional users
- Step Check at File Setup
- A workflow check has been added to the Deal Setup > Files tab.
### If you try to make the following changes while the deal’s workflow is running, you will be reminded that you must stop the workflow in order to make any setup changes:
- Add > Insert and Add buttons o Modify > Insert and Add buttons
- Delete button o Active checkbox
### If you try to make file setup changes on a deal that has an outstanding workflow (not in progress, but also not complete yet), you will get a warning that your signoffs will be wiped out if you continue with the setup change:
- If you confirm to continue, the outstanding workflow will revert back to the Process Distrib step
- Note: Please ignore the Workflow DateCode field in the automation setup tab.  That is a future feature to look forward to.
- Processing
- Loan Accounting Exceptions
- Loan/Fund Accounting deals oftentimes have to import into certain tables after the deal is already complete.  This data doesn't affect tblLoanMonthly or affect reporting, so we are no longer requiring the deal to be revised in order delete/import into these specific tables and are no longer updating the processing status if the deal has already been finalized.
- Exception tables: tblLoanPrice, tblServAdvance, tblLoanSale, tblLoanTransfer, tblLoanPurchase
- However, if you try to import into any other table after the deal is done, you will be advised that you must revise the deal first
- Approval / Workflow
- Shelf View in My Deals: Missing Shelf
- Bug that prevented deals from displaying in the Shelf View if the user is a member of multiple shelves has been fixed
### You should now see all the shelf allocated deals of which you are a member of:
- Termination Form Triggered When Shouldn’t
- The bug that caused the Termination Form to pop when a deal isn’t fully paying down has been fixed
- For example, if one class is paying down, but the other classes are still active, the form will no longer pop
- Add Termination Form to Processor Signoff
- In a previous build, the Termination Form had been removed from all signoff steps, except for the Package Report step
- However, if a deal doesn’t have the Package Report step enabled, the form would never get triggered and users had to hit the Final Payment button to bring up the form • Now, if the Package Report step is not enabled, the termination check will occur on the Signoff – Processor step
- Support and Final Package Enhancements
- External PDF File Page Check
- Both the Support Package and Final Package generations have been enhanced to verify that the pages setup by deal teams for an external PDF file actually exists before merging those pages into the package
- Ex. If setup lists pages 1-5, but source file only has pages 1-2, the system will simply pull in the first two pages.
- However, if setup lists pages 5-9, but source file only has pages 1-2, the step will fail stating: "Page(s) 5-9 does not exist in {file name}.  Please correct Support Package setup."
- Duplicate Pages
- The Final Package process has also been updated (similar to what was previously done for Support Package) to prevent duplicate pages from generating
- "ValidatePackage" API
- A  page check has been added to the Package and Repackage Report steps that will attempt to find any individual page within the final report that may be blank
- If a blank page is identified, it will result in a failed post-validation o A new mandatory post-validation called “Validate Blank Page” has been added both step
- If the blank page is not expected, o If the page is a Crystal Report, revert back to the Generate Auto Report step and rerun the workflow from that point on o If the page is a distrib custom view, revert back to the Package/Repackage Report step and rerun the step fresh
- If the blank page is expected, you can override the post validation fail
- IMPORTANT! The validation may pass even if the report seems to have a blank page IF a custom view has headers/data in white font.  This is common in many old deals so please still check manually and if the validation passed, then review the custom view and delete any white texts.
- Revert Not Clearing Going Green Files
- Previously, if the Check Report – Processor step is completed, but then the workflow reverted, when redoing the step, the old final package would still pull upas “Current” o Users would have to hit the Reset button in the task form in order to pull up the latest package
- This bug has been fixed and whenever the Check Report steps are rerun, the latest package will pull up as “Current”
- Fix Going Green Logic for Prior Period's Files
- Deals that must be repackaged AFTER Signoff – Reviewer, such as CMBS or next index rate deals, are allowed to go through without redoing the Check Report steps
- However, when going through the Check Report steps for the next period, the system is pulling in the reports without the SS comments or next index rates
- The Check Report steps have been updated to pull in the latest package for the “Prior” periods, i.e. the reports with the SS comments or next rates populated
- Ex. This will help deal teams confirm that the current rates are what were reported to be the next rates last period
- Deliver Final Reports Check
- The Deliver Final Reports step was previously missing the Input Manager checks that exists in legacy Send logic
- The step has now been updated to catch if there are blank inputs
- Missing records in tblrevisionhistory
- A bug that prevented iManage from correctly inserting revisions for every period into tblRevisionHistory when there are multi-period restatements has been fixed
- Previously, the comments section could only handle 255 characters and if users tried to add more, it will fail behind the scenes and prevent the records from being added
- Now, the UI will accept up to 800 characters in the comments field (truncating any characters past that) which will ensure nomore fails afterwards
- IREM Enhancements
- Step and Status Mismatch
- Bug that caused IREM to display workflow Step Status that didn’t match the Curent Step has been fixed
- Ex. The Step Status of “Delivered” should only be displayed for workflows that are complete and not tied to any step, such as Review Final Statement
- iManage for Tax
- Add R holder transfer indication for quarterly view of tax (SnrSub and USBBPROD)
- In the Tax Processing > Quarterly screen, a RTransfer column has been added to indicate if a holder transfer occurred for the selected quarter.
- If the transfer occurred at the quarter end, the cell will be highlighted in pink on both the top and bottom grids
- Miscellaneous
- Automatic Retries
- For deals running in Cloud Automation mode, if the queue fails due to "The remote server returned an error: (503) Service Unavailable", the workflow engine will retry the step after 3 minutes  o If the service is back up and step completes, the user will never know that it had failed  o However, if it is still down, the workflow engine will auto-retry the step at the 6 minutes mark.  If the service is back up and steps complete, the user will never know that it had failed.
- Only after the second retry will the fail be passed for the step
- If the API service is truly down, step will fail with the instruction to try again in 10 minutes
- ▪ API services should automatically restart so within 10 minutes, they should be back up.  If it still fails, it could be that the auto restart is failing for whatever reason and TOS must manually restart the service.
- Similarly, if an Excel request fails due to "The RPC server is unavailable", the workflow engine will automatically retry theExcel action that the RPC error occurred on after 30 seconds o If it fails again with the same error, the step will fail with message of "The RPC server is unavailable.  Please try again i n 10 minutes.  If it still doesn't work, contact TOS."
- Various Excel Processing Enhancements
### As part of a continued effort to improve Excel processing times during automation, the following enhancements were made:
- Use of already opened Excel instances instead of opening a new instance for each new request
- Improved utilization of the iRibbon – use of the xlam file locally, setting database server and mapped drives more efficiently
- Increased timeout threshold to avoid false fails.  Many times when steps fail due to “Unable to process macro due to services down”, in reality, the macros do complete without issue.  • We should also no longer get “Error while updating workflow sub step status” errors
- Report Generation Enhancements
- We are now tracking how long it takes to generate each page of the report (at the Generate Auto Reports step) in tblWorkFlowReportProcessPeriodic o This will help TOS identify report sprocs that are taking too long and should be optimized
- In addition, if a page fails to generate correctly, the Generate Auto Reports step will fail instead of continuing to generate the rest of the package components to save time/resources
- Automate Monthly Ratings Pull
- Starting November 2023, bond/CUSIP ratings for Standard & Poor’s, Fitch and Moody’s will systematically be pulled via an automatic job on the 1st of every month
- Up until now, this pull was done by certain individuals with access, but if they were out of office or forgot to import the ratings, there would be a scramble to find someone else who could pull the ratings
- Upgrade SSIS to 2017
- A new version of the software that we use to import SSIS packages has was released and iManage has been updated to work with the new version
- Please be on the lookout for an email from Rudy with further details of how this rollout will be handled
- Version 7.0.2.3 (Release Date: 9/6/2023)
- Monday, September 11, 2023	11:40 AM
- Setup
- Input Manager Enhancement
- Previously, when a field was set to Repeat Prior and users entered an amount for one month, they had to remember to take the repeat prior off or to reset to the previous amount
- Input Manager was enhanced to use a default amount unless users manually input an amount for a certain month.
- Default amounts must be populated via the DMT – tblInputDealSetup
- Note: for any single input, you can’t use “Repeat Prior” and a default value, you can only use one or the other (or neither)
- New Validations
- Based on business line suggestions, new validations have been added to the library for additional checks during automation.  If you have an idea for a new validation, please feel free to post your idea to the Automation-Validations channel.  The validation team will review and submit the request if they agree.
- Missing Index Rate Validation
- As deals get closer to full automation, there is a risk that deals that need next rates can go through with the next rates being blank on the report
- Using the existing next index rate logic setup in Input Manager, this new validation calculates the index date for the given deal and queries tblIndexRates to ensure that the rate for that specific date has been loaded
- This check is not mandatory, but available as an optional validation for all deals to be enabled as: o Pre-validation on the Reprocess Distrib step o Pre-validation on the Repackage Report step o Pre-validation on the Deliver Final Reports step
- Missing Special Servicer Comments Validation
- Specific to CMBS deals, if the deal has an active special-serviced loan, this validation will check to make sure that the special servicer comments had been loaded for that loan for the current period
### This check is not mandatory, but available as an optional validation to be enabled as:
- Post-validation on the Signoff Reviewer step
- Pre-validation on the Reprocess Supplemental Reports step o Post-validation on the Reprocess Supplemental Reports step o Pre-validation on the Repackage Report step
- Missing Modification Comments Validation
- Specific to CMBS deals, if the deal has an active modified loan, this validation will check to make sure that the modification comments had been loaded for that loan for the current period
### This check is not mandatory, but available as an optional validation to be enabled as:
- Post-validation on the Signoff Reviewer step
- Pre-validation on the Reprocess Supplemental Reports step o Post-validation on the Reprocess Supplemental Reports step o Pre-validation on the Repackage Report step
- Missing Agency Breach Review Validation
- If enabled on a deal, this validation will check to make sure there are records in vwAgencyBreachReview for the current period
### This check is not mandatory, but available as an optional validation to be enabled as:
- Post-validation on the Signoff Reviewer step
- Pre-validation on the Reprocess Supplemental Reports step o Post-validation on the Reprocess Supplemental Reports step o Pre-validation on the Repackage Report step
- Deal Termination Check Validation
- If a deal is flagged as terminating, this validation will fail and force Reviewers to confirm that the deal is actually terminating and the footnote information for withheld funds is accurate
- It is a new mandatory Pre-Validation on the Signoff-Reviewer step for all deals
### At the Package Report workflow step, if the Processor (or prior shelf member) had marked the Termination Form as Yes for terminating – this validation will fail:
- Once Reviewer has confirmed the termination and footnote information, they would override the fail so the workflow can resume
- If the deal is not terminating or the footnote information is incorrect, deal should be reverted back to the appropriate step to reprocess/repackage
- Allocations
- Revamp Current Allocations UI
- The Current Allocations screen has been revamped to display the full list of deals (based on the allocation type selected from the dropdown), regardless of whether or not the deal is automated o The Automated / Non-Automated radial buttons on top have been replaced by a new column in the grid view
- Users can flag multiple deals and based on whether the deal is automated or not, the system is able to determine which rules to apply per deal
- It is no longer disabling the allocation type dropdown
### If user is making allocation updates for multiple deals at once, this warning should only pop once, instead of popping for each deal:
### If user is making allocation updates for just one deal, will get this pop-up:
- However, if user is making allocation updates for multiple deals at once, instead of this pop-up appearing for each deal selected, they will get one summary message that states the number of deals that were updated
- If any allocations fail, summary message will state the number of deals that failed o “List copied to clipboard” means that the details of which deals failed were automatically copied to your local clipboard
- ▪ You can immediately paste (Ctrl+V) into Notepad to see which deals failed and why
- Processing
- Automation for deals with no active loans
- There are deals with no active loans for the period, i.e. nothing to import, process, or accept
- However, they still need to Auto Report to generate reports (files that show all zeros), which would fail due to “missing” data
- The Generate Auto Reports logic has been updated to account for these deals that have no data in tblLoanMonthly
- With this update, deal teams should no longer set the status of the deal to “Locked” to trick the system
- Note: If the collateral does not need to be processed through iManage, consider unflagging the iServ checkbox in Deal Setup.
- Accept Data for Loan Accounting Tables
- Loan/Fund Accounting deals often require data to be imported even after the deal is already complete
- Since this data doesn't affect tblLoanMonthly or affect reporting, an exception was added to the Import and Load buttons on the Data-Actions > Process > Import screen for the following import tables: o tblLoanPrice, tblServAdvance, tblLoanSale, tblLoanTransfer, tblLoanPurchase
- As such, if data is imported into any of these tables, the status of the deal will NOT change.
- There will be no need to hit Accept Data to get the status back to Finalized.
- RPC Error at Ad-Hoc Process/Accept Data - Switch Files to
- CSV
- For deals that are still processed outside of the automation workflow, there was an increased number of fails due to “RPC server is unavailable” o This is the same error that users often get when trying to open Excel files from iManage
- To avoid this error, if a Mismatched Loan file is triggered during Process, iManage will now generate the file as a .csv (bypassing Excel altogether)
- Similarly, if a PaidoffCodeViolation file is triggered during Accept Data, iManage will now generate the file as a .csv
- Approval / Workflow
- Termination Form
- For automated deals, the Termination Form has been removed from the Processor, Reviewer and Looksee Signoff steps
### The form will now only pop at the Package Report step based on these checks:
- If sum of bond balances go down to zero in tblPmtInfo (payment range) OR o If pool balances go down to zero in the remittance summary
- If the termination is not confirmed yet, hitting Cancel will cancel the Package Report step and workflow will not proceed.
- As mentioned above, if the form is triggered, at Reviewer Signoff, the Deal Termination Check
- Validation pre-validation will fail so the Reviewer can confirm that everything is correct
- Import Tax Range - Enhance to Accommodate Different Column Order

- The import has now been updated to handle different column orders
- Deal Revision Form Enhancement
- The Deal Revision form has been enhanced with a new field/checkbox called "Repost Only" that is only visible/accessible by Senior Managers
- If a deal needs to be revised just so the report can be reposted, Senior Managers can flag this checkbox when revising the deal
- If it is flagged, the Senior Manager must add a comment as to what happened with the deal to require a repost
- If you believe your deal revision qualifies for this, please reach out to your Senior Manager to revise the deal for you as you/your manager will not see this field
- Duplicate Deals in Shelf View
- Bug that caused shelf-allocated deals to be listed twice in the My Deals screen for some users has been fixed

- The logic has been enhanced to handle case differences of file paths

- IREM Enhancements
- Collapsible Filters
- The IREM Filters has been condensed towards the top of the screen and can be collapsed to allow for more space for the results
### Collapsed view:
- Step Status Filter
- An option to “Exclude Delivered” was added to the Step Status filter
- Sort by Payment or Due Dates
- Results can be sorted by Payment or Due Dates by default via the Sort By filter
- Columns for Payment Date and Due Date have also been added to the grid results (very right)
- Updated iManage Exception Form
- When clicking on the Exception Details hyperlink, the iManage Exception form that opens should look cleaner
- The Date is now just a simple short date

- As part of the Support Package setup, users have the option to choose which specific page of a pdf file should be used (if they don't want the entire pdf file)
- That page selection was being ignored during creation/merge of the Support Package (for automated deals during the Package Report step o Automation packaging was pulling the entire pdf for each file, instead of just one page of each file. o This bug has now been fixed
- Move Selective File Delivery Form
- For automated deals only, if Deal Setup > Other Settings 'Selective Report Delivery' is enabled on the deal, the Selective Delivery user form will now pop at Begin Workflow instead of at the Deliver Final Reports workflow step o Therefore, you may select which reports to deliver at beginning of the workflow and if all the workflow steps complete succes sfully, you could run these deals all the way through automation without any further stops
### At Begin Workflow, if setting enabled and workflow is run in:
- Manual and Local Automation mode - user form will pop before any other sub-steps are run o If step is run in Cloud Automation, step will fail due to user form that needs to be completed
- However, if the deal is revised, the form will pop at Deliver Final Reports step.

- Note: For non-automated deals, the form will still only pop at Send
- Remove Pre-Condition Pop-Up
- If workflow is currently stopped at a step due to a precondition, if you manually click on the step, you will no longer received a pop-up
- Manual Mode - If at step that has a pre-condition that hasn't been met yet, the step will fail, but you will not get a corresponding pop-up o The workflow status form will indicate that pre-condition has not been met
- After that fail, if you click the main button again, it will run the step (because it now knows that you are intentionally ru nning the step knowing that the pre-condition hasn't been met).
- If you revert back to a step that has a pre-condition, it will redo the check and fail again
- Local Automation Mode - Workflow will run through the steps until it hits a step with a pre-condition.  At that point, the step will fail if the date/time hasn't been met, but you will no longer receive the corresponding pop-up o After that fail, if you click the main button again, it will run the step (because it now knows that you are intentionally ru nning the step knowing that the pre-condition hasn't been met).
- Cloud Automation Mode - Workflow will run through the steps until it hits a step with a pre-condition.  The step will fail if the date/time hasn't been met.  You will then have to switch to Manual or Local Automation mode if you want to bypass the check.
- Fix Review PDF Archive Logic
- There was a bug at the Archive Reports step that directed iManage to look for the Review Sheet PDF in the T:/ISERV/{dealfolder}, which doesn’t exist for many deals so it was failing to archive the file in the repository
- The logic has been fixed and now it will look for the Review Sheet PDF in the T:/ISERV/{DID} folder
- Enhance Archive Report Logic
- The Archive Reports step was previously only archiving the Final Package that was reviewed during the Check Report steps
- The logic has been enhanced for deals that repackage after Reviewer Signoff (ex. for next LIBOR)
- Now it will check to see if the Modified Date/Time has changed since the last archived file (for the same period) o If the Modified Date/Time of the Final Package is greater than the last archived file, it archive the newest repackaged versi on o That new version will be presented in the Check Report steps as the Previous Package in the next period
- Extreme Slowness in Automation
- Both TOS and management is aware of the increasing processing time for automation.  TOS implemented several things that will hopefully improve the performance.
- Transfer of Logs Back to J: Drive
- In an effort to keep the J: drive lean, TOS had moved automation logs to the M: drive about two months ago.  However, they have since noticed that the mere loading of the M: drive takes much longer than the J: drive and suspect that is one of the main reasons things have slowed down so much.
- Therefore, they are moving their logs back to the J: drive, with hopes that will bring the macro and reporting processing times back to what they were in the beginning of the year
- Extend Timeout to 15 Minutes
- • There are various reasons why APIs, macro processing, etc. having been timing out and until TOS can come up with a solution for each item, they are extending the set timeouts from 10 minutes to 15 minutes.
- o Ex. If the Repackage Report step was previously taking more than 10 minutes, it would always time out.  Now, with the extende d threshold, hopefully the step can complete within 15 minutes and not time out.
- Tip: Until TOS can get the metrics back to normal expected times, you may consider running your deals via Cloud Automation.  Watching a step that is running for 10+ minutes under Manual and Local Automation is never fun.

- Excel Processor - Kill Ghost Sessions
- Macro processing for automated deals happens on servers and if a result is not returned back to iManage within 10 minutes, the associated workflow step will time out. o When this occurs, the Excel Processors will oftentimes not release the file the macro was run on, resulting in a locked file.
- “Error: Error in OpenFileAutomation macro OpenFileAutomation. Excel object returned failure: File open elsewhere”
- Now, the Excel Processors have been enhanced to release any files that have been in process for more than 10 minutes, which should prevent locked files going forward.

- 8811 – click on “8811” for the desired tier o Deal/tier specific file will be saved to T:\TAX\Form 8811

- W9 – click on “W9” for the desired tier o Deal/tier specific file will be saved to T:\TAX\Form W9
- Extension Failed to Insert into 1066 When Signoff on Review
- Per a previous enhancement, upon Review in the Tax Processing > Annually tab, iManage will try to merge the 7004 form with the 1066 for any tiers that were extended.
- o It looks for the extension in the date folder of the same day you are doing your review.  Therefore, if extensions were created on a previous day, it will fail to find the file to merge and will try to create a new one for today.
- However, that action would refresh the iManage screen and then it no longer knew which tiers need to be merged.
- This bug is now fixed and all selected tiers will have the 7004 merged with the related 1066, even if iManage has to create the 7004 on the fly.
- Fix/Enhance Archiving for Tax Processing
- Similar to our legacy method of archiving bond reports, tax reports were only being archived if the tax Going Green process was enabled on the deal
- To take advantage of our new file repository, iManage will now archive all OID (_3), ScheduleQ (_11), MDFR (_10), and 1066 (_12 and _16) reports for all deals as they are signed off in the Tax Processing screens (whether or not they have the Going Green process enabled)
- This more consistent archiving of files will be especially helpful when trying to find the original versions of the files after revising deals
- During signoffs, files will be saved to G:\FileRepo\Package\{did}\Tax\{yyyy} o Monthly – at Process, saved as {DID}_3_{mmyyyy}_Clean.pdf o Quarterly – at Deliver,
- MDFR saved as {DID}_10_{qqyyyy}_Clean.pdf
- ScheduleQ saved as {DID}_11_{qqyyyy}_Clean.pdf o Annually – at Deliver,
- Deal’s full 1066 package saved as {DID}_12_{qqyyyy}_Clean.pdf
- Terminated tier’s 1066 package saved as {DID}_16_{qqyyyy}_Clean.pdf
- If revised, the marked and clean versions of the reports is copied to G:\FileRepo\Archive\{DID}\Tax\{yyyy} with a “_0#” suffix to indicate how many times it has been revised
- Version 7.0.1.8 (Release Date: 3/9/2023)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:57 PM
- Setup
- DMT - tblImportFileSetup - Remove Hardcoded Map Restrictions
- FileIDs were previously restricted from using hardcoded maps.  The Servicer Setup screen was updated to allow for hardcoded maps, but the DMT was not.
- With this release, hardcoded maps can be selected for tblImportfileSetup modifications and inserts via the DMT.
- Copy From - Not Working For Macros
- Previously, there was a bug when trying to use the Copy From feature for automated deals when the deal to be copied from had duplicate macros, such as UpdateCas_IR, and/or it had multiple custom macros.
- The Copy From feature has now been enhanced to handle both of these scenarios.
- Enhance Workflow Creation for Default Mode
- The ProcessingMethod in the setup screen for automated deals has been decoupled from the method in the My Deals > Automation screen.
- In Deal Setup > Processing > Workflow tab, the Default Processing Method will now be static.
- Whenever a new workflow queue is created for the first time for a period, automation will use the Default Processing Method.
- TOS will make a one-time update to the field to match the method as noted in the Default Processing Method.xls file (as of 3/3/2023).
- ▪ If your deal did not have a method selected or was missed by the bulk update, you can still select your desired method directly via the UI.
- As with any automation setup changes, changing the Default Processing Method while a workflow is in progress will reset that period’s workflow back to Begin Workflow.  Please only make changes to the field prior to starting a period’s workflow.
- Going forward, any changes to the Processing Method in the My Deals > Automation tab will be applied only to that particular workflow queue (DID + Dt)
- Ex. Last month, the Deliver Final Reports step was completed via Manual mode.  Deal team set the Default Processing Method to Cloud Automation.  This month (and every period going forward), the deal’s workflow will kick off using Cloud Automation.
- Allocations
- Shelf / Automation User Lockdown in Allocation Screens
- The fake users of “Shelf” and “Automation” have been removed from all allocation screens’ user lists.
- Please work with the automation readiness team to convert your deals to automation so they can be shelf-processed correctly.
- Temp Shelf Allocation - Add Filters for Grid
- Filters on top of the grids of the SME Management and Temp Shelf Allocation screens have been added for ease of use.
- Processing
- Accept Data - Response Ended Prematurely
- For the past couple of months, we have been unable to run Accept Data on big deals (loan counts > 60k) – they would constantly time out.  TOS has been trying to find out what is implementing a 5-minute limit on our processes, but have not been able to find the source yet.
- When running Accept Data, users were getting this message;
- Last month, we were able to avoid the time-out issue by automating some of these big deals and running them via Cloud Automation.  This is still the suggested route.
- However, for deals that cannot be automated yet, TOS reverted the Accept Data button on the Data-Actions > Process > Discrepancy screen back to legacy code. o Now, big deals should be able to Accept Data without timing out.
- o Note: Doing so may slow down the database considerably and affect all other users.  If possible, please run Accept Data after normal business hours.
- Exception to Data Reviewed Check
- Once Accept Data is completed, the data status is “Finalized”
- As previously mentioned, some deals require supplemental data to be loaded that does not affect collateral or payment calculations, such as Special Servicing or Modification comments
### When loading into exception tables (tblCMSAComment and vwAgencyBreachReview), it will no longer give the following notification:
- “The selected process date has been reviewed.  Please consult your reviewer or manager for further instructions.”
- As long as the workflow is at or before the Reprocess Supplemental Reports step, hitting the “Load” button will allow you to import into these exception tables without any confusing pop-up notifications.
- Approval
- Input Manager - Display Rate Items as Decimals
- The bug that caused values in the My Deals > Input Manager screen to be displayed incorrectly has been fixed.
- The format of Rate, Date and Text columns will now be displayed in their appropriate format.
- Import API - Exponential values
- Exponential values from the payment and review ranges were previously getting imported in different formats, causing signoff steps to fail.
### Review range:
### Payment range:
- The Import Payment API is now updated to import the corresponding fields in the same format tblProcessingData- Character Limit
- The Import Payment API was also updated to allow for 55 characters for the tax range’s Dtype
- 'Servicer TermTest Trigger' to match the SQL table’s character limit
- Unlock Distrib - Revert to Prepare Distrib Step
- When unlocking the distrib on automated deals, if the workflow is past the Prepare Distrib step, the workflow will be reverted back to that step
- Support Package creation - Step Action fail
- Due to a deal folder name case sensitivity issue, the Package Report workflow step was failing to copy the newly created Support Package over to the J:\...\Support folder on some deals
- That bug has been fixed as the API will now be able to locate the deal folder even if the casing doesn’t match what is listed in Deal Setup
- In addition, even though the API failed to complete the action of copying the file over, it was marking the step as successful o Now, the API should validate the Support Package (and Final Package) were successfully copied over to the J: deal folder BEFORE marking the step as Success
- Update Revise / Archive Logic
- When revising a deal, the new archiving process will try to archive the previously delivered Final Package, Support Package and Review PDF, if applicable.
### When revising a deal that doesn’t have any of these files, it will always fail the archiving attempt and throw the following error unnecessarily:
- Now, it will only try to archive during revision if the deal has a Final Package
- Auto Report - Success When Should Be Failing
- The Generate Auto Report workflow step was incorrectly passing as successful even though it didn’t complete all necessary actions such as recording which component files were created in a SQL log table.
- This later caused the Package Report step to fail since it thought that the component files were missing.
- The Generate Auto Report step will now confirm all actions are complete before marking the step as successful and moving on.
- Macro Processing With Different Files
- There was a bug in the way automation handled macros run on different files within the same workflow, which is now fixed.
- For example, if a deal has macros setup for the Process Review step where it runs macros on the review sheet, then a macro on the distrib, and then finally Mastercheck_IR on the review sheet, it wasn’t saving the changes on the review sheet PRIOR to moving on to the macro on the distrib which ultimately caused MasterCheck_IR to fail.
- Add/Zap access restriction pop-up
- There was a bug that erroneously triggered an unauthorized message when
- Reviewers/Looksees tried to Add/Zap the Review info in the My Deals > Payments tab.
- Upon clicking 'OK' the function still proceeds as expected so the message has been removed to prevent confusion.
- Check on Open U Deal Folder Feature
- The Open Deal folder feature for the U Deal Folder was automatically creating a folder in the U: drive for deals that don’t have Backup Servicing duties so a check was added to the button to prevent the junk folders from getting created.
### If users try to open the U Deal Folder on a deal, they will get the following message if:
- Deal does NOT have Backup Servicing duties or o If user doesn't have access to the U: drive
- Miscellaneous
- iManage insert of a tblIRSchedCalc
- In the DMT, insert/modify into USBBProd table tblIRSchedCalc was not accepting exponential values
- It has been enhanced to allow decimal fields up to 9 decimal points (8 leading zeros)
## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 207.0.1.8.docx>
- Version 7.0.1.6 (Release Date: 2/6/2023)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	3:48 PM
- Processing
- Loan Accounting Run All AJEs
- The "Run all AJE’s” feature in the Loan Accounting > Processing screen was previously timing out
- The feature has been enhanced to handle the large data pool processing over huge data tables without running out of memory
- Extend Timeout Limits to 15 Minutes for Auto Report
- Auto Report for larger deals with lots of loan level reports were previously timing out after 10 minutes
- TOS extended the timeout limit to 15 minutes to accommodate these bigger deals
- Approval
- Optimize My Deals
- The My Deals screen has been further optimized and should load much faster than before o Ex. When navigating to the My Deals from Deal Setup or Data-Actions
- Input Manager Tab Enhancements
- To alleviate the need to switch and back forth between the Input Manager and Processing tabs of the My Deals screen, the Open Deal Folder feature was added to the Input Manager tab
- In addition, amounts in the grid are now displayed in “money” format – with comma separators for ease of reading
- Remove 6 Months Check From Cloud Processing Method Selection
- Now that iManage will automatically enable the Check Report – Processor / Reviewer workflow steps when automating deals that have not yet completed the Final 6-Month Review, there is no need to restrict Cloud Processing o The Check Report step will automatically switch deals to Manual mode during processing
- On both the Deal Setup > Processing > Workflow and the My Deals > Automation tabs, deal teams may switch the deal into Cloud Automation mode without restriction o Users that are not assigned to the deal (for hard or temp allocations) or who are not part of the shelf (shelf allocations) still cannot change the processing mode to Cloud
- New HTML Converter
- A new, cloud-compatible PDF to HTML converter called FocusPDF has been integrated into report packaging o The new converter will only be used during packaging for automated deals.  Legacy deals will continue to use the old converter.
- SEC deals can now be automated as the cloud can generate the required HTML version of the report (during the Package Report workflow step)
- Import Payment API - Missing TaxMaxOrigAmt
- Certain STACR deals require a TaxMaxOrigAmt field to be imported with the payment range
- Automation’s method of importing payment info was updated to include this additional field
- Shelf Access Rights - Reviewsheet/Distrib
- Users with Reviewer or Looksee rights within a shelf team should have the ability to lock/unlock the distrib and open an editable Reviewsheet for all shelf-allocated deals within the shelf o Example, a user who normally has basic Reviewer rights on hard-allocated deals (can’t run other people’s deals) may be a SME on a shelf.  As a SME, user is given Looksee rights for all deals in that shelf (that aren’t hard-allocated).  Therefore, user should be able to do everything on those deals, without restriction.
- However, those users were getting denied because iManage was limiting users by their general iManage rights (for hard allocated deals) and not considering their shelf rights
### Scenarios:
- Shelf-Allocated Deals
- If user has Processor rights within shelf team - should NOT be able to unlock deals or open review sheets
- If user has Reviewer/Looksee rights within shelf team - SHOULD be able to unlock deals or open review sheets
- Temp-Allocated Deals
- If user has Processor rights within shelf team - should NOT be able to unlock deals or open review sheets
- If user has Reviewer/Looksee rights within shelf team, whether or not assigned to the deal - SHOULD be able to unlock deals or open review sheets
- Hard-Allocated Deals
- Disregard shelf rights and use iManage rights
- If user has Processor rights within shelf team - should NOT be able to unlock deals or open review sheets
- If user has Reviewer/Looksee rights within shelf team, but not assigned to the deal should NOT be able to unlock deals or open review sheets
- IR Exception Management (IREM)
- Deal Count After Filter
- The deal count on the IREM has been updated to correctly reflect the number of deals (rows) displayed if the grid is filtered via the column headers
- Spinning When Trying to Multi-Process
- When processing multiple deals at once, if any of the requests fail to go through for any reason, the IREM would spin forever
- TOS implemented changes on all the processing buttons so that if any error occurs it will display in a pop-up instead of spinning forever
- Deal Listed Multiple Times
- TOS added more checks to the IREM to prevent deals from being listed on the IREM multiple times without different status/steps
- If you encounter this issue going forward, please report it via the GSF IR System Issues channel immediately so we can troubleshoot in real time
- iManage for Tax
- Auto Package Extensions
- Upon click of "Review" for tiers with "AmendedDueDt" indicated, iManage will find the 1065x PDF file saved in the T:\Tax\{DID} directory and package it along with the original 1066 and amended 1066
- If either the 1065x or “AOF” files are not found, you will have the option to proceed as-is (without the merge) or to stop so you can recreate the necessary files.
- If necessary files found, iManage will proceed with merging the files and delivering the final package to T:\TAX\_1066 staging for print
- Furthermore, “AMENDED” and “AS ORIGINALLY FILED” will be stamped on the bottom of each page of each of the relevant tax returns

## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 207.0.1.3.docx>
- Version 7.0.1.2 (Release Date: 12/7/2022)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	3:51 PM
- General Bug Fixes
- DTC Revision File
- The DTC revision file that iManage attaches to the File Delivery email at Send has been generating with erroneous bond data for the last month o Someone made changes to the template directly on 11/10 and all deals with payment revisions has been reporting that deal’s changes since
- PLEASE refrain from updating any template files as it will affect all other deals
- The original template has been restored and is now housed in a locked down folder so no one can make changes to it
- Insurance Claim Emails Missing on Non-Automated Deals
- For insured deals, an insurance claim email should be sent at Processor Signoff if
- 'InsuredClaimInt' or 'InsuredClaimPrin' are found in the tax range, even if 0
- In the prior build, these emails were not going out on non-automated deals, but still going out on automated deals.  Now, claim emails will go out on all insured deals.
- Quick Search - Missing Looksee
- In the prior build, the Quick Search feature did not display the assigned Looksee for deals.  This bug is fixed in the latest build.
- Legacy Deals - Emails Should Not be CC:ed to Theresa Rabkin and SME(s)
- With the last build, the Preliminary and File Delivery emails for non-automated deals were being sent to Theresa and the deal’s SME(s)
### This bug has been fixed:
- Preliminary File Delivery emails only sent to the Cash Analyst o File Delivery emails sent to Cash Analyst and Account Administrator(s)
- Only Retraction emails should include Theresa and the deal’s SME(s)
- Unable to Import – Object Reference Error
- The Import button on the Processing screen was previously throwing an object reference error for every deal/map
- The problem was that it was unable to determine the period to import for.  iManage will now pass through the period selected in the Processing Date dropdown and Importing should work as expected.
- Import Error - Parameter Count Does Not Match
- Importing with Map 1619 was previously throwing an error regarding a parameter count (while still successfully loading the data)
- You should no longer get this exception when using this specific map
- Allocations
- Current Allocations - Keep Dropdown Selections
- • For those who allocate deals, the user(s) selected will remain even after deals are updated.  This will help if other deals need to be reallocated to the same selected users.
- Processing
- Line Item Adjustments Tab
- Remove Import Options
- The Import (Replace/Append) options have all been removed from the Line Item Adjustments tab
- Most deals have FileIDs setup with line items MapID 16 that are automatically loaded.  If a user imports additional line items via these ad-hoc options, they would wipe out the data loaded via the FileID.
- Please use the Insert button for additional line items
- Add Step Check to Insert Button
- Similar to all the other Import / Load buttons, a step check was added to the Insert button o If the deal has already been sent, you will be instructed to revise the deal
- If a workflow step is currently being processed, you will be instructed to stop the workflow
- If any of the workflow steps have already been completed and the workflow is stopped, you will be warned that all your signoffs will be wiped out
- Update Import Data (SQL) Button
- The Import Data button in the Data-Actions > Map > Mapping Screen has been updated to work with SQL maps
- After selecting a File, the dropdowns in the Source Column From File column will be loaded with the headers from the source file
- The Import Data (SQL) button allows you to import your file with the selected map for the Dt shown (greyed out on top) o Import status will be displayed in the black box on the bottom right corner of the screen o If the import fails, an email notification will be sent to you with details to help you troubleshoot
- STACR - Maintenance Screens
- Due to the huge loan pools in the STACR deals, iManage used to crash when loading the Maintenance screens (or saving a change and navigating away)
- Pagination has been added to the top right of the Agency Maintenance loan level tabs to address this problem
- The Total Count is listed on the far right o Each page will list 10,000 rows of data
- Use the page buttons to navigate through the entire result set
- LID Search can be used to search for a loan in the entire result set
- Note: the column filters will only work on the loans listed on the loaded page
- Approval
- Enhanced Payment/Due Dates Calculations
- Pre-calculate current month payment date and due date
- Previously, iManage had to calculate the payment/due dates displayed on the UI in real time, which took a lot of database resources
- tblPmtDay was updated to include new fields CurMonthDt, PaymentDt and DueDt
- The table will be updated on the 1st of each month with the PaymentDt and DueDt for the
- CurMonthDt for each deal o When loading iManage screens for the current month, the screen should load faster since it should be able to find the payment/due dates via a simple query
- ▪ If changing to a prior/future period, the UI will switch back to calculating the dates for the selected deal and may take a bit longer
- o Changes made to Deal Setup > Dates will automatically update tblPmtDay for the selected
- o
- deal
- Check Report – Processor/Reviewer
- For automated deals, the Check Report – Processor/Reviewer Tasks form would take a very long time to close and crash iManage if users manually closed them
- Now, the forms will close and behave the same as for legacy deals with no crashing
- Add Exception to Data Reviewed Check
- Importing was previously allowed (without risk of reverting workflow) for maps that load into tblCMSAComment and vwAgencyBreachReview.  However, users would still get stopped because the deal had been “reviewed”.
- Users will no longer get that pop-up if trying to import into those exception tables while the workflow is at or before the Reprocess Supplemental Reports step
- However, if the workflow is already past the Reprocess Supplemental Reports step, attempting to import even into those exception tables will revert the workflow back to the Reprocess Supplemental Reports step
## Note: Refer to iManage 7.0.0.8 Release Notes for details on how to use the Reprocess
- Supplemental Reports step
- Enhance Distrib Checks
- Previously, iManage would determine that a Bond deal has a distrib if the Deal Folder was populated in Deal Setup.  If found, iManage would check to see if the file is unlocked or if it had been changed since the
- package was created.
- However, with the integration of the Backup Servicing deals into automation, since they also use the Deal Folder field, iManage can no longer assume the deal has a distrib to check against
### Now, the Distrib Locked and Distrib Date Changed checks will only be run on: o Bond deals o If deal flagged as Bond Reporting, if the deal has at least one of the following:
- The Distrib Pmt Range populated
- The Distrib Tax Range populated
- Distrib Reports setup
- Pause Distrib Change Tracking
- In rare cases when a client requests never-ending changes, Senior Managers may allow the deal to stop change tracking while it is unlocked
- Only Senior Managers have access to enable the “Allow suspension of change tracking” setting in Other Settings
- For deals where this setting is enabled, when deal team Unlocks the distrib, they will get the option to suspend distrib change tracking
- If Yes, the distrib will unlock, but not be Shared o If No, the distrib will unlock like normal, in Shared mode
- If change tracking had been paused, when relocking the deal, iManage will find no change history to verify and then ask if it should resume change tracking
- If Yes, deal team is confirming that they are done with all the changes and iManage can continue tracking changes the next time the deal is unlocked
- If No, deal team is confirming they aren’t done, but distrib is good enough to be relocked for signoff
- If a deal has not resumed change tracking in over 90 days, the user that paused the change tracking will be added to a Daily Change Tracking Noncompliance report that is emailed to GSF IR ALL
- Process Tax Workflow Step Fails
- As stated previously, if the Process Tax step fails, an email notification will be sent to GSF IR Tax
- The email notification will now specify the deal and period that the step failed on
- Tax analysts can pull up the failed deal under the bond deal team’s view to resolve any exceptions.  (Only the Tax team can resolve exceptions on this particular step)
- Shelf Processing
- Default Shelf SMEs As Looksees
- All Shelf SME(s) will automatically be added to the shelf team with Looksee rights o All existing SMEs will be given Looksee rights for their shelves
- When changing SMEs, the user that was the previous SME will remain as a Looksee in the shelf team unless user is no longer active
- If an existing shelf member is assigned as the shelf SME, their rights will be upgraded to
- Looksee as well
- Logins with all caps unable to signoff during shelf processing
- Previously, users whose iManage profiles had capital letters for their login were unable to kick off workflow steps during shelf processing
- This bug is fixed and as long as users are part of the shelf team, they should be able to kick off any workflow step within a shelf processed deal
- Shelf Allocation Tabs- Limit Rights of SME
- Access to make changes in the Shelf Management and Temp Shelf Allocations tabs have been restricted so that users with SME rights will have the ability to only edit the shelves they are the SMEs of
- Managers – If your direct is a SME of a shelf and needs access to make edits to their shelves, please submit an iTracker to grant them SME rights
- All users can view the data in these tabs, but the buttons will be disabled unless the necessary access is granted
- IR Exceptions Management Application (IREM)
- Previously Released Enhancements
- On 11/18/2022, we released an enhanced version of the IREM with the following updates: o Filters in the headers – requires minimum of 4 characters to be typed
- Option to sort by Status (Fail first, grouped by Step and ordered by DID alphabetically)
- Restricted rights for Managers (will have same rights as anyone else – can only take action on deals they are assigned to) o Select All / None buttons
- Don't Allow Multiple Clicks
- Previously, if users clicked on the Process button multiple times, it would kick off multiple queues for the same deal
- Now, users will not be able to generate multiple queues by repeatedly hitting the Process Deals or Revert Workflow buttons
- A spinner and greyed-out background were added to prevent users from clicking again until the confirmation message pops
- After that, if user clicks Process again without refreshing, they will get a message that the workflow is no longer at the step displayed on the grid and to refresh
- Archiving
- New File Repository
- Historically, we have been archiving all the Going Green-approved Final Packages, Support
- Packages and Review PDFs in the ServicingFiles database.  However, if the SQL server goes down or there are issues with the database, it would fail to archive
- We have now converted all archiving to a file server on the G: drive
- All files that are checked during the Processor/Reviewer Tasks (legacy workflow) and the Check Report - Processor/Reviewer steps (automation workflow) will be saved to the new file repository o Note: The new archiving process applies to Tax Processing signoffs as well
- If an automated deal does not use the Check Report - Processor/Reviewer steps in its workflow, the Final Package, Support Package and Review PDF, if applicable, will still be archived o This is an improvement from the legacy workflow that only archived these documents if the Processor/Reviewer Tasks were enabled
- This more consistent archiving of files will be especially helpful when trying to find the original versions of the files after revising deals
- As a reminder, to pull the approved versions of the files, go to My Deals > Internal Files tab
- The files listed in the initial grid (green) are the most current approved files at the time of the latest delivery
- If file is marked as True, the file had been successfully archived
- Download Clean Copy will save the unmarked copy of the selected file to the deal’s J: PDF folder
- Download Marked Copy will save the copy with checkmarks of the selected file to the deal’s J: PDF folder
- To view the versions of the files that were approved in previous deliveries (prior to revision), hit Open Archive
- The grid that appears (red) will list all of the prior versions of the files
- Ex. If deal had been revised twice, would expect to see 2 versions of each of the files listed.
- Archive Reports Workflow Step
- As stated above, if an automated deal does not use the Check Report - Processor/Reviewer steps in its workflow, the Final Package, Support Package and Review PDF, will still be archived via a new Archive Reports Workflow step
- The step will automatically get added to any automated deal’s workflow (that doesn’t have the Check Report – Processor AND Reviewer steps enabled) and does not need to be enabled in the setup
- If a deal has none / only one of the Check Report steps enabled, the archive step will be inserted automatically when you first kick off the workflow
- If a deal is in the middle of a workflow, the step will only get inserted if the workflow is reverted back to Begin Workflow or is at a failed status
### At this step, it will archive:
- The Final Package if it exists in the deal’s J: PDF folder or the file location specified in the
- Files setup
- AND has not been modified since the Package Report step
- If the package was modified, the step will fail
- The Support Package, if applicable and a current file exists in the deal’s J: Support folder o The Review PDF, if applicable and a current version exists in the deal’s T: ISERV folder iManage for Tax
- Extensions Enhancement
- Previously, the tax team had to manually merge the extension form with the 1066 for each extended tier
- Now, as long as the REMICID is setup for the tier, iManage will automatically merge the 7044 form as page 2 of the tax return for each extended tier after a successful Review signoff in the Annually tab of the Tax Processing screen
- If extension date found, but no extension file found, iManage will create the extension file for the insert
- If the REMICID was not setup for the tier, iManage will remind the user to attach the extension manually.
- The updated tax return is then saved to the location/date specific folder in the T:\TAX\_1066 staging for print folder
- In addition, iManage will place a copy of the extension file and the updated tax return in the deal’s tax folder under the year sub-folder
- Risk of missing tiers between tblDealEntity and Annually on Tax Processing
- When a tax entity is added to a deal via Deal Setup > Tax, it adds the signoff records for the new entity to the Annual signoff table
- However, when entities are added in bulk via the Import Batch button or the DMT, the signoff records don’t get added and users have to remember to go into each deal and hit the Update button for each new entity they just bulk-added.  This leads to some potential discrepancy between tblDealEntity and what appears in the Annually signoff screen on Tax Processing. If it occurs, the extension may be missed, which is a huge risk.
- A new Update All button has been added to the screen so that the same signoff reconciliation is done for all of the deal’s tiers at once, i.e. users no longer have to hit Update for each individual tier
- Note: Each of the deal’s entity type must be assigned to a user in the Allocations tab in order for it to show in the Annually screen
- Reporting
- New CMBS Reports
- • The following CMBS Package FM Irvine reports now have “by Group” versions o Historical Bond/Collateral Realized Loss Reconciliation   o REO Status Report
- Interest Shortfall Reconciliation o NOI Loan Detail
- Historical Loan Modification Report
- Material Breaches and Document Defects
