## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.2.2.4.docx>
- Version 6.2.2.3 (Release Date: 11/2/2019)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:23 PM
- The following update(s) are related to changes to setup/processing.
- Multiple Due Date functionality (#9776) - SME: Mike Ortiz
### There are some deals that first have to be submitted to the client 5 BD prior to the payment date (“PreSend”) and then the final approval is done 2 BD prior to payment date, like the Agency deals.   To accommodate this multiple due date scenario, a new setting was created:
- For example, if the DID is Freddie, create a “child” deal named Freddie#1 o Child deal should be named the same as the parent deal followed by #...
- For the child deal, enable the “Child Deal – User Parent’s Going Green Tasks” setting in Deal Setup > Other Settings
- For the child deal, set the earlier due date in Deal Setup > Basic Info > Dates
- Since the parent-child deals are actually the same deal, the child deal should NOT have Going Green tasks set up.
- All checks will be done on the parent deal.  Ex. Going Green tasks must be done on the parent deal, Freddie.
### 5 BD prior to payment:
- Perform the Processor and Reviewer Going Green tasks on the parent deal – Freddie o Sign off as Processor and Reviewer on the child deal – Freddie#1
- When hitting Send on the child deal, iManage will check to make sure the GG tasks were done on the PARENT deal.
### ▪ If GG tasks were not completed, will get the following hard stop advising that the parent deal’s tasks must be completed first:
- 2 BD prior to payment – complete the rest of the parent deal’s approval as normal
- Note: Mike Ortiz will provide additional training/communication on this new feature soon.
- Support Package - Add Effective Date – SME: Kevin Butz
- In Data-Actions > Setup > Deal Report Setup > Support Package Report, a new “Effective Date” field has been added to the setup form.
- If you added a new Support Package item recently, such as a new file the Servicer started providing in October 2019, you can set the Effective Date for that item as of Oct 2019.  This becomes useful if you have to revise the deal for a prior month and need to recreate the Support Package for that month iManage will be smart enough to know to NOT include the new item since it wasn’t available previously.
- Remove Export Package and Export Support from Data-Actions (#12062) - SME: Neemit Desai
- The Export Package and Export Support buttons were removed from the Data-Actions > Process > Export screen.  Now that iServ and iManage are combined, there is no need for these buttons that require separate maintenance from the buttons on the My Deals screen.
- Note: The Supp Package button was enabled for Collateral Deals in the My Deals screen.
- Adding 2nd SME to tbldefaultMetrics (#12329) - SME: Dona Werth
- Many of the bigger shelves have more than one SME so a “SME 2nd” field was added to Deal Setup > Basic Info > Main Info to reflect another contact you can reach out to for questions.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Late Form Refresh Issue (#12206) SME: Jae Choi
- There was a bug in the Late Form that prevented the Finish button from appearing if you decided to change the categories after initially selecting other options.  This refresh issue should be fixed now – as long as you select a Main and Sub Category, the Finish button will consistently appear.
- Update to bizGetDealAdmins (#12207) SME: Jae Choi
- Some deals require more than one Account Admin to be assigned, but the sproc that was used to determine who the AA is would fail because it was only expecting one contact to be assigned.  The sproc was updated to allow for multiple AAs.
### Example: Previously, the InsuranceClaim Check would fail on deals with multiple AAs, but you should no longer get this error:
- Revision Interface missing dates (#12357) SME: Jae Choi
- Due to bugs with the multi-process feature, the Revision form was not pulling in all the completed periods for the deals that were multi-processed.  The Revision form logic was updated to correctly capture all completed periods.
### Before:                            After:
- Bug Fix: Add button not working for Pool Balances (Loan Level) (#12246) – SME: Neemit Desai
- In the My Deals > Payments tab, after zapping the Pool Balances (Loan Level), we were unable to Add them back in.  The Add button has been fixed to correctly reimport the sum of the BegSched and EndSched from tblLoanMonthly, which should match your BloomBeg and BloomEnd ranges from the distrib.
- Error with bizInsertLog (#12378) – SME: Brian Scheff
- Randomly, after generating a package, iManage would throw the following error stating that it's failing to insert a record into tblProcessLog, but can't because the Description is missing.  It wasn’t a hard stop, but caused unnecessary concern.  This error was related to the new revision table and should no longer happen.
- iManage for Tax : Update Review and Deliver code for Annual Duties (#12211) - SME: Carrie Reynolds
- As promised last month, the Review and Deliver buttons of the Tax Processing > Annually screen have been updated to match the new Process logic.  If the deal has a terminated tier, iManage will now allow you to sign off on the remaining selected tiers in “batch,” as long as they have the same EntityType.
- In addition, the 1065, 1041 and WHFIT signoff process has been simplified, i.e. no Going Green or delivery of files.
- Update Signoff Process for Terminated Non-1066 Annuals (#12066) - SME: John Tavares
- If a 1065, 1041 or WHFIT tier terminates, iManage will no longer try to deliver files that don’t exist.  As stated above, iManage will just populate the signoffs.
### iManage for Tax: Enhance Logic for late returns (Part 2 of 12067) (#12163) – SME: Carrie Reynolds The logic for the highlighting of late filings was fixed to only refer to the original Due Date:
- If deal was originally delivered on time (StDt <= DueDate), the deal should never be highlighted, even after hitting Revise.
- If deal was originally late (StDt > DueDate), the deal should stay highlighted, even after hitting Revise.
- Tax Processing - Extensions for Grantor Trusts or Partnerships (#12074) - SME: Carrie Reynolds
- You can now create the Extension form for 1041s and 1065s via Tax Processing > Annually > Create Extension.  The form will be generated in the T:\TAX\Extension\YYYY_MM_DD folder.
- C-BASS 2007-SP2 unable to sign off the 1066 review for terminated tier (#12313) - SME: Pai Liu
- Previously, iManage was unable to handle terminating tiers that had REMICIDs with a space in it, such as “M-8 REMIC”.  This deficiency has been fixed to accommodate the full REMICID.
- The following update(s) are miscellaneous enhancements.
- Batch report did not pull in this deal record (#12324) - SME: Johan Laksmana
- The Batch Export > Bloomberg TXT NEW export logic was not pulling in some non-Chicago deals, but this bug has been fixed.
- Data Management Tool Access - tblLoanOID (#12372) - SME: Neemit Desai tblLoanOID is now available for editing via the DMT, but only for the Loan Accounting team.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the reports.
- Flex Remittance Summary - Incorrect Sub out Reporting (#12327) - SME: Jae Choi
- The Substitution Out Loans line on the remittance summaries was pulling erroneous information because it wasn’t matching the Servicer in tblLoanCutoff to the Servicer in tblLoanMonthly.  This should be fixed now, but please pay close attention to this on deals with multiple servicers and multiple groups.
- Group Level Collateral /Remittance Summary --- creating and displaying an extra blank page (# 12368) - SME: Christine Paidosh
- If your generated package has any blank pages, please submit a ticket or bring it up to the deal shelf’s SME.  Some clients are very particular so we would like to prevent these from going out.
## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.2.2.3.docx>
- Version 6.2.2.0 (Release Date: 10/5/2019)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:24 PM
- Inquiry Tracker Enhancement (#12196 & 12298 / PI #1709) – SME: Samir Ghia
- Senior Managers requested a redesign of the Inquiry Tracker screen to encourage you to use it more.
### You are only required to complete the:
- DID
- Inquiring Party
- Category
- If you have a few more seconds to fill out the other fields, please feel free to.
## The Inquiry Notes (comments) section is reserved for the Issues Task Force.  You will not be required (or even able to) add any comments to the inquiry.
- Once you’ve recorded an inquiry, you can search for it in the bottom grid.  All previous inquiries can also be found here.
- If the inquiry needs to be escalated to the Issues Task Force, changing the Status to “Escalated” will automatically email the Task Force group with the details so you don’t have to.
- Filling out the form should take less than a minute, so please remember to submit all inquiries.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to setup/processing.
- Bug Fix: Unable to save updates to Base Distrib field (#12264) - SME: Yuan Li-Crouch
- In Deal Setup > Basic Info > Main Info, any changes to the Base Distrib field were not being saved correctly.   This bug has been fixed.
- 2 New Date Codes (#11446) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- In Deal Setup > Processing, two new date codes of "LC" and "LB", standing for Last Calendar day and Last Business day, respectively, have been added for more accurate date calculations.
- If you forget, you can always hover over the Date Code Legend, which will present all the options that are available for date calculations.
- Add Sydney & Melbourne (Australia) to Holiday List (#12297) - SME: James Hounslow
- For a new UK deal, Australia holidays needed to be added for Distribution Date calcs.  The Sydney and Melbourne financial centers are now available in the Deal Setup > Basic Info > Dates tab.
- Allow for code 98 for Other Amort Type (#12225) - SME: Christine Paidosh
- For CMSA deals, Servicers provide both codes 9 or 98 for “Other” amort type, but iManage only recognized code 9 so the Mortgage Loan Characteristics Amort Type table wasn’t capturing any loans that were reported as 98.  Since 98 is the official code, we’ve added it as another option for “Other” for COM Collateral Amort Type.
- Import cutoff/ update cutoff (#12244) - SME: Keagan Delfosse
### The IMPORT CUTOFF – EXCELand UPDATE CUTOFFmaps have been updated to accept alphanumeric LIDs.  You should no longer get this type of error if your LIDs have letters in them:
- Update Triage Contact List on Import Failure Emails (#12041) - SME: Neemit Desai
### When an import fails, an email is automatically sent to you with the error details and a list of contacts that you can reach out to for help.  The Error-SSIS email will now list the following updated Triage list and shelf SME, if known:
- Constraint on tblServ's PaidOffDt (#12284) - SME: Kalan Jablonski iManage will no longer allow you to import a PaidOffDt of any “date” prior to 1950, such as 0 or "1/0/1900" that the Servicers sometime provide in their periodic files.  You will get the following error if you attempt to import those bad “dates” and will be required to correct the bad date(s) before you can successfully import data.  Please ensure that your iMap is updated to treat any such “dates” as NULL.

- The MisMatchedLoans file that is generated to the deal’s T: folder (when iManage can’t find a loan that you are trying to import data for) was updated to report the LID3, if applicable, for easier reference.
- New field for tblProcessingData - Servicer TermTest Trigger (#12269) - SME: Kim Ghia
- There is a new item that can be imported via the tax range to tblProcessingData, called Servicer Termination Test Trigger (DType = Servicer TermTest Trigger)
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Auto Report command line not exporting the correct csv (#12265) SME: Mike Ortiz
- The Auto Report macro (when used via Macro Manager) was not generating the correct Loan Level csv because it wasn’t identifying the period correctly.  Example - Instead of creating the Loan Level file for “Sep201901” in September, it generated a file for “Jan101”.  This bug should be fixed.
- Termination Form - Email notifications failing on subsequent tries (#12278) – SME: Quinlie Lin iTracker #12137 had ensured that iManage automatically sends the email notification when a user first completes the Termination form.  However, if the deal team decides to "Resend Email", subsequent delivery of the email to the Account Admin would fail.  This bug should be fixed.
- Duplicate exporting of Payment xls during sign off (#12112) – SME: Neemit Desai
- On deals that don’t have a Final Looksee assigned, during the Reviewer Signoff step, iManage was exporting the Payment file twice consecutively.  This bug has been fixed for efficiency.
- Special character cause issues when revising deal (#12268) - SME: Jae Choi

- iManage for Tax - tweak logic for quarterly - terminating deals (#12217) - SME: Carrie Reynolds
- The trigger that creates that tax quarterly signoff records have been fixed to accurately account for when deals terminated.
- iManage for Tax: Tax Processing - Delete button for Extensions (#12075) - SME: Carrie Reynolds
- In the Tax Processing > Annually screen, if you had previously created an extension for a deal/tier, but no longer need it, you may use the new “Delete Extension” button that will remove the Extension Created checkmark and Extended Due Date for the selected deal/tier.
### iManage for Tax: Enhance Going Green file location name for Terminated Tiers (#12262) – SME:
- Courtney Harrington
- When a tier terminates, iManage tries to process that tier individually and would identify the tier by its REMICID.  However, there are instances where a REMICID is not assigned to the tier, so the process would fail.  This ticket addresses the different scenarios as much as possible.
### For iTax deals with blank REMICID:
- Tax Managers agree that all deals should have a REMICID.  If it doesn’t, please reach out to them to add it to tblHolder_Remic via the DMT.
- If you forget, when you go to sign off on the terminating tier, iManage will give an error that it can’t find the file with the REMICID in the name.
- If you run into this error, please work with your direct tax manager to identify the REMICID for the tier.  You may have to regenerate the tax forms as well.
### For Excel deals:
- Tax forms created by Excel differ slightly from the ones created by iTax.  As long as the deal is setup with Tax Platform = “E”, iManage will know to look for the file named as "{DID with no spaces}_1066_{HolderID, if any}_ Period".
- ▪ If a HolderID does not exist for the tier, iManage will no longer look for the extra underscore
- iManage for tax - allow multiple tiers of processing to include terminated tiers (#11925) - SME: Carrie Reynolds
- Previously, if one tier terminated early, iManage would force users to sign off the remaining tiers individually.  In the Annually tab, the Process button has been enhanced to allow you to sign off on the remaining selected tiers in “batch,” as long as they have the same EntityType.
- Attached to the iTracker is a decision tree that explains what iManage will do based on different scenarios.
- Note: If this new logic works well for Process, the same logic can be later applied to the Review and Deliver buttons.  For now, only the Process button will work in the new way – the other two will continue to force users to sign off remaining tiers individually, until we are confident the new logic works well.
- Added bonus in the Annually tab: you can now type in the DID into the filter row itself instead of using
- the filter form to quickly find your deal.
- The following update(s) are miscellaneous enhancements.
- Test Package File Name (#12197) - SME: Brian Scheff
- Due to USBank protocols, our sample packages will now be named “_sample” instead of “_Test”.  You can generate a sample package via My Deals > Create Test Package under the Run options that will output into the deal’s PDF folder.
- Additions to vwRevision (#12257) - SME: Kim Ghia
- Table vwRevision now includes the deal team names for easy reference when trying to query revision details.
- STACR - Update spRptDiscAgency when CMSA = 7 (#12283) - SME: Brian Scheff
### You should no longer run into the following error on new STACR deals when switching to the Discrepancy screen:
- iManage for Tax: Update logic for Tax Status Reports for only Active Deals and for Location (#12007 & 12312) - SME: John Tavares
### The Tax Status Report logic had to be enhanced to account for the new tblDealEntity, tblCompletedTaxM/Q/A and REMICTax fields in tblSetup.  It will now only report:
- Records that are active
- Deals that have not terminated (as of January 1st of the year selected)
- The deals based on REMIC Tax Processing Location
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the reports.
- Logic Update for previous ticket: 12069 (#12255) - SME: Nadia Ahmed
- The “Loss Trigger Review Event” report was fixed to pull the "endsched" instead of “bal3_end” as was originally requested when the report was created.  EndSched captures the true balance that we should report for ALL deals in the MCMLT shelf.
- CMBS - Mortgage Characteristics Strat Ranges (#12192) - SME: Brian Scheff
- The “Remaining Principal Balance” MLC report was incorrectly reporting a range twice.  The report logic has been fixed to prevent this going forward.
- Please update the Prepayment and Liquidation HELOC Report to only report current month Prepayments (#12270) - SME: Dona Werth
- The Prepayment and Liquidation HELOCreport was updated to reflect only loans that have paid off in the current reporting cycle.  For example, for the August 2019 report, only loans that have a PaidOffDt between 7/1/2019 and 7/31/2019 will be included. This change is only for the HELOC version of the Prepayment and Liquidation Report.
### Liquidation Count in the Prepayment & Liquidation Loan Detail Report is not correct (#12290) - SME:
- Keagan Delfosse
- The Liquidation Count on the Prepayment and Liquidation Loan Detail Reportwas updated only include loans that have an Ending UPB (EndSched + EndBalDefAct) = 0 and Loss (Loss + DefActLoss) > 0.
- FMSCRT 2019-1, 2019-2 and 2019-3 (#12221) - SME: Ruby Liu
- The Payahead_Reserve_Deposit logic on the Loan Level CSV FMSCRT file was fixed.  It was previously calculating incorrectly, even after the deployment of iTracker #12000.
## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.2.2.0.docx>
- Version 6.2.1.9 (Release Date: 8/31/2019)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:26 PM
- Revision Project (PI #1138) – SME: Jae Choi
### The Revision Enhancement project was deployed with this latest build to lessen the time spent compiling information and to provide more meaningful metrics for management.  Jae will be holding training sessions in the coming days, but here are a few highlights:
- New Revision form (applicable to Bond and Collateral deals)
- Undo Revision button – option to restore signoffs, payment info, tax info, etc. if a revision is cancelled
- New tblRevisionHistory to capture related data
- Ability to revise multiple periods at once and group items together
- Flexible sending options (#11903/ PI #1622 & 1469) - SME: Mike Ortiz
### Mike will be holding training sessions on the following new features that were added to Deal Setup > Files > Add or Modifyto allow for flexible sending, but here are some highlights:
- “New Folder” - Allows you to specify an additional folder to save auto-generated files to, other than the default folder.
- The field allows for filemasks
- When hit “Send” in the My Deals screen, the report with this feature enabled will be copied to the specified folder
- “Send Email” – If you want a certain auto-generated file to be emailed at “Send”, flag this box and populate the email address of the recipient o Multiple email addresses must be separated by semi-colon
- Flag the “Include Admins” box if you want the Account Admin(s) to get the email at the same time
- The Files screen will show which report has any of the new features enabled.
- 11903 Epilogue (New file type for sending nothing to Pivot) (#12169) - SME: Mike Ortiz
- A new file type was added that will not post to Pivot, but still has the file copy and emailing features mentioned above.  In the File Type dropdown, it is listed as “Skip Standard Delivery File”.
### In My Deals > Investor Files, new columns were added so you can quickly identify which of the above features were set on certain files:
- The following update(s) are related to changes to setup/processing.

- To the Basic Info > Main Info tab: o Legal Hold Start Date o Legal Hold End Date o Final 6 month Review extension date o Explanation for past due Status o ACS Acct Short Name o SEI Acct # o Base Distrib
- To the Basic Info > Dates tab: Critical Dates (see below)

- ➢ A border now encloses the Distribution Date section to clearly separate it from the rest of the date setup

- 11965 - Map 1663 still importing full property address (#12173) - SME: Christine Paidosh
- To further safeguard iManage from allowing borrower name and address to come through, a trigger has been created to wipe out any such personal information, if found.

- One sided tbldidchange (#12037) - SME: Jae Choi
- When transferring loans, such as from a main trust to RMBS, iManage can now update the cutoff table for the loans without populating the SubOutDt and SetupType.  For this to work correctly, you must enable a new Advanced Setting.
- In Data-Actions > Setup > Advanced Settings, enable the Data Map – DID Change Additions setting.  Set it to Yes.
- Import the transferring loans using the DID Change Template (map 1450).  You will notice that the SubOutDt and SetupType will remain NULL in the cutoff tables.
- Note: If you forget to enable the DID Change Additions setting, map 1450 will populate the SubOutDt and SetupType for the loans as it always has.

This was causing problems for clients and the Cash group who use the Excel files to update their own files.  The packaging process will now remove all ranges when creating the Excel version of the Final Package.

- The Loan Level CSV FMSCRT file now calculates the “Amount of Aggregate Forgiveness” as the sum of ModForgPrin.
- FMSCRT - modification reporting (#12174) - SME: Jae Choi
- For the FMSCRT/Freddie SLST shelf only, the Material Modifications Loan Detail Report - Full UPB under the RMBS Package was updated to reflect the prior period’s Rate and P&I.
- Note: Deals outside of the FMSCRT shelf that use this report should continue to report the same way as they always have.  Please reach out to Jae Choi if you notice a discrepancy.
- Freddie CMBS - Realized Loss Summary for CMBS Report (#12128) - SME: Brian Scheff

## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.2.1.9.docx>
- Version 6.2.1.8 (Release Date: 8/3/2019)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:26 PM
- Special Note:The Loan Accounting screen was added under Data-Actions.  However, iManage will crash if you try to access it.  It will only work for deals that have converted, i.e. have an accounting ledger, so please do not touch the screen.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to setup/processing.
### Create a new flag in Servicing db and iManage UI to indicate inactive deal (#12054/PI #1617) – SME:
- Hieu Nguyen
- In Deal Setup > Basic Info > Main Info tab, a new “Inactive Deal” flag has been added to easily identify inactive deals for data analysis and trending purposes.  Only managers and senior managers have the access to flag a deal as inactive.
- New Notification Alert in iManage associated with Defeased Loan Status on a loan level basis (# 12160/PI #1698) - SME: Christine Paidosh
- A new notification alert has been added to the Data-Actions > Process > Notifications tab to notify users of defeasance loans.  This is becoming more common with the Freddie deals - the alert should prompt users to contact the servicer to change the surveillance rates, which increases the net rates and affects net WAC.
- Allow "Batch" deals to be Allocated (#12089) - SME: Samir Ghia
- Previously “deals” that were categorized under the Batch type (not Global Duties) could not be allocated.  Now, Batch “deals” can be allocated.
- iServ Discrepancy Tab to show New LID from LID Change Tab (#12059) - SME: Brandon Humphreys
- A “LidNEW” column was added to the Data-Actions > Process > Discrepancy screen.  Previously, the screen only provided the cutoff LID, but if the LID had changed, users would need to do a bit of research to find the right loan in the current Servicer file.  The LidNEW column should help reduce the time it takes to resolve discrepancies.
- iServ Maintenance LID Change Search Function (#12058) - SME: Brandon Humphreys
- The Data-Actions > Maintenance > LID Change Search feature has been enhanced to be able to search by both Old and New LIDs.  This should help when trying to load lineitems or searching LIDs to resolve discrepancies.
- GUI: Enhance Maintenance Table for Resecs (#11991/PI #1662) - SME: Brandon Humphreys In order to prevent typos when entering a UDID on the Data-Actions > Maintenance > Resec tab, the UDID field has been enhanced to be a dropdown of all active DIDs from tblSetup.
- Please enable Step 1 and Step 7 Rate/Date and P&I to be loaded with Cutoff (#11889) - SME: Dona Werth
- The cutoff templates (via the Data-Actions > Setup > Deal Info > Import Data area using "Import CutoffExcel" and “UPDATE CUTOFF”) have been updated to include the newer NextStep…1 and 7 fields.
### As Mary previously mentioned, Bayview sub-out files created by automation will need to be updated:
- Rerun your deal through the line items generator to include additional fields in the cutoff template.
- OR you can manually add the fields to the sub out file (and update your import range to include the columns) and reimport.
- Export Package button not generating the Excel version of the package (#11894) - SME: Brian Scheff In Data – Actions > Process > Export, the “Export Package” button has been enhanced to generate both the PDF and Excel versions of the reports to T:\ISERV_TEST\{DID}.
- Adjust timestamps for UK date format (#12087) - SME: James Hounslow
- For computer settings, UK dates are formatted as DD/MM/YYYY, which caused problems when recording the date into SQL tables, such as when updating Allocations.  iManage has been updated to correctly convert UK date format into US date format.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Enhance Payment File Creation Logic (#12018)
- Previously, if a deal had the “Include Cash Tab” feature enabled in Deal Setup > Other Settings, but the distrib’s Tax range wasn’t set up correctly to populate that sheet in the payment file, it would cause a hard stop when trying to approve the deal at Reviewer Signoff with an erroneous error of “System could not find PAYMENT file.”
- iManage has been enhanced to skip the SD_Cash sheet generation in these cases when creating the payment file so the approval and file delivery can proceed as expected.
- iManage for Tax: Additional logic fix needed in trgDealEntity (#12129) – SME: Carrie Reynolds After 11896 was deployed, the first quarter created for a deal was one quarter too early.  The insertion of quarterly signoff records (when an entity has been added to a deal) has been fixed to insert the correct first quarter based on the deal’s first payment.
- iManage for Tax: Going Green's Deal Folder Buttons (#11799) – SME: Keagan Delfosse
- The Going Green form within the Tax Processing screens has been fixed to correctly open the deal’s folders, depending on the button selected.  Previously, these buttons were opening to the root of the drives only.
- J: Deal Folder button now opens to J:\{tblSetup.DealFolder}
- Report Folder button now opens to T:\iServ\{DID}
- Data Folder button now opens to M:\{tblSetup.DealFolder}\Data\{YYYY}\{M} iManage for Tax: iManage looking at the wrong deal folder path for iFactor deals (#11998) – SME: Mirela Berberi iManage has been enhanced to differentiate between deals with taxes run in iTax, Excel and iFactor (based on Deal Setup > Basic Info > TaxPlaform).  If run in iFactor, iManage will now know to refer to F: \Reports\{DID} instead of failing.
- When hitting the "Open Tax Folder" button,
- If TaxPlatform = "S" for iTax, it will open T:\TAX\{DID}
- If TaxPlatform = "E" for Excel, it will open T:\TAX\Excel\{DID}
- If TaxPlatform = "F" for iFactor, it will open F:\Reports\{DID}
- Quarterly tab - when hit Deliver and in the Annually tab - when hit Review, it will look for the files from the appropriate source folders (as above)
- Reminder: if iManage seems to be looking in the wrong location for your tax files, please make sure Deal Setup > Basic Info > Main Info > Tax Platform is populated correctly (as indicated above).
## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.2.1.8.docx>
- Version 6.2.1.7 (Release Date: 6/29/2019)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:26 PM
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the setup process.
- Update iManage MacroRun button to save a field to tblMacroDealSetup (#12030) – SME: Mike Ortiz In the My Deals screen, if you have macros set up for certain steps, such as at “Process Distrib”, but don’t necessarily want all the macros to run every time you hit ”Process Distrib” for that particular deal, you can uncheck the “Should Run” flag and iManage will remember to not run that particular macro on that step going forward.  However, the macro will still be attached to the step in case you choose to have the macro run – simply check the “Should Run” flag again.
- Previously, unchecking the flag would only prevent the macro from running if you immediately hit the “Process Distrib” button after.  The next time you hit “Process Distrib” on the deal, the macro would be enabled again and run.  Now, if you uncheck the “Should Run” flag on a certain macro, that macro will no longer run anytime you hit “Process Distrib” unless you check it again.
- Update Macro Manager Process to insert and update status to tblMacroProcessing (#12031) - SME: Mike Ortiz
- iManage will now record the details of when a macro is run on a deal via Macro Manager, such as the macro name, file used, date the macro was run, by whom, machine name and if the macro was done or skipped.
- Macro Manager List Consolidation (#11459) - SME: Mike Ortiz
- To speed up the Macro Manager process, iManage will now have iRibbon run the macros.  That means that the distrib (and/or whichever file is associated with the macros) will only open once while its macros are run.  You will no longer see the distrib opening multiples times, each time a macro that uses the distrib is being run.
- Add TIR Code 904 in Deal Setup as Monthly Reports (#12097) - SME: Kalan Jablonski
- If your deal requires a file to be posted to Pivot (publicly) and the Admin has been posting it manually, you may consider using the “Monthly Report” file type with TIR Code 904 that was just added to the Files setup options.
- Update Error Message at Importing (#11881) - SME: Neemit Desai
### In Data-Actions > Process > Import tab, when a user tries to import a csv file with a map that requires a txt file (or any combination of file type mismatch), the first thing iManage does is it checks for the file type.  Previously, it would throw an error about “index and length”, which was hard to decipher.  The error message has been updated to be more helpful:
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Local Packaging
- You may have noticed the packaging had reverted back to the J:/PDF folder last month.  That bug has been fixed so that packaging takes place on the C: local drive again to help speed up the process.
- Termination Form: Option to resend email notification (#11999) – SME: Neemit Desai
- On a final payment, after you fill out the Termination Form for the first time, it will send a notification to various parties.  The next time the form opens, it will give users the option to re-send the email or not to help prevent the email recipients from getting duplicate notifications.
- Update the restate & late dropdown options (#11891) – SME: Jae Choi
- The Revision form has been further enhanced with field names and to enforce the required fields to be populated.  When you hit Revise, you will be required to select the appropriate Main Category, Sub Category, and Revision indicator.  You will notice that the “Finish” button will not appear until the Main and Sub Cat fields are populated.  However, the Revision Identification field must also be populated and you will get an error message if you forget to do so before you can complete the revision.
- Revision Identifier (#11905) – SME: Jae Choi
- The new Revision Identifier field in the Revision form is used to identify the party that found the error which resulted in the revision.
- Need to Capture QPA Again (#12055)
- Now that the QPA feature only loads upon clicking the QPA button on the My Deals screen, we can begin capturing the QPA again, without fear of it slowing down the screen.
- When you click on the QPA button, it will load the default QPA for that deal.  It will no longer show up as 0 minutes for all deals.
- If the deal took longer than usual to process, you can either manually enter the true time it took, ex. “1h30m”, or use the slider to adjust the time, and the revised time will be saved for the month.
- Confirm Date in Distrib is correct when signing off in iManage for Bond Reporting deals (#12045) – SME: Vince Tran
- For Bond Reporting deals, iManage will now check the distrib's month and year when loading the payment range data (at Processor Signoff) to ensure the correct information is imported.
- iManage for iTax :: Add a Tax Deal Folder button to the GG from to open the defined tax folder (#
- 12052) – SME: Keagan Delfosse
- A “Tax Deal Folder” button has been added to the Going Green form for easier access during tax signoffs.
- iManage for Tax: Create logic to highlight deals that are past due (1066 and 1041) in the Annually screen (#12046) – SME: Carrie Reynolds
- The Tax Processing > Annually screen has been enhanced to highlight deals that are past due (1066 and 1041).
- Even if the deal has been completed, if it was delivered after the Due Date, it will remain highlighted.
- If the deal was extended, it will only be highlighted if the current date is past the extension date or if it was delivered after the extension date.
- iManage for Tax: Quarterly signoffs - create extra sub-folders for Trustee or OT (#12047) and Add a sub-folder layer of Boston or Irvine under T:\TAX\_Qs for sending\Emailed\ (#12053)  – SME: John Tavares
- To help track the files delivered, the _Qs for sending folder creation has been updated to include new sub-folders for Boston/Irvine under the Emailed/Mail by USPS folders.  In addition, new OT sub-folders will be created under the date folder for files that need to be sent to Outside Trustees.
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
- Add views to archived tables (#12001) – SME: Sudh Karmarkar
### New functions have been created to allow users to easily query data that has been archived:
- SELECT * FROM dbo.fnLoanMonthlyAYByDID(@DID) – use to query all historical tblLoanMonthly data
- SELECT * FROM dbo. fnServAYByDID(@DID) – use to query all historical tblServ data
- SELECT * FROM dbo. fnCalcAYByDID (@DID) – use to query all historical tblCalc data For example, SELECT * FROM dbo.fnLoanMonthlyAYByDID('csfb 2006-heat7').
- iManage for Tax: Update logic Tax Status Reports for Location (#11996) – SME: John Tavares The Tax Status Reports have been updated to be based on the office that the tax reports are PROCESSED, rather than by which office does the filing as before.
## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.2.1.7.docx>
- Version 6.2.1.6 (Release Date: 6/1/2019)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:26 PM
### The latest version of iManage introduces a new Deal Setup tab called “Add’l Info” that is associated with the Portfolio Metrics project.  Here are the highlights:
- For new deals - when adding an Initial Task template, you will see a new task named "Update Deal Setup-Additional Info" that is due prior to first payment.  o When you try to sign off that task, it will check to make sure that at least the "Deal
### Type" field is populated in the Add’l Info tab.  If not, you will get the following error:
- o The new task has been added to the Bond, Converted, Backup Servicing,
- Exchangeable, Resec, and Collateral Initial Tasks templates o The task will not be added to legacy deals as those deals will be backfilled with the necessary information.
- When signing off approvals, if the task hasn't been completed by the second payment, you will get a hard stop.  Again, this will not be an issue for legacy deals that have passed their second payment.
- Below are the details of the bug fixes and other enhancements that were just released.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the setup process.
- Reports: Extra space between columns / columns repeating (#11988)
- Report packaging logic has been further enhanced to help speed up the process.  iManage will now generate all the Crystal reports simultaneously instead of sequentially – “Pre-fetching.  We had actually introduced this concept early last month, but you may recall that we had issues with certain pages generating with too much space between columns or certain sections repeating.  This ticket addresses that bug while allowing for “pre-fetching” of the Crystal reports.
- New iManage command line functions : Data Process, Auto Report, Accept Data (#11979, 11974, 11972) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- Data Process, Auto Report and Accept Data have all been added to Macro Manager to be performed to any sign off step you set it up on.
- ACS NUM - Bug Cannot Save Field (#11981) – SME: Theresa Rabkin
- As noted in the last release, data in the ACS Number field could previously not be edited via the interface.  This ticket enhanced the Misc screen to allow the data to be changed as needed.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Update Distrib Unlocking Logic (#11887) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- When locking or unlocking the distrib, if the file is corrupted, iManage will stop its attempt.  The file won't be even partially unlocked, nor in shared mode.   You will get a pop-up asking to hit the cancel button on the userform (though there's no userform).  At that point, you should open the distrib to clean it up or restore a working version that iManage can lock/unlock.
- Bug Fix: #9780 no longer working with Processor Signoff button (#11956) – SME: Kimberly Ghia If Analysts forget to import the CUSIPS (Deal Setup > Basic Info > Cert Info) for their new deals, after the first period, iManage will automatically import the data into the Cert Info screen (tblCertInfo) from tblPmtInfo at Processor Signoff.  Please note that this only applies to non-UK, Bond deals.
- Bug Fix: Bond allocation requirement (#11913) – SME: Kimberly Ghia
### To reinforce the rule that every Bond deal must have a distinct Processor and Reviewer assigned to it:
### The Allocations screen has been enhanced so that you cannot change a deal that is currently assigned to a user as Processor to no one for the Processor.  If you try, you will get the following error:
- At Reviewer Signoff, iManage will check to make sure a Processor, who is not the same person as the Reviewer, is assigned to the deal.  If there is no one assigned as Processor, you will be forced to assign someone else as the Processor in order to proceed with the approval.
- Note: If, as the Reviewer, you are covering for the Processor, you will still be able to sign off, as long as someone other than yourself is the assigned Processor.
- Bug Fix: EvID 99 in tblProcessLog (#11907) – SME: Kimberly Ghia
- When a deal is revised, users are required to answer if the revision is a Tasks Force issue.  If users hit
- "Yes", EvID 99 is inserted into tblProcessLog for that deal/period to flag the revision as a Task Force issue.  However, EvID 99 was being recorded even if users hit "No” – that bug has been fixed.
- iManage for Tax: Add Deliver button to the Tax Monthly screen (#11900) – SME: Mirela Berberi A Deliver button has been added to the Tax Processing > Monthly screen.
- The button is purely optional, and a Sent date will not be recorded if used.
- It was set up to be used exclusively for the GNMA deals.  When clicked, iManage will copy the latest MDFR file from F:\Reports\{DID} and paste it to the staging folder and renamed so it can be correctly picked up and posted to Pivot.
- The Deliver button can only be used on the top portion of the Monthly screen.  You can select multiple deals and deliver them at once.
- iManage for Tax: Daily Folder Not getting created for quarterly deliveries (#11908) – SME: Carrie Reynolds
- When hitting Deliver in the Tax Processing > Quarterly screen, the daily folders were not getting created under T:\Tax\_Qs for sending\Mail by USPS\Irvine (or Boston).  This bug has been fixed – if the folder doesn’t exist, iManage will attempt to create the folder again.
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
## Update Issues Task Force and Processing Notes Links (#11985 & 11986) – SME: Neemit Desai With the migration of Sharepoint to its new home, iManage had to be updated to open the new Issues Task Force and Processing Notes sites when called upon.
### Issues Task Force - once you click Yes to the “is this a Task Force issue?” question in the Revisions or I Found Something forms, iManage will open the new path:
- https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/Lists/Issues Task Force/AllItems.aspx so you can easily submit the issue.
## Processing Notes – when signing off on the “Create Deal Notes” Initial Task or when using the “Open processing notes” Run feature, iManage will know to look at the new site for the deal notes: https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/ProcessingNotes/
- tblMasterDeal incorporated into Flexible Remittance Summary (#11554) – SME: Neemit Desai Master Deal – Sub Deal logic has been integrated with the Flexible Remittance Summary.
### Pre-requisites:
- Must enable Master Deal in Data-Actions > Setup > Custom Action Configuration > Action Type: Maintenance Tab > Master Deal (as shown below)
- Setup up the Master Deal data under the master deal’s maintenance screen
- Must have any Flexible Remittance Summary setup for master deal and underlying deals
### Once pre-requisites are met, please see instructions below:
- Select the MASTER DID (as you have defined in the Master Deal tab)
- Go to Data – Actions > Setup > Advanced Settings
- Under the Reporting Section there should be an option called ‘SubDeal Flex Remit Rpt’.  Select ‘Y’ in the Drop Down.
- Click the Insert button near the top right.  The function should now be enabled.
- Note:  If you enable this function AFTER processing, you will need to re-click Accept Data for the stored procedure to kick off.
- 1063 Map - Import Fail (#11984) – SME: Vicki Huo
- After the release of iManage 6.2.1.5, map 1063 stopped working properly.  This should be fixed now.
- Reporting - ACIS Forward Loan Level File (#11557) – SME: Brian Scheff
- At the end of processing the LLD file using iMap 1767, iManage will now correctly parse out the ACIS loans to their respective Reference Pool files.
- iManage - STACR Maintenance Tab Remit Summary (#11840) – SME: Brian Scheff
- There was a bug that prevented users from updating values within the STACR Remit Summary
- Maintenance tab.  That bug should be fixed now and users should no longer have to use the workaround of inserting a second row and deleting it after making the changes needed in the original row.

## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.2.1.5.docx>
- Version 6.2.1.4 (Release Date: 3/30/2019)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:26 PM
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the setup process.
- Add Country Code to Deal Setup for NYSE (#11620) – SME: Neemit Desai
- The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) has been added to the Date code logic in Deal Setup > Dates.  Please note that NYSE holidays differ slightly from US holidays.  Example: Good Friday is a NYSE holiday, but not a federal holiday.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- 11510 Followup/Fix (#11664) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- Some of the logic from iTracker #11510 was revised to prevent confusion.
- The distrib must be locked before you can complete any of these steps:  a) Processor Signoff, b) Reviewer Signoff, c) Looksee/Final Signoff and d) Send.
- Note: The hard stop has been removed from Receive, Process Distrib/Review Sheet,
- Processor/Reviewer Tasks, etc.  iManage will allow you to continue with any of these signoffs if the distrib is unlocked.
- When locking the distrib back up (by someone other than the person who originally unlocked it), the message has been changed to "This deal must be locked before signoff. Deal was unlocked by XXX."
- Only the assigned verifier should be able to verify the deal*.  If you attempt to verify a deal that is not assigned to you, the verification option will be disabled.
- Locked Deal Verification Open to Managers (#11673) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- *In addition to the assigned verifier, any Manager will be able to verify changes on any deal.  The end result is that only the assigned verifier and any Manager are now able to verify a deal.
- iManage - Sort by [Due Date] - secondary sort for custom payment dates (#11534) – SME: Kim Ghia When sorting the My Deal screen by Due Date, the deals will be listed by Due Date.  If multiple deals have the same due date, they will be further sorted by Actual Payment Dates.  If multiple deals have the same due date and actual payment dates, they will then be sorted by DID in alphabetical order.
- iManage Macros Update (#11784) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- iManage will now check to see if the deal is locked for processing before running either the DataProcess or AcceptData macros via Macro Manager.  Just as if you were manually re-processing your data, if the deal was already processed and marked as Reviewed, you will need to get it unchecked.
- These are the messages you would get on the bottom right corner of the My Deals screen if those macros try to run and the data has already been processed.
- iManage Packaging Sets Distrib File Calc method to "Manual" (#11450) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- In order to speed up packaging times, when Packaging PDF, once iManage opens the distrib, it will set the Excel calculation method to “Manual”.  This will save time since Excel does not have to recalculate any formulas while the file is open.  Since the distrib file is not saved, this will not interfere with the deal team's preferred calculation method saved within the distrib.
- iManage for Tax: Add a “Clicked By Mistake” button (#11579) – SME: Courtney Harrington
- In each of the Tax Processing screens, an “Undo” button has been added to allow users to revert a sign off.   Previously, if a user decided to redo something prior to the deal being delivered, there was no way to start over without clicking Revise which sends an email notification that the deal is being revised, but it's not true.
### Rules:
- If deal/period status is “Done”, will not be able to use the Undo button.  Will be advised to use the
- Revise button instead, since it already wipes all out the signoffs and changes the status back to Ready.
- If deal/period status is “Rvwd”, clicking Undo would just wipe out the reviewed by date and change the status back to “Prcd”.
- If deal/period is “Prcd”, clicking Undo would wipe out the processed date and change status back to “Ready”.
### In the Monthly tax screen only (since hitting Process changes the status to Done):
- If the Reviewed On date is populated and then the user decides to hit Undo, only the Reviewed On date will be removed (and the status will remain as Done).
- If the Processed On date is populated and the user hits Undo, the Processed On date will be removed AND the status will be changed to “Ready”.
- iManage for Tax: Remove prior signoff controls for Annual signoffs  (#11697) – SME: Courtney Harrington
- Since the Tax team sometimes need to process/deliver multiple years in a row (revisions and terminations), the previous year completion check has been removed from the Tax Processing – Annually screen logic.  Please note that the related quarters must still be completed before you can sign off on the annual tax for the year.
- iManage for Tax: Extensions selected (#11825) – SME: Carrie Reynolds
- Previously, when extending individual or multiple tiers, iManage would generate the extension form for all of the deal’s tiers. Now, it will only generate the form for the selected tier(s).
- iManage for Tax: Daily folders for Qs and 1066s (#11672) – SME: Carrie Reynolds
- Previously, iManage would create empty daily folders under T:\TAX\_1066 staging for print or T:\TAX \_Qs for sending without adding any files to the folders.  This bug should be fixed now – the daily folders will only be created if there are files that need to be delivered on that day.
- Please refer to the SME listed for each item or, you can always reach out to me, if you have any questions on any of the above.

- Version 6.2.1.3 (Release Date: 3/2/2019)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:26 PM
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the setup process.
- Support Package page selector not recognized by iManage (#11679) – SME: Yuan Li-Crouch
- As previously communicated, iManage was not being able to generate support packages if only selecting certain pages of a pdf file.  That bug has been fixed and you can resume populating the desired pages in the file mask again.
- Expand the Allocations grid (#11580)
- The grid in the Allocations screen has been widened, which is especially helpful for Tax allocations as you can now see the entire DID and the type.
- Allocations Screen Bug - London Office (#11660)
- The Allocations screen has also been updated to allow for assignment of deals to UK users.
- UK imanage project multiple delivery date child deal setup automation (#11739) – SME: Dona Werth When a UK child deal is added to iManage (DID#), many of the Deal Setup fields will automatically populate with the same data as the parent deal (except for the First Distrib Date, Deal Folder, Distrib Tax Range, and Bond Reporting fields).
- If a parent deal already exists when child deal is inserted, the auto updating fields will be updated with matching parent field value. What you originally imported will be replaced with parent field value.
- If a parent deal does not exist when child deal is inserted, what you imported will stay until the parent deal is inserted and updating process starts at that point.
- If a parent deal is updated after the child deal is already inserted, the child deal auto updating fields will be auto updated right after parent deal change.
- Note:  If you want to update any auto updating fields, you can only do it in the parent deal, not the child deal, as they will be wiped out and replaced with the parent field value.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Revision Pop-Up: Issues Task Force missing link (#11726) – SME: Neemit Desai
- When revising a deal (via My Deals > Revise button), you must answer if the revision is an 'Issue Task Force'-related incidence.  If you choose Yes, once you hit Finish, iManage will automatically open the Issues Task Force Sharepoint page so you can easily file your submission.
- iManage for Tax: Change Annual Signoff Logic (#11587) – SME: Carrie Reynolds
### The Tax Processing - Annually signoff logic has been updated so that individual TERMINATING tiers can be don.  When one tier terminates before the rest of the deal, please do the following:
- Populate the tier’s Termination Date in Deal Setup > Main Info > Tax and hit Update (to the right)
- Refresh iManage
- In Tax Processing > Annually, select that tier and hit Process.
- When doing the Going Green tasks, you will notice there is a “1066 Terminate Remic” file to check, specifically for the terminating tier.  iManage will archive the terminating tier’s 1066 file by itself and the 1066 package for the entire deal separately.
- Note:The RemicID must be set up for the terminating tier (in tblHolder_Remic) so iManage knows how to differentiate the files.
- Once you process the 1066 for the rest of the deal, the Going Green tasks will pull up the 1066 package (that includes the 1066 for all the tiers) like normal.  You will also see the previously checked 1066 file for the terminated tier.
- Note: A separate ticket will address how the process should work when REVISING individual tiers.  The main issue with revising an individual tier right now seems to be that it’s sweeping all the 1066 files to the folder.  The team will have to delete the non-revised ones manually.
- iManage for Tax: Form updates for Extensions (#11581) – SME: Carrie Reynolds
- In the Tax Processing - Annually screen, when creating extensions, iManage will now auto update the initial year / final year check boxes and populate associated dates on Form 7004.
- Initial Year Extensions o For any tier wherein the StartDt is within the year extended (i.e. 2018 tax year with a StartDt of 8/1/2018/first payment of 8/27/2018) ….
- Form 7004 will update the “beginning” date to reflect the same and check the “Initial return” box
- Final Year Extensions o For any tier wherein the Termination Date is within year extended (i.e. 2018 tax year with a TerminationDate of 12/17/2018)…
- Form 7004 will update the “ending” date to reflect the same and check the “Final return” box
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
- Sidebar clean-up and Addition of Troubleshooting Tool (#11745)
### Sidebar Clean Up – the left panel of iManage was getting too busy so the following items were moved to the Help pull-down menu:
- Addition of a Troubleshooting Tool – “Problem Recorder”
- If you run into an error and need to report an iTracker ticket, it is helpful for the developers to see the steps you took prior and up to running into an issue.  You can record these steps using the Problem Recorder tool accessed through the Help menu (see above).  Simply record the steps and once done, save the zip file it creates.  Attach the zip file to the ticket for reference.
- Shelves added per ticket 9997 are causing issues with QPA shelves (#11625) – SME: Maggie Foertsch Deal shelves have been separated from QPA shelves to prevent bad reporting for management.
- Reporting - Mortgage Loan Characteristics DSCR Table (#11744) – SME: Brian Scheff
- The Mortgage Loan Characteristics DSCR table used to post a % sign.  Given that this is a ratio, the % sign for the ranges were inaccurate and management agreed that the sign should be removed (i.e. 0.000% 0.490%, should be 0.000 - 0.490).

- Version 6.2.1.2 (Release Date: 2/2/2019)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:26 PM
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the setup process.
- 10045 Followup (#11629) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- Three new macros were added to Macro Manager to mimic the actions that are normally done in the Data – Actions > Process screens.
- Macro called "DataProcess” – will run the same sproc as if you were to hit Process in the
- Discrepancy tab.  If there are any error popups, this macro would result in a "fail"
- Macro called "AcceptData” – will run the same sproc as if you were to hit Accept Data in the
- Discrepancy tab.  If there are any popups, this macro would result in a "fail"
- Macro called "AutoReport” - same as pressing the "Auto Report" button in the Export tab.
- Allow for actual dist date to be masked in Support Package File Mask (#11527) – SME: Kevin Butz
- Date code logic within the Support Package file masks recently stopped working, but is now fixed.  If you want to use a file that has a date, such as the payment date, within the file name, you can resume using the date code masks to pull the file name in correctly.
### For example, if the file is named “TPAT 2018-SL1 Distribution Report 2019.01.25.xlsx”, you can use the following file mask to pull it in:
- Please refer to the Support Package Setup instructions on Sharepoint – IR Resource Library for all the file masks available for use.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Process Bug Fix: Clicked By Mistake (CBM) Issues (#11478) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- Hopefully, this ticket addresses all the bugs that were preventing you from approving/sending deals after Clicking by Mistake.  However, please keep in mind that you will still have to CBM multiple times to correctly clear your signoffs.  Please refer to the main “button” to see which step you are at and don’t rely solely on the time stamps.
- For example, as the Processor, you have to hit 1) Receive, 2) Process Distrib, 3) Processor Tasks and 4) Processor Signoff.  If you already completed step 4, but decide you need to re-process your distrib and regenerate the package, you will need to CBM twice.  If you only CBM once to clear the “Processed By” time stamp, you only reverted to the Processor Tasks step.  Therefore, you will need to CBM once more to get back to the Process Distrib button.
- If the button is at “Processor Signoff” and you CBM, it will clear out the Final Package task signoff.  This was intentional to have you acknowledge that something was reverted - if you don't repackage, then you’ll just have to open the existing file in the repository and mark it off again.
- If you are ever stuck, hit the Show Tasks Form button to verify whether or not all of the Processor (green)/Reviewer (blue) tasks are completed as expected. If not, re-do the tasks to get everything back on track.
- In addition, the Reset button in the Going Green form has been updated.
- If the reset button is hit on the Final Package by either the Processor or Reviewer, the Final Package signoff will be removed and iManage will revert the deal back to "Process Distrib".
- If the reset button is hit on Review sheet, iManage will revert the deal back to Reviewer Tasks.
- If the Support Package is reset, the Support Package signoff will be removed and iManage will revert the deal back to "Process Distrib"
- Clicked By Mistake remove permissions (#11498) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- Security permissions have been removed from the Clicked By Mistake button.  Anyone will now be able to CBM to revert any step, except after the deal has already been sent.
- Updates to the Termination Form not sticking (#11632) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- Once the Processor populates the Termination Form, their inputs should stick so that when the form pops up for the Reviewer, they will only have to confirm that the information is correct and hit Continue.  Previously, the Reviewer would be required to populate the form all over again before they could proceed.
- Update for revision reasons (#11559) – SME: Jae Choi
- The late/revision reasons have been updated to provide more details and the breakdown of the options shown on the form have been updated.
- iManage for tax: Monthly signoff on 1st month (#11659) – SME: Courtney Harrington
- The prior month check for monthly tax signoffs has been disabled when processing the first payment month of the deal.
- iManage for Tax: Remove prior signoff controls for Quarterly signoffs (#11539) – SME: Courtney Harrington
- To allow tax analysts to signoff multiple quarters at once, the prior quarter check has been disabled.
- iManage for Tax: Quarterly deliveries for Fractions Only (#11598) – SME: Carrie Reynolds
- Hitting Deliver in the Tax Processing - Quarterly screen for deals that only have Fractions services (not Schedule Q) will now sweep the MDFR file without issue, as long as the file is found in the source folder.
- iManage for Tax: Change Annual Signoff Logic (#11587) – SME: Carrie Reynolds – PARTIAL SOLUTION ONLY
### The Tax Process – Annually screen has been updated:
- There is an “Individual Process and Review” box visible, but it isn’t functional yet.  Basically ignore it.
- The Remicid column was added to the build and is just informational for now.
- Highlighting one tier will sign off all tiers (for Process, Review and Deliver) – same as before.
- As requested, highlighting one tier will revise only the selected tier.  It will no longer revise all the tiers of the deal.
- Note: This ticket is still open to enhance the Going Green process so that it could retain different versions of the 1066 for the same year, i.e. in cases where one tier terminates prior to all the other tiers.
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
- iManage - Time stamps and UI (#11593) – SME: Kimberly Ghia
- This ticket rolled back the logic that was deployed via #10282.  Now, the signoff tables will only record time stamps based on Central time to make management reporting more consistent.  This ticket does also address the original problem reported in #10282 so that the times shown on the UI will be converted to the user’s time zone (based on the time zone set up on their VDI).  Basically, the time stamps you see on the UI should make sense now – Received should be before Processed by, regardless of which time zone each step was done in.  iManage will indicate what time zone it has converted the time to.
### Example: This deal was signed off in California (11:43 a.m/12:12 p.m./12:36 p.m), but is saved in tblCompleted in Central time:
- If viewed by someone in Boston, they will see the time based on Eastern time.

- iManage performs a balance check at Reviewer signoff.  The form should pop only if the entire deal pays down to $0 (sum of bonds' beginning balance > 0 and the sum of the bonds' ending balance = 0).
- If the form is triggered by the above condition, it will not auto-populate the Termination Date to account for deals that stay active even after paying down to $0.
### The form was updated to allow users to confirm whether the deal is actually terminating or not.  Note:
- the form can be pulled up manually by hitting the Final Payment button or via the balance check performed by iManage.
### • A new section was added: "The deal has paid down to $0. Is this deal terminating?" o If you select Yes:
- You will be required to select the Termination Date within the form. Once a date is selected, iManage will auto-populate the Termination Date under Deal Setup > Basic Info > Dates.
- Just as before, you will be required to answer the Footnote question
### Once you hit Continue, an email notification will be sent to the deal team, Account Admin, Cash Analyst, GSFExtraordinaryBilling@usbank.com, GSFSecuritizedBilling@usbank.com ▪ Email notification body would include following text:
### All bonds of the trust are paying down this month, please reach out to IR analyst [assigned analyst] if you have any:
- --Additional funds to be distributed from any accounts that IR may not be aware of
- --Additional fees to pay/withhold

A message box will pop up stating "An email has been sent to the Account Admin and Cash Analyst to notify them that the bonds are being paid down to zero. Per best practices, please also call them to remind them of this termination." o If you select No:  The form will close and you will be able to continue to process as normal.
- 4)	At Reviewer Signoff - If the Processor initially entered a Termination Date and selected No for the footnote, the form should pop with all the details that the Processor already populated. The Reviewer will no longer have to complete the form again before they can approve.

Please let me know if you continue to see this issue going forward.

- iManage for Tax - Emailing feature to skip Holders that have ended (#11536) – SME: Carrie Reynolds Tax Processing/Quarterly: When sending the quarterly files, iManage will now take into account holder end dates (tblHolder_Remic.DtEnd). When GSF IR Support archives a terminated deal, a record is inserted into tblArchiveTerminatedDealLog.  When you click on the “Open Deal Folder” button, iManage will check that table and if the archive is active, iManage will open the archived folders from the K: drive.
- Note: If you need to reactivate a terminated deal, please reach out to GSF IR Support so they can correctly restore the deal and update the status of the deal in the table so that iManage doesn’t continue to look in the K: drive for the deal’s folders, when it should be opening normal Production folders (J:, M:, and T:).

- For Tax Analysts: You should no longer get the following error when selecting a Table in the DMT.

## Emergency Release Notes
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the setup process.

You will get a hard stop if there are any empty/blank rows detected in your txt file.   Please note that you will not get an email notification so please pay attention to the warning message you get in iManage so you can know why it failed.

## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.2.1.1.docx>
- Version 6.2.1.0 (Release Date: 12/1/2018)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:26 PM
- In addition to normal enhancements and bug fixes, the newest version of iManage includes major additions for the Tax group to provide more accurate, consistent tax reporting and controls to meet internal status report requirements.
- You will notice a new “Tax Processing” screen under the menu – this is where all tax signoffs will occur (tax signoffs have been removed from the My Deals screen).  Only the Tax analysts will have access to the new screen.  In addition, there are several new tabs within Deal Setup and Allocations for tax are now done separately for Monthly, Quarterly and Annually duties.  The tax teams should expect training on the new process from their site’s SME in the near future.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the setup process.
- Bug fix: Cover Page Admin doesn't stick if adding one Admin to a deal (#11406)
- For new deals, you should now be able to add your Account Admin and flag them as the Cover Page contact without having to do any workarounds.
- In addition, the feature has been updated with different pop-ups to advise you of what may be wrong with your selection. Please keep in mind that for US deals, only one Account Administrator can be selected as the Cover Page contact.
### If you accidentally select the Cash Analyst (or any other contact) for Cover Page, you will get this pop-up:
### If you try to select two AA contacts for the Cover Page, you will get this pop-up:
- Need curtailment period flag added to iServ Advanced Settings (#10266) – SME: Julie Ji
- If your deal requires the Curtailment Period Start Date to be a specific date for the first payment, you can now use the new Data-Actions > Setup > Advanced Settings > Reporting > Cover Page > Deal Dates > Curtailment Period Start Date feature.
### If populated, as in this example:
- Only for the first payment date, the Starting Curtailment date should report as 4/16/18
- For every period after the first payment date, even if the Curtailment Period Start Date item is populated, the Starting Curtailment date should follow the old logic (not 4/16/2018)
- The Ending Curtailment date shall continue to use the old logic (no changes)
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Two PDFs scroll down simultaneously (#7898) – SME: Rodney Johnson
- The Going Green Tasks forms have been enhanced to include a Control button that will allow you to scroll through your prior and current files together, which should make comparing files much easier.
- To use, click on the Control button prior to opening any files and this form will pop-up.
- Open your files and then move the Control form front and center to use it.
- You have to be inside the form to use mouse scroll up and down to control pdfs up and down.
- Using the keyboard, you can use Tab to switch between buttons and click Enter to execute
- Use PageUp, PageDown, Home, End and Esc keyboard shortcut in the control • If you don't like to scroll, click the timer for auto repeat last command 10 times.
- Use Timer horizontal scroll to control speed
- Use Range horizontal scroll to control the up or down range
- Use Opacity horizontal scroll to change form's visibility
- Check status bar for info
- Due date for custom payment dates (#10274) – SME: Kimberly Ghia
- The due date for custom payment dates will now be based on the custom payment date, not the random scheduled payment selected.  This change should prevent these deals from being counted late when they are not.
- iManage - Sort By [Due Day] for custom payment dates (#11474) – SME: Kimberly Ghia
- In the My Deals screen, the Sort By Due Day is now based off the correct due date on deals with custom payment dates so you will be less likely to miss a deal that is actually due.
- Input Manager tab update (#10215) – SME: Mike Ortiz Numerous updates that will be communicated by Mike.
- Disable the Clicked By Mistake button after Send for Collateral Deals (#9745) – SME: Sudh Karmarkar To be consistent with the best practice of only being able to Revise after a deal has been Sent, the Clicked by Mistake button will be disabled for Collateral deals after they have been Sent.
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
- Cover page Report change (#11501) – SME: Dona Werth
- Per Management’s request, the Cover Page has been updated so that the word “Monthly” has been removed and the word “Report” has been moved down to the same line as the distribution date.
- Quick Search Enhancement - Global Duties (#11403) – SME: Neemit Desai
- The Quick Search function has been updated to display allocations for Global Duties so you can more quickly get to your signoff screen.
- Bug: Unable to pull files from the Investor Files tab (#11399) – SME: Neemit Desai In My Deals > Investor Files tab, the “See” button has been changed to “Opn”.
- As long as the file exists as shown in the File Location field, the file will open (xls, xlsx, csv, pdf files)
- If you are trying to open a zip file, it will open the location of the zip file so you can use whatever zip application installed on your computer to open the file
- If the file doesn’t exist, you will get an error stating “File not found”
- Although no changes were made to the “Get” button, it might be helpful to know that it will open a “Save As” dialog box and will allow you to save the selected file with a different name anywhere you want.  Keep in mind that you will have to include the file extension in the file name since you can't select a "Save as type".  For example, save the file as "Test.csv" instead of just "Test".
## Enhancements to the Release Notes feature (#9899)
## The Release Notes form has been updated to include a “View All” option so that users can see all the releases at once, instead of having to select each release individually.
- Senior Managers – you have the ability to generate your own announcement that will be broadcast to users when they open iManage using the “New Release” button.
## Once you hit “New Release”, a blank Release Notes form will open.  Fill out the Problem Title and Problem Description.  Once done, hit “Save New Rele” and your announcement will pop-up for users the next time they open iManage.

- Version 6.2.0.1 (Release Date: 10/30/2018)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:33 PM
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the setup process.
- Add a table to iManage to store Shelf and SME (#9997) – SME: Dona Werth
- You can now assign your deal to the related shelf in Deal Setup > Basic Info > Main Info (bottom of screen).  Hit Edit and select the appropriate Shelf from the drop-down list.  Once you save your update, the SME associated with the shelf will auto-populate, in case you have any questions.
- In addition, the Allocations > QPA Shelves tab has been renamed to QPA Groupings
- Add file masks to the ExcelPrintRange field for Support Packages (#10136/PI #486) – SME: Kevin Butz A new RangeMask field has been added to the Support Package setup screen that can be used if your tab name changes each period.  The new field utilizes the same masking logic that currently exists for the FileMask field. For example, if the Servicer names their tab by month, you can now setup the Support Package to capture that dynamically.
- Tip! You can find all the available masks here (and the IR Resource Library).
- 'Skip Large Wire' Other Settings - Access Rights (#11371) – SME: John Kavlich
- Per Senior Management, only Managers can enable/disable the “Skip Large Wire” setting on a deal now.
- If you believe your deal does not need the large wire check, please reach out to your Manager as the Reviewer can no longer enable the setting to skip it.
- Import: Remove Open Template button from iserv - Map tabs (#11386) – SME: Sudh Karmarkar The Open Template button has been removed from the Data-Actions > Maps screens.  Instead, please refer to the templateFile field for the path of the last successfully loaded file for your desired map.
- Flex Remit - export out current template (#11378) – SME: Jae Choi
- For those who create/update Flex Remit templates, you now have the ability to export the current template to make changes to it and reimport.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Bug: Users unable to unlock distribs for deals that haven't gone through the Final 6 Months Review (# 11438) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- The Locking/Unlocking features have been fixed and should work as they did before.
### Add "Unlock Tracing" button to Verifier form (#10050) – SME: Mike Ortiz A few updates have been made to the Verifier form:
- An “UnLock Tracing” button has been added that allows you to open the distrib in Tracing mode directly from the Verifier form.
- The results under the Formula Changes and Non-Formula Changes grids now show the latest changes on top.
- After locking a deal, iManage will check for changes made in the tabs (waterfall, reports, anything with distrib in the name, anything with NIM in the name).  If there are none, you will be notified that there are no changes to be verified.
- Update "File was already locked" message (#10039)
- If you try to lock the distrib when it is already locked, the Locking form will pop-up.  Currently, if you enter a reason and hit Done in the Locking form, the form doesn't go away and multiple bad records can be inserted into tblLockLog with each attempt you make.
- The proper way to exit the form, in this case, would be to simply hit Cancel.  To prevent the bad records, a reminder to click Cancel has been added to the message that the file was already locked.
- Refresh issue with Lock fields when going from a Collateral deal to a Bond deal (#9599) – SME: Brian Scheff
- Previously, in the My Deals screen, when switching from a Collateral deal to a Bond deal, the right panel would not get refreshed properly (would only show the Unlock and Lock buttons).  Now, iManage will properly refresh the screen when switching deal types and the right panel will show all the buttons and fields accordingly.
- Keep GG form open form (#11418) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- You can now run macros during the Processor/Reviewer Tasks step.  Previously, assigning a macro (via Macro Manager) to this step would cause the Going Green form to auto-close when you try to check a file.  If you assign a macro to this step, that macro will run once you hit Processor Tasks.  Once the macro is run, you can continue with checking your Support Package/Final Package/Reviewsheet as normal.
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
## Update Open Processing Notes Feature for Global Duties (#9270) iManage has been updated to allow you to pull the Processing Notes for Global Duties using the “Open processing notes” feature in My Deals - Run.
## You will need to select the Deal Notes Template type (on the right side of the Run button) first before hitting Run.
## iManage will search all the locations that the Processing Notes may be in and indicate in the bottom right corner where it is pulling the document from: 1) Sharepoint (Location: http://usbportal.us.bank-dns.com/sites/ct/gsfinvestorreporting/ProcessingNotes), 2) if not there, N:\Processing Notes\Upload to SharePoint, 3) if not there, N:\Processing Notes\In Progress • If notes do not currently exist for the Global Duty, iManage will open a blank template with all the “deal” information auto-populated to get you started.
- Restrict access to the Delete button in Contacts (#9892)
- The Delete buttons in Contacts > Company and Contact tabs have been disabled for all users, except for iManage Admin.  It is very rare that a contact would ever need to be deleted and keeping the open the button open to everyone can cause contacts to be mistakenly deleted. When a contact is accidentally deleted, they must be manually restored because there is no historical record kept of the deals’ contacts.
- Open Deal Folder action for archived deals (#11335)
- After a terminated deal is archived, its deal folders are all moved to the K: drive.  The Open Deal Folder button (for J:) in the My Deals screen and the Folder button in the Quick Search form have been updated to open the archived J: folder from K: if an archived terminated deal is selected.
- Merging HTML Converter with iManage (#11410) – SME: Mike Ortiz
- Mike will be releasing a new iRibbon that will include a new macro called "PDF2HTM_IR".
- Run it and a file dialog pops up - navigate to your source folder and select the pdf(s) you want converted.
- Once selected, the following box will come up (see below).
- Push the “Convert to HTM” button and all the pdfs will be converted to HTML and saved to the same source folder as the pdf.  Note: the filenames will have any capitals, spaces and dashes removed.
- This macro has the exact same functionality as the PDFtoHTML Converter program that currently exists in iManage (except that within iManage, it could only convert files generated by iManage).  The macro allows you to convert any PDF to HTML.
- New SSRS Report to Identify Terminating Deals (#11341) – SME: Matt Beu
- A new SSRS report has been created to identify deals that paid down to $0 in any given period.

- Final Model Review unlocking doesn't need shared mode (#10049) – SME: Mike Ortiz
