- Enhancement to iManage PDF Xchange Screen display - Enable FlipScreens when using one monitor (# 9750)
### Currently, the default setting for PDFs to open during the Going Green process is to have the Prior PDF open on the right side and Current PDF open on the left side.  For users that use only one monitor to work and would like the option to have the PDFs open on flipped sides, you can now request your personal setting be updated to do just that.  Please email me if you would like your Going Green settings to be updated with any of the following options:
- FlipScreens will change your personal default setting to open the Prior PDF on the left and the Current PDF on the right.  This applies for when VDI is used on one monitor or two.
- ForceSingleScreen will change your personal default setting to open both PDFs on the right monitor (current on left, prior on right)
- Enabling both settings will change your personal default setting to open both PDFs on the right monitor (prior on left, current on right)
- You can also request that the PDFs open at a different percentage zoom than the default 87%

- "Sample Report."
- Field 1066Sig of tblSetup in DMT (iTax) (#11304) – SME: Pai-Yun Liu
- The DMT has been updated to pull in the data correctly for the SNRSUB.tblSetup.1066Sig field.
- GCT on splash image when opening app
- As part of the new brand architecture restructuring initiative, when launching iManage, you will see a quick flash of our business line name that was updated to “Global Corporate Trust – Structured Finance”.

## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.1.6.1.docx>
- Version 6.1.6.0 (Release Date: 8/6/2018)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:36 PM
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the setup process.
- Auto Report not pulling in the correct saved export reports (#10181)
- A reminder has been added to the Data-Actions > Export screen to make sure you hit Edit and then Save if you want to add (or remove) any file under the Export Text File section to your deal’s Auto Report.
- Mass Add/Transfer feature in the Allocations screen not working for Final Review section (#10154) In the Allocations screen, the Add/Transfer features have been fixed for the Final Review section.  Previously, neither feature worked for the Final Review section, but worked fine for the Processing and Reviewing sections.
- Bug fix: Unable to make changes to the Deal Setup > Tax Platform field (#10171)
- In Deal Setup > Basic Info, edits to the Tax Platform field is now saving correctly.    Previously, changes to the field was not sticking.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to processing.
- Error message loading 1132 map file for FNMA 96-M2 (#10242)
- You should no longer get the following error when using certain maps.
- Update Export Support button to pull files from M: drive’s TempSupportFiles folder (#10210)
- The Data-Actions > Export > Export Support button has been updated to match the code for the My Deals > Supp Package button.
### When you click on the Export Support button, it should pull any doc, pdf and txt files from the following locations:
- File masks (Setup > Deal Report Setup > Support Package Reports)
- M:\<Deal Folder>\TempSupportFiles\YYYY\M
- M:\<Deal Folder>\CERTS\YYYY\M
- Note: You should no longer be using the J:\{DealFolder}\Support\TempSupportFiles folder to save temp files.  In order to keep the J: drive lean and to allow for historical archiving of temp files, you should be saving them in M:\<Deal Folder>\TempSupportFiles\YYYY\M instead.  Later this week, I will run a macro to delete all empty J:\...\TempSupportFiles folders.  If any files are found in your deal’s J:\...
- \TempSupportFiles folder, you will be asked to move them to M: or delete them out, so please be on the lookout for that email.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- tblMetricsDeal not capturing QPAs for most deals (#10127)
- QPAs were not being recorded consistently for the past few months, but that bug should be resolved now.
- Remove terminated deal from Allocations (#10198)
- If you forgot to populate the Termination Date for a deal in a prior period and the deal still shows up in your current allocations, populating the Termination Date will remove the deal from your My Deals view (even when the “All Nontax” box is checked).
- If you accidentally click Received on the deal in the current period, you can simply Click By Mistake to remove the sign off and then populate the Termination Date with last month’s payment date to remove the deal from your view.
- Update how the My Deals allocation is driven by the Termination Date (#10217)
- If a deal is terminating this period, it will continue to be listed in the My Deals screen, as long as it is being signed off prior to the payment date.  Previously, the My Deals screen was driven by the
- Termination Date vs. the current date.  It has been updated to check the Termination Date vs. the actual payment date.
- Background: There were instances when users accidentally selected a Termination Date (day) that is prior to the deal’s actual payment date because the Termination Form date selection defaults to the current date.  This caused the deal to disappear from their’s and the deal reviewer’s allocation lists for the current month and the deal was never completed.
### Now, if the selected Termination Date is different from the Actual Payment Date, you will get a pop-up advising you of the discrepancy:
- Selecting Yes will allow you to continue signing off on the off-schedule final payment.
- Selecting No will allow you to select the correct Termination Date through the Termination Form (which updates Deal Setup)
- Update the All NonTax filter in the My Deals screen to include Fund Accounting deals (#10218) Fund Accounting deals have been added to the All NonTax filter in the My Deals screen, both when used in the UI filter or if set as your default view under Action > User Startup Preference.
- Allow manual sending of linked DID pmt ranges in iManage (#9885)
- The "Create Files" and "Snd" buttons for the payment file in the My Deals > Investor Files tab has been updated to work for linked deals.  Previously, normal delivery of the main deal would create/sweep the payment files for all of its linked deals, but the Create Files and Snd buttons would only do so for the main deal.  Now, if the payment files for all the deals (main and linked) need to be re-created or re-sent, users can do so without revising the main deal.
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
- Rewrite iManage Access Security Logic (#11295)
- Access to iManage is determined by a specific Active Directory (AD) entitlement that everyone in IR has been assigned.  In the off-chance that someone outside of our department installs iManage on their computer and tries to access it, iManage will check to make sure they have that AD membership.  If they don’t, they will not be able to open iManage.
- Some IR users encountered this check last month when opening and processing in iManage, due to an unknown cause.  iManage has been updated to only do the check during opening of the app so you should no longer get the error while processing.  If you get the error upon launching iManage, closing and reopening iManage should work.  Either way, please let me know if you run into this error going forward.
- Add AgencyCID as a key filter in DMT iTax tblAgencyExport (#10222)
- The AgencyCID field has been added as a key filter in DMT > iTax > tblAgencyExport.  If you want to make a change to a specific deal/class, first filter by the AgencyCID on the top section, click Filter and then further filter down by the DID, then hit Modify.  This will allow you to make changes to each individual class record separately.
## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.1.6.0.docx>
- Version 6.1.5.0 (Release Date: 6/30/2018)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:36 PM
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the setup process.
- Add file masks to the FileTypeDefault field in tblMacroDealSetup (#10137)
- Deal Setup > Macro Manager allows macros to be run on files other than the distrib by inputting the full file path in the "File" column.  However, if a file was saved in a monthly folder or the filename itself included a date, the date info needed to be updated each month.  You can now use the same files masks that are used for the Support Packages in the “File” field in Macro Manager for dates.
- After updating the file path with the file masks, hit the <Enter> key on your keyboard to trigger the Save button
- Hit Save to save the changes
- Correct the Add Bond Level File button to add the ”auto-generated” files (#9727)
- In Deal Setup > Files > Add, when clicking the Add button for "Add Bond Level File", iManage will insert the "auto generated" version of the Bond file to the deal.  Previously, it was incorrectly adding the nonauto generated file instead.
- At the Restricted pop-up, hitting Yes will let Pivot know that the file should be posted in the Secure tab and hitting No will make the file Public.
- Fix the Map Setup feature (for importing cutoff by Underwriter) (#9787)
- In Data-Actions > Setup > Deal Info tab (for importing cutoff maps by Underwriter), the Map Setup feature has been fixed.
- You will no longer get an error (“There is no row at position 0”) when pressing the Map Setup button.
- In the Mapping screen, after selecting a map and hitting Assign, you will have the choice to add an existing map to your deal or to make a copy of the map (so you can edit the map as needed).  Previously, you could only make a copy of a map, unnecessarily adding new maps to the database that weren't needed.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Enable the Revise button only after a deal has been delivered (#9995)
- The Revise button can now only be pressed after a deal has been delivered, per best practices.
- Previously, since it was enabled throughout the entire approval process, an accidental click of the button would trigger a retraction email that would confuse the Admins.
- 2 minor UI updates to iManage (Input Manager related) (#10085)
- In the "My Deals" screen, in the form that pops up after hitting the "Macros" button, buttons for "Select All" and "Select None" have been added for easy mass selections.
- In Deal Setup>Processing tab, the "Save" button above the "New Input" button (see below) now has the exact same permission as the "New Input" button.
- Add 10 seconds to the timer for packaging (#10116)
- We added 10 seconds to the package merging process to allow it to actually finish before iManage thinks it's done.  Users are constantly reporting that the final packages are generating with just a cover page, table of contents and then a blank page OR links fail to get added.  We believe the merging process is taking longer than iManage expects, i.e. even though the black boxes on the right corner goes through all the pages, the actual merging of the pages (PDF and Excel) in the J:\{Deal Folder}\PDF folder may still be in process, but since the black boxes finish running, the merging process stops before it is done.  The hope is adding 10 seconds to the merging process will resolve both issues.
- Note: We understand that packaging PDF has been taking much longer than usual lately and IT has confirmed a slowdown on the SQL side.  They are actively working on a remediation plan to get things back to normal.
- Enhancement to Termination Footnote Form - Revise function (#10133)
- When a user clicks 'Revise' on a completed deal, the prior appended termination disclosure/footnote page will be removed from the report package and the Termination Form will be wiped out for the processing of the revision.  The deal team will have to re-populate the termination form, if needed, during the processing/signoff workflow.
- Lock and Verifier Distrib change updates to SQL (#10146)
- The Locking box has been updated to more accurately capture changes to the distrib.  The first grid will display only Formula Changes whereas the second grid will display all other changes in any of the sheets checked in the Distrib Change Tracking feature.
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
- Map 1619 enhancement (#10044)
### Map 1619 (CMSA Property file) has been enhanced so that it can load the data, regardless of whether or not the original file has headers, has commas, etc.  Analysts should no longer have to reformat their property files when using the map.  The following scenarios were addressed:
- Loading files with 1 and 2 headers, as well as with no headers (old way of doing it)
- Files with commas
- Files with incorrect end balance (zeros, nulls, wrong bal) • File with headers with the below variations: o 1,2,3
- Col 1, Col 2, Col 3 o Col1, Col2, Col3 o COL001, COL002,COL003 o Transaction ID
- Transaction_ID o Loan_ID o Loan ID o LoanID o Loan
- Add 'Fund Accounting' as a drop-down option in the Allocations tab in iManage (#10134)
- Fund Accounting deals can now be assigned to a separate deal team through the Allocations tab.  Previously, these deals would default assign to the same deal team as the Bond deal of the same name which didn’t make sense since Fund Accounting deals may need to be assigned to different analysts.  The deals can be pulled into the My Deals screen under the “Fund Accounting” type.
- Note: A ticket has been submitted to include Fund Accounting deals in the All NonTax filter.
## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.1.5.0.docx>
- Version 6.1.4.0 (Release Date: 6/1/2018)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:36 PM
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the setup process.
- Error importing 'Payment' range to Cert Info tab (#9963)
- Previously, iManage was unable to import data into the Cert Info tab in Deal Setup > Basic Info for certain class names.  That bug has been fixed.
- The following update(s) are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Multi Process with deals using Macro Manager (#9741)
- Multi Process should work now at (almost*) each step of the new approval process.  We have also removed the late check at the beginning of Multi Process since you will still have to enter the “reason for late” when approving the deals anyway.
- Note: We found out late into testing that Multi Process does not work for the Reviewer for Reviewer Signoff.  If you try to Multi Process Reviewer Signoff, you will get a “User is not authorized to perform action” error.  Until the bug is fixed, please manually complete the Reviewer Signoff on each individual deal.
- Enhance the Termination Form (#9996)
- The Termination Form has been updated to save prior inputs so the Reviewer doesn’t have to repopulate the form if the Processor already did.  The Termination Form will pop-up if you hit Final Payment or if iManage calculates that the deal is paying down to $0.
- At Processor Signoff, when iManage imports the payment range, it will check to see if the bonds are paying down to $0.  If so, the Termination Form will pop-up.  If you had already filled out the form (by pressing Final Payment), you can hit Continue or make any changes, if needed.
- For the check that is done at Reviewer's Signoff, if the Processor has already completed the form (by selecting to add the footnote with a holdback amount) and generated the package with the Disclosure, the form should pop with all the details that the Processor already populated.
- The Reviewer should be able to hit "Continue" if they agree with the holdback amount already populated and move on with the approval process.
- If the Reviewer disagrees with the amount, they should be able to edit the amount and hit Continue and be reminded to regenerate the package.
- Note: This is not a hard stop.  The signoff will continue, so please heed the reminder to regenerate the package and re-do signoffs if the holdback amount needs to be revised.
- If the Processor didn't completed the form previously, then the Reviewer would need to complete the form (if the deal is paying down to $0)
- Internal Files - Open Feature not working correctly (#9665)
- The archived files feature has been fixed to pull old approved statements that may be needed for reference after a revision.
### As a reminder, the My Deals > Internal Files tab will list all the files that were approved through Going Green for the deal/period selected.  If the file is listed as “True” in the Stored in Repository column, you can:
- Click on “Download Clean Copy” to download an unmarked copy of the last approved version of the file to the deal’s PDF folder as {DID}_{FILE}_MMYYYY_Clean.pdf
- Click on “Download Marked Copy” to download the check-marked copy of the last approved version of the file to the deal’s PDF folder as {DID}_{FILE}_MMYYYY_Marked.pdf
- Click on “Open Archive” to list any older versions of the files that were approved.  (Only available after a deal is revised)  If available, you can select to open either a Marked or Clean version of the file.
- In the example below, the deal was revised twice (hence 2 versions of each of the files in the Archive).  Remember, using the Download Clean/Marked Copy buttons will download the most current, revised files whereas the Archived files will be the original files prior to the last revision.
- QPA text box next to the slider not working (#10013)
### The bugs with the QPA slider and text box has been fixed.  Tips on how it works:
- Can move the slider to adjust QPA - switch back and forth between deals to see the saved value.
- Can enter 0 in the text box and it will automatically change to 0h00m.  Can then change to a different value and it will save correctly.
- Can manually enter the time in the XhXXm format.  If the time is not entered in this format, you will get a prompt reminding you how to enter the time.
- Distrib Locking Verification (#9979)
- When a user locks a Distrib, they will be required to enter a 'Reason' in the text box (for audit reasons).
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
- End Excel process when the Excel session opened through iManage is closed (#8313)
- IT has addressed all the known causes of ghost Excel sessions within iManage, such as Package PDF, DMT and unlocking distribs.  If you are still running into ghost Excel sessions, please try to pinpoint which button or process within iManage caused it and submit a new ticket to get that fixed.

- An interface was created that allows users to create new and edit/delete existing flexible remittance summary templates, as needed. Hopefully, this will limit the need to submit iTracker tickets to have IT make the updates for you.

- Click the “Insert” key on the keyboard to add a new report (reportname and description ) and then click on Insert in the Edit column

- Sample template file for each map (#8946)
- The Data-Actions > Map > DynamicMap and HardcodedMap tabs have been enhanced to allow you to save and open the latest Excel templates associated with your selected map.  They will also list the name of the template file for your reference.
- Note: More information on who will have access to create and upload map templates to come.
- Once a map has a “templateFile” listed, you will be able to open the template to help you determine the columns required, the constraints of the columns, the accepted type of file (.xls, .xlsx, .csv, etc.).  The template should also have sample data to help you further.
- In addition, the HardcodedMap tab now displays the MapID associated with each hardcoded map.
- The following updates are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- iManage Bond Requirements (#9621 & 9798)
- New requirements have been implemented for Bond deals.  They do not apply to other types of deals, including those that are flagged for “Bond Reporting”.
- All Bond service deals must have data populated in the following tables for the related date. o tblPmtInfo o tblProcessingData o tblReviewPmt o tblReviewTrigger
- MasterCheck value between 0 and 5 MUST be populated in tblReviewTrigger.  Per PID 9798, the MasterCheck value cannot be negative.
- The checks are done at “Reviewer Signoff” and you will not be able to continue the process unless the checks pass.
- If the checks fail, the error message will indicate what is wrong.
- If there is no active payment text file on the deal, iManage will skip the data check for tblPmtInfo and tblReviewPmt.
- Note:  The 3 review sheet range exception fields in Deal Setup have been removed and will no longer be checked for at setup and approval.
- Check Proof variable in tax range during iManage processor approval (#9749)
### When hitting “Processor Signoff” to approve a Bond deal, iManage will now check the "Proof" variable in the tax range to ensure the value is not less than -$1 and not greater than +$1.  If the “Proof” value does not fall within this range, you will get a hard stop, such as this:
- Enhance iManage Lock/Unlocking to more tabs (#9894)
### When using the Lock or Unlock features, iManage will now lock down/unlock any tabs that start with the following words:
- Distrib
- Waterfall (New)
- NIM
- Report
- In addition, the “Distrib Change Tracking” feature has been updated to identify any changes made to the same named tabs.
- Restore PID 7802 - Suppress/hide Excel window during process of packaging PDFs (#8750) When Packaging PDF, by default, iManage will open the distrib behind-the-scenes.  If you want the distrib to be visible during packaging, simply flag the checkbox next to the Package PDF button before pressing it.
- Bug Fix: Deals not loading automatically or fully when switching between users (if a Filter By option has been selected) (#9940)
- The bug that prevented the My Deals screen from loading ALL your Incomplete deals when using the “Filter by” feature has been fixed.  You may resume filtering your allocations by responsibility (Processor, Reviewer or Final Reviewer).
- Enhance the "Open Deal Folder" button in My Deals (#9462)
- The “Open Deal Folder” button has been enhanced to work for Backup Servicing deals.  If on a Backup Servicing deal, the folder options will change to T and U Deal Folders.  Keep in mind that only those who work on Backup deals will have access to the U: drive.  For Bond deals, the options will remain J, Deal Data, M and T Deal Folders.
- Bug fix: Unlocked distribs are opening as "[Read-Only][Shared]" (#9841)
- Distribs that are unlocked will open as [Shared] and in edit-mode.  The bug that caused it be read-only has been fixed.
- Unable to import payment and tax ranges into iManage after zapping (#9943)
### You should now be able to re-Add the tax range in the My Deals > Payments tab after Zapping it.  Previously, it was throwing this error:
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
- tblMetricsDeal not capturing QPAs for every single month for Backup Servicing deals (#9842) Going forward, tblMetricsDeal should correctly and consistently record the QPA value for the analysts doing the work.  There was a bug that prevented it from capturing QPAs every period.
## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.1.3.0.docx>
- Version 6.1.2.0 (Release Date: 4/7/2018)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:36 PM
- The following project is related to archiving of terminated deals, retention and removal from network
- “Archive Terminated Deals” project
- Archiving of terminated deals aggregates all files and folders, across network shares, for the deals which have been terminated and moves them to alternate location for safekeeping. Retention is being tracked for 10 years. Upon retention being met, files and folders are deleted off the network. SQL data is not removed.
- New Approval Process for Bond Deals
- The approval workflow was updated for all Bond deals. You will now see the new buttons that were created for the Macro Manager workflow, i.e. “Processor Tasks” instead of just “Tasks”. The update was made so IT wouldn't have to maintain two separate processes, especially since all Bond deals will eventually use Macro Manager.
### The “button” will now flow in the following order, depending on what is set up on your deal:
- Receive
- Process Distrib (only if using Macro Manager)
- Processor Tasks (only if Going Green tasks are setup)
- Processor Signoff
- Process Review Sheet (only if using Macro Manager)
- Reviewer Tasks (only if Going Green tasks are setup)
- Reviewer Signoff
- Looksee Signoff
- Delivery Signoff
- Since there are additional steps in the workflow, if you Clicked By Mistake on a deal that uses Macro Manager, you will notice that you may have to click the button twice before it clears your signoff since it has to rollback a couple of steps (Signoff > Tasks > Process Distrib/Review Sheet).
- Unfortunately, the Multi-Process feature is not working correctly under the new approval workflow.  There is an outstanding ticket to get it working, but for now, you may have to do your approvals individually.
- Note:  The original buttons will continue to be used for Collateral, Backup Servicing, Global Duties, etc.
- The following updates are related to changes to the setup process.
- Unlock DueDays in tblPmtDay for first month of payment and lock down after first payment (#9833) The “Days Due Before Payment” field in Deal Setup > Basic Info > Dates is now open for edits during the first period. Management determined that analysts should have the capability to update this field in the first period. After that, the field will be locked down and can only be edited by Managers.
- Bug Fix: Allow Final Reviewer to be unassigned (#9879)
- The Allocations screen will again allow the Final Reviewer (Looksee) to be unassigned since not all deals need a Final Reviewer. For example, the TOWD and Bayview deals are final reviewed by the SMEs for just the first month and then they should be removed from the deals.
- Enhancement : Create a flag and notification in iManage to allow Reviewer to know whether or not to send a deal after approving it (#9338)
- In Deal Setup > Basic Info, a new box called "Addl Send Confirm" was added next to the iServ and RegAB checkboxes on the bottom. If flagged, when the Reviewer tries to Send the deal, they will get a pop-up asking them to confirm whether or not they got the 3rd party approval. If Yes, iManage will continue to Send. If No, the process will stop. This is especially helpful for when people are covering for others.
- Background: Certain deals require approval from an external party prior to final delivery of the deal (after approving payment and report in iManage). If the Reviewer forgets which deal needs this external confirmation, they may accidently send the deal and have to revise if changes are requested by the 3rd party.
- Remove Deal Admin from Deal Setup UI (#9450)
- The Deal Admin field has been removed from Deal Setup > Basic Info. Since the Admin reported on the statement package is now pulled from the Contacts > Trustee field, there was no need to keep the Deal Admin field in Deal Setup.
### Deal Report Setup - Clean Up / Create Clear Naming Conventions (#9131) The Data-Actions > Setup > Deal Report Setup screen has been updated:
- The default view will show each category collapsed
- Once a category is expanded, the reports within it will be listed alphabetically
- Added “TYPE” to the Display Reports and Export Reports sections for easier identification of which category the reports are listed under
- The following updates are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Want iManage to check that the date in Distrib matches the processing month when payment range is imported (#9770)
- iManage will now perform a date check when the payment range is imported into iManage - the month/year in the distrib should match the period that the user in iManage is signing off on. If there is a discrepancy, the user will get a hard stop error stating that the "Date in Distrib does not match processing month".
- Automate tblCertInfo Pull (#9780)
- If Analysts forget to import the Cert Setup for their new deals, after the first period, iManage will automatically import the data into the Cert Info screen (tblCertInfo) at Processor’s No Errors.
- iManage deals under Macro Manager not storing signoffs (#9740)
- A bug in the approval process for Macro Manager deals that createda discrepancy between the button display and the signoffs display has been fixed.  Previously, when signing off on a "step" and the screen is not changed to the Analyst name that the step is assigned to, the button would move to the next step, but tblCompleted would not be populated accordingly.
- Tweak the Macro Manager iManage Macro "Create Package Report" (#9743)
- The "Create Report Package" macro (for Macro Manager) has been updated to automatically default to “Yes” for the repackage and revision pop-ups, if any.  Also, if repackaging, the “button” will revert back to Processor Tasks.  Previously under the new approval workflow, repackaging would wipe out tblCompleted, but wouldn’t revert the button back to Tasks to match.
- Global Duty Signoff Issue (#9647)
- The following reminder will pop-up if Analysts try to sign off on a Global Duty that doesn’t have a Payment Day set up. Previously, they would have gotten a “Conversion from type ‘DBNull’ to type “Short” is not valid” error that didn’t clearly state the problem.
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
- Data Management Tool error pop-ups (#8700)
- The DMT will no longer throw the following errors after making table updates.
## iManage release notes notification (#6270)
## After the release of a new version of iManage or if any special announcements need to be made, you will get a Release Notes notification box right when you open iManage for the first time that day.
- You can access the specific iTracker ticket for each item by clicking on the hyperlink under the PID Link.
## After you have received the Release Notes once, you won’t see that specific release again unless you click on the “Show only unread release notes”. Once clicked, it will list all prior Release Notes. • You can select to turn off the notification for the rest of the day by clicking the "Turn Off Release Note Prompt" button or else you will continue to get the pop-up every time you restart iManage on that first day after a release.
- iManage Bond Requirements (#9621)
- Full rollback of ticket #7205. The 3 review sheet range exception fields are disabled. Logic checks at both setup and No Errors steps have been removed
- New checks: All bond service deals must have following data populated in the table for the related date UNLESS Bond Reporting field is flagged Y. Check are performed at No Errors for Bond service after importing of data but before sending files. Cannot continue process unless checks pass.
- User receives message "Data is not populated in XX" --> List all table names missing data.
- If there is no active payment text file, check for tblPmtInfo and tblReviewPmt are skipped
- Active payment text file --> FileTypeID = 8 and Active = 1 in tblFileSetup
- Active payment text file --> DID not in tlbDealSettings where SettingName = 'Selective Report Delivery" and SettingValue = 1
- Confirmation of logic: MasterCheck less than 5 MUST be populated in tblReviewTrigger at Bond service No Errors unless Bond Reporting field is flagged Y. Cannot continue process unless check passes.
- Dtype = MasterCheck in tblReviewTrigger

- The following updates are related to changes to the import/export process.

- You can indicate an additional folder that you want the selected csv/text files to be exported to (in addition to the T:\ISER\{DID} folder). o Click on Add Export Location and navigate to the additional folder.  The chosen path will be listed in the field below the button. o When you click Auto Report or Export Text, the selected csv/text files will be exported to both locations. o You cannot edit the additional export location directly – you will have to click on the Add Export Location to navigate to the new location, as desired. o Click Remove Export Location to remove the additional export folder.

- The following updates are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Insert a footnote page for terminating deals that require investor notification (#8850)
- When certain RMBS deals terminate, the Admin may require that a footnote page be added to the package to notify investors that amounts are being withheld to cover future trustee expenses.
### You will be given the option to add the disclosure when:
- You hit Final Payment on the My Deals dashboard.  The following form will pop-up asking you to select the Termination Date and whether the Footnote is required.
- If Yes, populate the amount you’ve been instructed to withhold and hit Continue.  You will have to repackage PDF in order for iManage to add the disclosure to the end of the package.
- If No, the sign off will continue like normal.
- If you’re not sure, you will be reminded to ask the Admin about it.
- The first month that iManage calculates that the ending balances of the certificates, excluding class R, are being reduced to zero. Note: This check is done when the Reviewer hits No Errors.
- The same Termination Form will pop-up with the same options and results as above.
- If yes, please remember that you must regenerate the Final Package to add the disclosure, which means the Processor and Reviewer must redo their sign-off of the Final Package in the Tasks form. c.	If you are not sure if the disclosure is needed, you will not be able to proceed with approvals until you give a definitive answer.
- Enhancement to iManage PDF Xchange Screen display percentage auto adjustment (#8897)
- For those who stretch their VDI sessions across dual monitors, you now have the option to change the way the prior and current PDFs open through the Tasks form.  Right now, the current PDF opens on the left monitor and the prior PDF opens on the right monitor by default (when using dual monitors).
- FlipScreens will change your personal default setting to open the prior PDF on the left monitor and the current PDF on the right monitor
- ForceSingleScreen will change your personal default setting to open both PDFs on the right monitor (current on left, prior on right)
- Enabling both settings will change your personal default setting to open both PDFs on the right monitor (prior on left, current on right)
- These setting changes are made in the Admin screen, which is locked down for most users.  Please email Mike Gath or myself if you want either of these settings enabled for yourself.
- Note: There is an outstanding ticket to allow the PDFs to flip when using VDI on just one monitor.
- iManage not working after setting up startup preferences (#9656) iManage will no longer crash if you set your My Views dashboard to only show All Tax or All Non-Tax deals.
- iManage bug when sorting by due date and then back to none (#9689)
- iManage will no longer crash if you change your “Sort By” options.
- Bug Fix: Deals not loading automatically when switching Filter By options (#9135)
- The appropriate deal list will show on your My Deals screen depending on what you Filter By, without a need to refresh or restart iManage.
- iManage Crashing when selecting a sent deal that was set up with Input/Macro Manager (#9703) iManage will no longer crash when selecting a deal using Input Manager, after the deal has been Sent.
- Disable the Clicked by Mistake button after Send (#9718)
- The Clicked by Mistake button had previously been disabled on Bond deals after they have been Sent.  The best practice is that deals should only be revised after they have been sent.  The same control was applied to Bond deals using Input Manager.
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:

Please note that this will only work for periods that haven't been processed yet (won't work retroactively).

- CREFC Collateral Summary File - Secured (auto generated) – TIR Code: 992
### o If the file(s) can be posted on the deal’s public tab on TIR:

- CREFC Collateral Summary File (auto generated) – TIR Code: 996
- You may also use the “Add Collateral File” button to select the desired system-generated Collateral file.
- However, do not use the "Add Bond Level File" button because it's not inserting the system-generated file as expected.  Please use the File Type drop-down instead.  Note: There is an outstanding ticket to fix the "Add Bond Level File" button to correctly insert the system-generated file.
- Add a new Service flag in iManage for "Fund Accounting" (#8950)
- A new service called “Fund Accounting” has been added to better identify those types of deals.
- Insert new field in tblsetup for bond exception (#9444)
- A new “Bond Reporting” field has been added to Deal Setup to identify bond-like deals that do not require the same control as normal bond deals, such as requiring the payment and review fields to be populated in the Basic Info tab.

## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version%206.1.0.0.docx>
- Version 6.0.9.1 (Release Date: 1/6/2018)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:46 PM
- Please read below for the bug fixes and enhancements that were just released.
- Errors when Packaging (#9648)
- This was an emergency release of iManage to deal with the locked file errors that we’ve been encountering when packaging PDF.
- Now, iManage will try to delete the temp files 3 times before throwing an error which will hopefully allow the packaging to proceed successfully. If it’s unable to delete a temp file, you will get the following type of error. Please note that this is different from the old error in that it gives you the option of having iManage try to delete the temp file another 3 times.
- If you hit Yes – iManage will attempt to delete the file 3 times. If it is successful, it will continue with packaging the reports.
- If you hit No – iManage will stop packaging reports completely. Your PDF folder will still have all the temp files in it and you will have to manually delete them yourself before packaging again.
- The following are other iManage enhancements that have recently been implemented.
### Review Sheet Unlock Permission and "Tracing" mode (#9138) Review sheet unlocking permissions have been adjusted as follows:
- If you are the Processor on a deal, the Review Sheet can only be opened in a "Read-only" mode (similar to distrib tracing mode). You will not be able to save any edits.
- If you are the Reviewer on a deal, you can open and edit the review sheet for that deal.
- If you are a “Senior Reviewer” or a “Manager”, you can unlock ANY review sheet as long as you are not the Processor on the deal.
- Update user allocation lists to account for custom payment dates (#8581)
- Previously, for non-monthly deals that iManage didn’t correctly calculate the payment dates for, users had to set up custom payment dates for the month prior and after in order for the Table of Contents page to report the correct prior and next payment dates. However, this caused the deal to show up in months that the deals don't actually pay in. Users were either having to delete the prior/next period records in the Custom Payment Date table or ignoring the deal / leaving them incomplete in the months they don't pay in.
### iManage has been updated to address the previous workaround:
- When setting up custom payment dates on non-monthly deals, you no longer have to set up dummy prior and next payments.
- Even if you set up the dummy prior and next payments, the My Deals screen will no longer show the deals in your allocation for the periods that the deal doesn't actually pay in.
- The Table of Contents page will now report the correct prior and next payments without the dummy prior/next months set up.

- Send out the comparison Excel file when a deal is revised (#9156)
- A DtsRevision.xls file will be attached to the File Delivery email notification that is sent to the Account Admin and Cash Analyst whenever a payment revision is “Sent”.  The Cash Team requested an automated file detailing the original vs. revised payment info.  This will save them from having to manually populate the file that they send to DTC.
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
- Allow for maps to be enabled/disabled via UI (#9495)
- Those with Map Edit rights can disable/enable maps through the Data-Actions > Map > DynmaicMap screen, as needed.  You will no longer need to submit an iTracker ticket to do so.
- New Filemasks for Support Packages (#7793/#9429)
### The following filemasks have been added to Production for use in setting up Support Packages:
- LCD = Last Calendar day of current month
- LCD- = Last Calendar day of prior month
- LBD = Last US Business day of current month LBD- = Last US Business day of prior month xNBD = X calendar day of current month or next US Business day xNBD- = X calendar day of prior month or next US Business day xPBD = X calendar day of current month or prior US Business day xPBD- = X calendar day of prior month or prior US Business day
- DID = DID of active deal
- Folder = Deal folder of active deal
- For example, you may now use {DID} to indicate the folder in the M: or T: drives that you want to pull a file from. You can also use the {LCD-} filemask to indicate the last calendar day of the prior month, if that is how your servicer file is named.
- Please refer to N:\Projects\Going Green\Training Material\Support Package Setup.docm for additional details on how to set up filemasks.

## From <https://sharepoint.usbank.com/teams/gsf/ir/GSF%20IR%20Release%20Notes/New%20iManage%20Version% 206.0.6.0.docx>
- Version 6.0.5.0 (Release Date: 9/2/2017)
- Tuesday, March 7, 2023	4:49 PM
- The following updates are related to changes to the approval/revision process.
- Fixes to Excel Sessions when Opening the Review Sheet (#8251)
- Excel sessions/files opened through iManage have been completely revamped to address the problems we've had since conversion.  Please note these fixes only apply to when opening the Review Sheet through iManage.  A separate ticket is being worked on to address the same issues when opening the Distrib through iManage.
### Highlights:
- No more ghost Excel processes running once you close the files opened through iManage.
- No more file recoveries of the files that were opened through iManage.
- If you open the review sheet through iManage, you can open other files in the same Excel session and close them out individually.  If you made changes to the other files, it will prompt you to save/not.  If you did not make any changes, it will just close the individual file without the save prompt.
- Note: If you open another file in the same Excel session as the review sheet that is opened through Tasks and make edits to the other file, please make sure you save the changes to your other file before signing off on the Review sheet.  If you don't save the file and sign off on the review sheet first, it will close the file's window and THEN ask if you want to save the changes.
- When iManage opens the review sheet behind the scenes to create the PDF for the repository and to import the review range at No Errors, it will ask,  "Do you want to save changes before exiting?" even if you didn't make any changes at the time.  This is due to Excel being closed out (and the safety measure of allowing you to save), instead of being killed on its own.
- Resec Enhancements 	- Revision Notification Emails and Automated Received  (#9098)
- The email notification sent to the Resec deal team has been updated to clearly state that the underlying deal has been revised.  It will also be marked as urgent (!) to make the email stand out even more.
- Another enhancement is the Resec will be automatically marked as Received once all the underlying
- deals have been completed (Sent).  Please note that the Received By field will not show an actual user's
- name since it is auto
- -
- populated by iManage.
- Create a calc compare of payments vs factors when you sign off in iManage (#8392)
- In addition to the payment comparison between the distrib and review sheet, iManage now compares the
- factors calculated in the distrib's payment range against an outside calculation done by iManage.  We had
- some revisions where bad factors (pulled from the distrib) were sent to DTC,  who relies solely on the
- factors to make payments.  This additional check will ensure the factors listed in the payment text files are
- correct.
- If there is a discrepancy with the
- Principal Distributed or Interest Distributed factors
- , you will get the
- following type of error.  This is a hard stop and you will not be allowed to move forward until the factors
- are corrected in the distrib.
- Bug Fix: Managers should not be able to Revise on deals they are Processors on (#9073)
- Users who are the assigned processor on the deal will not be able to revise that deal, even if they are a manager. This was a business rule established by Senior Management in iTracker #7610 	- "...a reviewer or manager that is the processor for a deal is considered processor level on the deal."
- Bug Fix: Review Sheets disappearing after being rolled through the Tasks form (#9076)
- Old KILL Excel code was causing files to crash or get wiped out.  For example, when rolling the Review Sheet through the Reviewer's Tasks Form and signing off on it by clicking Done, the file would suddenly disappear from the deal folder and throw an error that the Review Sheet can't be found.  This should be no longer be happening now.
- Bond - Mastercheck requirement (#8964)
- To further enforce that the Mastercheck should be added to the review sheets for all bond deals, iManage will now import the trigger range even if the review payment range is not populated.  Then, if the Mastercheck does not exist or if the trigger range fails to import for any reason, the approval process will stop, files will not be sent, and you will get the following message: "The Mastercheck value does not exist.  The Mastercheck is required for Bond deals."  As before, the Mastercheck value must be below 5.
- Note: Similarly, the tax range will now be imported even if the payment range is not populated as the data from the tax range is still needed.
- The following updates are related to changes to Deal Setup.
- Update iManage 	- Deal Setup 	- Location fields (#8454 / PI #242)
- The location field names in Deal Setup have been updated to clearly indicate what each one represents.  The IR Processing Location and REMIC Tax Processing Location fields will automatically update if the IR or Tax Processor, respectively, are reassigned to an analyst in a different office.
- IR Processing Location 	- The office that the Processor is based out of (where the distrib is being processed)
- REMIC Tax Proc Loc 	- The office where the tax is being processed only (not filed)
- REMIC Tax Filing Loc 	- The office where the tax is being filed (not processed).  Note, this is a static field and currently shows St. Paul (data from the old field) and will be updated shortly.  For most deals, the tax filing location is the same as the tax processing location, except for 100	-120 deals.
- Add a shortcut to the T:	\Tax \{DID} folder in the J:	\{Deal folder} whenever the 1066 service is added to a deal (#7737)
- iManage will automatically create a deal's tax folder (and corresponding shortcut in the J: deal folder) whenever a tax service is added to the deal.  Please note that the folder/shortcut will only get created if the TaxPlatform is populated first, prior to adding any tax duties to Services.  Ex. Must populate S in the TaxPlatform field first, then add Tax 1066 to Services.  If you add the service first and then populate the TaxPlatform, it will not work.
- If Tax Platform = S (iTax), folder will be created under T:	\TAX
- If Tax Platform = E (Excel, folder will be created under T:	\TAX \EXCEL	\
### Miscellaneous Enhancements/Bug Fixes:
- Watermark on Test Packages (#8992 / PI #357)
- When using the Create Test Package feature to generate the package, each page of the PDF report will
- now have a watermark in the background to indicate that it is a "Sample Report."

- Basic Info

- Thursday, May 29, 2025	8:53 AM
- It is possible to have a mismatch in payment date between VIPR and iManage.   If that happens, the data will not get automatically pulled into VIPR - request is done for a specific payment date and we would not have a record for any payments on that date (for example, PIVOT asks for 15th and we have a payment date of 16th).
- Things to look at that may cause the disconnect -
- Different payment date set up on different CUSIPs.   Look at the payment date record to see what activity exists on that payment date in VIPR.  From there you should be able to click on a CUSIP to open CUSIP Summary page.
### Navigate to Payment Detail:
- There you can see the payment schedule.   Some deals are set up with only custom / ad-hoc payments.
- Check with Account Admin (AA) or Cash Analyst (CA) and request to update to a periodic schedule.   Typically all CUSIPs on the deal should be on the same payment schedule.
- Multiple payment dates in a month.  iManage may have multiple DIDs setup to account for each payment date, but VIPR has only one deal.  Ex. deal pays on the 5th and 20th of each month.  Solution is to calculate and load each payment date into VIPR.
- Add the payment dates to an Excel file (column A, no headers)
- Go to CUSIP Summary/the Update Payment Detail tab.
- Select the Frequency as Custom and click on the Select file button to upload the dates from the file.
- Missing amount for STA Adjustment
- Thursday, May 29, 2025	10:01 AM
- Normally VIPR will automatically calculate the adjustment amounts, but there is an 'order of operations' issue that can result in the STA adjustment ending up in Missing Amounts queue for a class.
- Prerequisites for calculation - Class should have STA Outstanding populated on the payment activity record and payment file from IR is loaded after that amount is provided.
- If you see that STA Outstanding is populated on a class and all other amounts (Prin/Int/Balances) are loaded, but the STA Adjustment is NULL, re-load data from GSFIR.   That will trigger re-calculation of the STA Adjustment and class should go to either 'Awaiting Payment Date' or 'Awaiting Disbursement' status.
- Normally the STA Outstanding is updated via an overnight daily batch process for all deals.  You can also manually trigger the update just for your deal by pressing 'Refresh STA Amount' on the CUSIP Summary page.

- Tuesday, September 2, 2025	10:10 AM
### Symptoms:
### Email message indicating error with a job.  Log file contains the following:
- Failed to get secret from /protected/data/prod/Azure/secret/b70de23d-daab-4fcf-abf7-7c0e035a0c2f: The remote server returned an error: (403) Forbidden.
- Secrets are retrieved using one of two methods - in 8431 namespace, usually using AutoAuth agent that is running on the machine, or with an AppRole account credentials stored in an encrypted XML file.
### Troubleshooting:
- Connect to the machine (listed at the top of the log file) using your "D" service account.
- Navigate to D:\AutoAuth\ and look at vault.sink file.  If the modified timestamp is older than a few minutes, it is likely an issue with the agent.
### Resolution:
- Open Powershell 'Run as Administrator'.
- Execute following commands: cd d:\autoauth .\valut_agent -service
- Confirm that valut.sink file timestamp is updated

- A precondition is a date/time that can be setup to be calculated for every period at any given step.
- We setup a precondition for most iManage deals to give some leeway between when the bond deal is completed and when tax workflow starts.  For those deals, we set up a precondition of 7 p.m. (CST) on payment date - tax workflow will automatically kick off at that time.  if user tries to manually kick off the tax workflow prior to that, the precondition will fail as a warning to the tax analyst that bond deal might not be done yet...are you sure you want to run tax workflow anyway?  if you are, you can simply override the fail and proceed with tax workflow.

- Modify to delete a validation via the Delete tab
- • What to do if a validation fails
### If a validation fails, you have two options:
- Fix the problem that the validation caught. Once fixed, rerun the step and the validation should pass.
- Ex. Deal termination validation fails so you make all the manual adjustments needed to get the termination to process correctly and then rerun workflow.
- Ex. File validation fails because it’s less than 5 kb so it’s most likely blank.  You open the file and see that it is indeed blank so you revert workflow to the Create Reports step so iTax can regenerate the reports.
- Use the validation as a reminder that you need to pay close attention to the results.  In these scenarios, you can simply override the fail (see below).
- Ex. Deal Team must manually validate – this is a generic stop that can be used for any reason.
- Excel deals – validation is setup at Begin Workflow to remind user they need to run the deal in Excel first
- STACR deals – validation is setup at the Reviewer Signoff step to remind user they need to review the results before delivery
- Overriding a validation fail o If the status shows that a validation failed, go to the deal view for the related period o Open the step report for the step in which the validation failed

- Flag the Override checkbox for the validation o Hit Save and workflow will automatically resume

- Tuesday, December 16, 2025	9:53 PM
- In order to rerun any completed period, you must revise the period in the Tax Portfolio View.  Since monthly, quarterly and annually  signoffs are all tied together, there is no undo option with tax workflow.
- Workflow actions > Revise period
- In the Incomplete deals tab, select the deal's row and Workflow actions > Revise period
- In the Monthly details expanded view, select the earliest period you want to revise and Workflow actions > Revise period
### The Period revision modal will open:
- The period displayed in the Incomplete deals grid or selected in the Monthly details grid will be selected as the Revision period by default
- ○ You can select to revise a different period from the dropdown menu
- You must select the Identifying party (Client, Holder or Internal) - the party that notified you of the need to revise the deal/period
- You must select the Revision main category
- If the main revision reason does not fit into the available options, select Other and you will be required to add Comments with the details explaining the revision
- Revert to tells the system which workflow step you want the deal to be reverted to for the selected period
- Leave Begin Workflow selected if you want the data to be reimported
- ○ Select Run Tax if you want workflow to skip the Import step
- Existing Revision ID
- Instead of manually selecting the Identifying party and Revision main category again, you can select an Existing Revision ID
- If you have already revised the deal for the same reason in a different period, use the Revision history tab
- If another deal within your deal's shelf has already been revised for the same reason you are revising now, use the Shelf history tab
- Selecting a revision record that matches your desired selection will automatically backfill the Identifying party and Revision main category for you
- Annual Revision
- Monday, January 12, 2026	3:56 PM
- Annual revision merely moves the deal from Completed deals tab to the Incomplete deals tab. It doesn't actually revise any periods.
- We had asked that we have the ability to make a decision of whether to actually revise or not and from which period. Therefore, Annual revision only moves the deal to Incomplete. Once you've decided to revise, then you would use the Period revision under Workflow actions in the Incomplete tab to revise the earliest period you want and that will automatically revise all the subsequent periods as well. If you decided that revising is not really needed, for now, you would submit an iTracker ticket to set SignoffCompleted =1 in tblcompletedtaxA and that would move the deal back to complete.  In the near future, you will have an option to "move back to complete" on the UI.
- Reset Emails
- Tuesday, December 16, 2025	9:54 PM
- If you get an email about tax workflow reset, it means that someone is trying to run a deal in iTax that you are assigned to and maybe running workflow on.
- Ex. Suppose you kicked off workflow for October and it ran the deal current to December and all three months are waiting for your signoff at the Check Report - Reviewer step.  If someone tries to run the deal for November in iTax, it will reset the workflow for November and December.

## Key Topics:
- Introduction: Courtney, Linda, and other team members discussed various technical aspects and troubleshooting steps for the new iManage system. The meeting aimed to address questions and provide guidance on using the system effectively.
- Technical Troubleshooting: Courtney and Linda explained the importance of starting the iManage agent first and the role of the  iManage legacy. They discussed the need to clear the cache frequently and provided steps to do so, emphasizing that clearing the cache should be the first troubleshooting step for any issues.
- Period and Annual Revisions: Courtney and Linda demonstrated how to revise periods and annual reports in the new iManage system. They explained the process of revising periods, including selecting the revision period, identifying the party, and providing comments. They also discussed the importance of revising the entire period and subsequent periods if needed.
- Reset Workflow Emails: Courtney and Linda discussed the reset workflow emails that team members receive when a workflow is reset. They explained that these emails notify team members of any resets and the importance of checking the emails to stay informed about workflow changes.
- Manual Adjustments and Workflow: Courtney and Linda explained how to make manual adjustments in iManage and how to continue the workflow after making adjustments. They emphasized the importance of not reimporting data if manual adjustments are made and provided steps to continue the workflow from the appropriate step.
- Contact Management: Linda introduced the contact management feature in iManage, explaining how to add contacts to a deal and show them in the ribbon for easy access. This feature helps users manage and access contact information efficiently.
### Action Items:
### Technical Troubleshooting:
### Clear the cache and perform a browser refresh whenever encountering weird errors in the iManage system. (Team) Period and Annual Revisions:
### Revise the period or annual report by selecting the appropriate revision period, identifying the party, and providing comments in the iManage system. (Team) Reset Workflow Emails:
- Check reset workflow emails to stay informed about any workflow resets and changes in the iManage system. (Team)
### Manual Adjustments and Workflow:
### Make manual adjustments in iManage and continue the workflow from the appropriate step without reimporting data. (Team) Contact Management:
- Add relevant contacts to a deal in iManage and show them in the ribbon for easy access. (Team)

- Question
- Answer/Resolution
- How to clear browser cache in the new Imanage?
- Use Ctrl+Shift+Delete; ensure only one web UI tab is open when clearing cache.
- How to revise a period (e.g., monthly/quarterly report)?
- Go to monthly details, select the period, use "Revise Period" under workflow actions, fill out the form, and click "Revise Deal."
- How to revise quarterly reports for guarantor payments?
- Revise each month in the quarter; monthly and quarterly are now combined in one sign-off process.
- If monthly processing is undone, how to revise schedule Qs already delivered?
- Revise from the first month needing changes; all subsequent months must be redone.
- For validation reports, does the system pull the latest from the F drive?
- Yes, it always pulls the latest validation; if files are moved, the link will break.
- For Ginnie Mae and iFactor, do we process in the new system?
- No, continue using legacy iFactor for batch processing; new system is for sign-off and delivery only.
- Can batch sign-off be done for Ginnie Mae deals?
- Not exactly as before; can select multiple deals and process if set up, but may need individual review for check reports.
- How does the system determine the latest validation version?
- It looks for the highest version number (e.g., V5 over V4), not the date saved.
- How to fix out of balances (OOB) without reimporting?
- Manually adjust in ITAX, rerun, then resume workflow from the current step; do not revert to begin workflow unless reimport needed.
- What to do if sign-off is stuck after manual review?
- Rerun the workflow and use "Save and Resume" instead of just "Save."
- How to filter deals needing action in the new Imanage?
- Use the filter for period and step status "does not contain complete" to identify deals needing work.
- Is there a function to switch between Imanage and Iserv in the new system?
- No, Iserv-related functions are still in legacy; only contact management is available in the new system.

- “SIRP/AIR activation” refers to the point at which a user (PBLO, Technical Owner, or Risk Oversight Manager) becomes fully enabled to participate in the Application Inherent Risk (AIR) process in ServiceNow — replacing the legacy Software Inherent Risk Profile (SIRP) process from tGRC.
- Your enterprise sources describe this very consistently.
- What is AIR?
### AIR (Application Inherent Risk) is the new ServiceNow-based inherent risk methodology replacing SIRP. It is used to determine an application’s inherent cyber and data risk levels. Your organization’s documentation confirms:
- “SIRP is transitioning out of tGRC and will be replaced by the Application Inherent Risk (AIR) assessment in ServiceNow IRM.” [We are exc...rviceNow f | Viva Engage]

- What does ‘Activation’ mean?
### AIR activation = entitlement + training complete, meaning you are officially allowed to perform your AIR role within ServiceNow. Your enterprise sources describe the activation steps very clearly:
### Activation requires:
- a. Completion of mandatory AIR training (in TLC)
- “Entitlements will be requested once you have completed the AIR training… You will not be able to view anything in IRM until you have an entitlement.” [SIRP to AI...nformation | SharePoint]

- “You will not be able to view anything in IRM until you have an entitlement.” [SIRP to AI...nformation | SharePoint] c. Activation of access specifically for your transition wave
- Different SIRP-rated applications are moved to AIR in waves. Your access becomes active at the start of your wave, after training is complete.
- “You will be able to access ServiceNow IRM beginning December 17 after your entitlement is activated.” [SIRP to AI...rticipants |
